### 剪贴板图片与读取校验

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/clipboard.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useUploader, type UploadFileItem } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const files = ref<UploadFileItem[]>([])
const message = ref('')
const rejectionMessages: Record<string, string> = {
  'max-files': '最多接收 3 张图片',
  'max-file-size': '单张图片不能超过 1 MiB',
  accept: '仅支持图片文件',
}
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  accept: () => 'image/*',
  maxFiles: () => 3,
  maxFileSize: () => 1024 * 1024,
  autoUpload: () => false,
  onRejected: (rejected) => {
    message.value = rejected.map((item) => rejectionMessages[item.reason] ?? '文件未能读取，请重新选择').join(', ')
  },
})
function paste(event: ClipboardEvent) {
  const incoming = Array.from(event.clipboardData?.files ?? [])
  if (!incoming.length) {
    return
  }
  event.preventDefault()
  message.value = ''
  uploader.addFiles(incoming)
}
function addExample() {
  message.value = ''
  uploader.addFiles([
    new File(['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="8" height="8"/>'], 'local-example.svg', {
      type: 'image/svg+xml',
    }),
  ])
}
function reset() {
  uploader.reset()
  message.value = ''
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <p>将剪贴板图片粘贴到输入区。最多 3 张，每张不超过 1 MiB；只读取文件，不上传。普通文本粘贴仍按原生输入处理。</p>
    <mp-textarea placeholder="在这里粘贴图片或文本" @paste="paste" />
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="addExample">加入本地示例图片</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="reset">清空列表</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p role="status">已接收 {{ files.length }} 个文件。{{ message }}</p>
    <ul>
      <li v-for="file in files" :key="file.uid">{{ file.name }}</li>
    </ul>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### 替换后的约束校验

反向返回顺序：旧任务等待时重置并加入新文件，先点“返回最新缩略图”接受新项，再“拒绝最早缩略图”。旧失败只结清旧任务，不能再显示read-error、删除新项或增加解码数；最后重置清空列表和计数。这仍是本地回调竞争，不是原生读取器异常。

开启 FileReader / data-url 后，接受的 File 会读取为 data URL。Data URLs 显示当前 data-url 项目数，Decoded images 显示重置以来累计的 load 次数。删除项目不会减少累计次数；重置清零两者，类型拒绝发生在读取之前。

开关仅影响后续新增项，不会重新读取既有项目；可按 file/data-url/file 顺序混合加入三项。满额后再加入会报告 max-files，图片和解码计数不变；删除 data-url 项后重新加入会读取新文件，累计解码数继续增加，重置清空整个混合队列。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/replacement-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const files = ref([])
const readDataUrl = ref(false)
const readObjectUrl = ref(false)
const pauseThumbnail = ref(false)
const pendingThumbnails = shallowRef([])
const decoded = ref(0)
const reasons = ref([])
const replacements = new WeakMap()
const maxFileSize = 1048576
const maxTotalSize = 2097152
const maxFiles = 3
const svg =
  '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><rect width="16" height="16" fill="#4caf50"/></svg>'
let sequence = 0

function replace(file) {
  const mode = replacements.get(file)
  if (mode === 'type') {
    return new File(['text replacement'], file.name.replace('.svg', '.txt'), { type: 'text/plain' })
  }
  if (mode === 'size') {
    return new File([new Uint8Array(maxFileSize + 1)], file.name, { type: file.type })
  }
  return new File([file], file.name, { type: file.type })
}

const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  accept: () => 'image/*',
  maxFiles: () => maxFiles,
  createThumbnailUrl: () =>
    pauseThumbnail.value
      ? () =>
          new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            pendingThumbnails.value = [...pendingThumbnails.value, { resolve, reject }]
          })
      : undefined,
  maxFileSize: () => maxFileSize,
  maxTotalSize: () => maxTotalSize,
  resolveType: () => (readObjectUrl.value ? 'object-url' : readDataUrl.value ? 'data-url' : 'file'),
  beforeRead: () => replace,
  onRejected: (items) => {
    reasons.value = items.map((item) => item.reason)
  },
})

function probe(mode) {
  reasons.value = []
  const payload = mode === 'total' ? svg.padEnd(786432, ' ') : svg
  const file = new File([payload], `sample-${++sequence}.svg`, { type: 'image/svg+xml' })
  replacements.set(file, mode)
  return uploader.addFiles([file])
}

function reset() {
  uploader.reset()
  decoded.value = 0
  reasons.value = []
}
function settleThumbnail(fail = false, latest = false) {
  const tasks = [...pendingThumbnails.value]
  const task = latest ? tasks.pop() : tasks.shift()
  if (!task) {
    return
  }
  pendingThumbnails.value = tasks
  if (fail) {
    task.reject(new Error('Local thumbnail failure'))
  } else {
    task.resolve('data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(svg))
  }
}
function cleanupThumbnails() {
  const tasks = pendingThumbnails.value
  pendingThumbnails.value = []
  tasks.forEach((task) => task.resolve(undefined))
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanupThumbnails)
onDeactivated(cleanupThumbnails)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="upload-read-demo">
    <p class="thumbnail-pending">Pending thumbnails: {{ pendingThumbnails.length }}</p>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length" @click="settleThumbnail(false, true)">
      返回最新缩略图
    </mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length" @click="settleThumbnail()"
      >返回最早缩略图</mp-button
    >
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pendingThumbnails.length" @click="settleThumbnail(true)"
      >拒绝最早缩略图</mp-button
    >
    <mp-checkbox v-model="readDataUrl" edit-mode="direct">使用原生 FileReader 读取为 data-url</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="readObjectUrl" edit-mode="direct">使用原生 Blob/object-url（优先）</mp-checkbox>
    <output>Blob URLs: {{ files.filter((file) => file.url?.startsWith('blob:')).length }}</output>
    <p role="status">
      Data URLs: {{ files.filter((file) => file.url?.startsWith('data:')).length }} · Decoded images: {{ decoded }}
    </p>
    <img
      v-for="file in files.filter((file) => /^(data:|blob:)/.test(file.thumbnailUrl || ''))"
      :key="file.uid"
      :src="file.thumbnailUrl"
      :alt="file.name"
      width="16"
      height="16"
      @load="decoded++"
    />
    <p>仅接受图片；单文件 1 MiB、合计 2 MiB、最多 3 个。每个示例均经过 before-read。</p>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="probe('valid')">加入小图片</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="probe('type')">替换为文本</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="probe('size')">替换为超大图片</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="probe('total')">加入 768 KiB 图片</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="reset">重置队列</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="pauseThumbnail" edit-mode="direct">暂停本地缩略图 Promise</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-upload v-model="files" edit-mode="direct" :show-upload-button="false" :preview="false" />
    <p>队列：{{ files.map((file) => file.name).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
    <p>拒绝原因：{{ reasons.join(', ') || '无' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## 队列与进度

### 外部管理进度

可直接加入本地示例项观察 40% 的外部进度，再模拟完成。完成操作只更新仍在上传的项；取消项保持 canceled，已删除的项不会重新出现。外部托管模式隐藏内置请求重试按钮，使用“模拟外部重试”恢复取消或失败项，再由业务端完成。示例不发送网络请求。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/external-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const files = ref([])
const hasUploading = computed(() => files.value.some((file) => file.status === 'uploading'))
const hasRetryable = computed(() => files.value.some((file) => ['error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status)))
let sequence = 0

function read(file) {
  file.status = 'uploading'
  file.percent = 40
}

function addExample() {
  const file = new File(['Local external upload demo.'], `external-${++sequence}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' })
  const item = {
    uid: `external-${sequence}`,
    name: file.name,
    size: file.size,
    type: file.type,
    file,
    status: 'ready',
    percent: 0,
  }
  read(item)
  files.value = [...files.value, item]
}

function complete() {
  files.value = files.value.map((file) =>
    file.status === 'uploading' ? { ...file, status: 'success', percent: 100 } : file,
  )
}

function retry() {
  files.value = files.value.map((file) =>
    ['error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status) ? { ...file, status: 'uploading', percent: 40 } : file,
  )
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>业务端托管进度和结果；可加入本地示例项，无需选择文件，也不发送请求。</p>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="addExample">加入外部上传项</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!hasUploading" @click="complete">模拟外部完成</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!hasRetryable" @click="retry">模拟外部重试</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-upload v-model="files" edit-mode="direct" :show-retry-button="false" @read="read" />
    <p>队列状态：{{ files.map((file) => `${file.name}: ${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`).join('；') || '空' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'

const files = ref([])
const timers = new Set()
function start(file) {
  file.status = 'uploading'
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    file.percent = Math.min(file.percent + 10, 100)
    if (file.percent === 100) {
      file.status = 'success'
      clearInterval(timer)
      timers.delete(timer)
    }
```

### 手动队列和可取消请求

可直接“加入示例文件”，也可选择本地文件；两种方式均不访问网络。点击提交后观察进度，取消会停止活动请求，重试会重新上传。开启“首次请求失败”时，同一文件首次失败、重试成功。活动请求数在完成、取消、失败及离开 Demo 后清零。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/queue-request.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import type { UploadFileItem, UploadInstance, UploadProgressEvent, UploadRequestOptions } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const files = ref<UploadFileItem[]>([])
const uploader = ref<UploadInstance>()
const failOnce = ref(false)
const activeRequests = ref(0)
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>()
const attempts = new Map<string, number>()
const exampleUrls = new Set<string>()
let sequence = 0

function addExample() {
  const file = new File(['Local upload demo; no network.'], `example-${++sequence}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' })
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(file)
  exampleUrls.add(url)
  files.value = [
    ...files.value,
    {
      uid: `demo-queue-${sequence}`,
      name: file.name,
      size: file.size,
      type: file.type,
      file,
      url,
      status: 'ready',
      percent: 0,
    },
  ]
}

function request({ file, onProgress, onSuccess, onError }: UploadRequestOptions) {
  const attempt = (attempts.get(file.uid) ?? 0) + 1
  attempts.set(file.uid, attempt)
  const reject = failOnce.value && attempt === 1
  let percent = 0
  const stop = () => {
    clearInterval(timer)
    timers.delete(timer)
    activeRequests.value = timers.size
  }
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    percent += 10
    onProgress({ percent } as UploadProgressEvent)
    if (percent >= 100) {
      stop()
      if (reject) {
        onError(new Error('Simulated first-attempt failure'))
      } else {
        onSuccess({ ok: true, attempt })
      }
    }
  }, 200)
  timers.add(timer)
  activeRequests.value = timers.size
  return { abort: stop }
}

function cleanup() {
  uploader.value?.abort()
  timers.forEach((timer) => clearInterval(timer))
  timers.clear()
  activeRequests.value = 0
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  cleanup()
  exampleUrls.forEach((url) => URL.revokeObjectURL(url))
  exampleUrls.clear()
})
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <p>本地模拟请求；支持取消、重试和手动提交，不访问网络。</p>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="failOnce" edit-mode="direct">首次请求失败（重试成功）</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="addExample">加入示例文件</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="uploader?.submit()">提交队列</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-upload
      ref="uploader"
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      multiple
      :auto-upload="false"
      :custom-request="request"
    />
    <p>队列状态：{{ files.map((file) => `${file.name}: ${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`).join('；') || '空' }}</p>
    <p>活动请求：{{ activeRequests }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## 异步钩子与请求

### 删除前确认

开启“手动异步确认”后忽略同步允许开关，删除等待“确认删除 / 取消删除”。同一文件等待时重复点击不会新增钩子；取消保留文件，等待中禁用后再确认也不会删除，解除禁用后需重新发起。计数核对列表、等待任务、钩子和 remove 通知；停用或卸载结清本地等待，不访问网络。

新增操作均不访问网络：“异常拒绝删除”拒绝本地Promise，文件保留且后续可重试；“替换同 UID 文件”生成新的本地File，旧删除确认不得移除替换项。“重置上传队列”调用公开reset，旧确认不再产生remove；“激活上传组件”通过KeepAlive停用/恢复Upload，等待任务保留在外层Demo用于手动返回，旧结果不得影响恢复后的实例。停用Upload不等于取消外部业务Promise；离开整个Demo才结清其本地等待。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/before-remove.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const files = ref([
  {
    uid: 'image',
    name: 'example.svg',
    type: 'image/svg+xml',
    url: 'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%22120%22 height=%22120%22%3E%3Crect width=%22120%22 height=%22120%22 fill=%22%236750a4%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E',
    status: 'success',
    percent: 100,
  },
])
const allow = ref(false)
const manual = ref(false)
const blocked = ref(false)
const attempts = ref(0)
const removed = ref(0)
const uploadRef = ref()
const mounted = ref(true)
const pending = shallowRef([])
const beforeRemove = () => {
  attempts.value++
  if (!manual.value) {
    return allow.value
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    pending.value = [...pending.value, { resolve, reject }]
  })
}
function settle(accepted) {
  const jobs = pending.value
  pending.value = []
  jobs.forEach((job) =>
    accepted === 'reject' ? job.reject(new Error('Local removal rejection')) : job.resolve(accepted),
  )
}
function replace() {
  files.value = files.value.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    name: 'replacement.txt',
    type: 'text/plain',
    file: new File(['local replacement'], 'replacement.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }),
  }))
}
function restore() {
  files.value = [
    {
      uid: 'image',
      name: 'restored.txt',
      type: 'text/plain',
      status: 'success',
      percent: 100,
      file: new File(['local sample'], 'restored.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }),
    },
  ]
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => settle(false))
onDeactivated(() => settle(false))
</script>

<template>
  <section class="remove-confirm-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="allow" edit-mode="direct">允许此操作</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="manual" edit-mode="direct">手动异步确认</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="blocked" edit-mode="direct">禁用上传组件</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="settle(true)">确认删除</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="settle(false)">取消删除</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!pending.length" @click="settle('reject')">异常拒绝删除</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!files.length" @click="replace">替换同 UID 文件</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="uploadRef?.reset()">重置上传队列</mp-button>
    <mp-button html-type="button" @click="restore">恢复示例文件</mp-button>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="mounted" edit-mode="direct">激活上传组件</mp-checkbox>
    <KeepAlive>
      <mp-upload
        v-if="mounted"
        ref="uploadRef"
        v-model="files"
        edit-mode="direct"
        :before-remove="beforeRemove"
        :disabled="blocked"
        @remove="removed++"
      />
    </KeepAlive>
    <p role="status">文件：{{ files.length }}；等待：{{ pending.length }}；钩子：{{ attempts }}；删除：{{ removed }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 上传前准备与取消竞争

取消后重试合计大小组合：双项进入准备后取消，再次提交会保留四个待返回任务（含两次已失效尝试）。统一返回时仍只启动一次有效请求；超限项保留取消前的原文件和 `canceled` 状态，不误算为新失败或自动恢复为 ready。删除成功项后可再次提交剩余项并成功；旧准备结果不占用额外容量。

合计大小组合：空队列选择“每项替换600B，合计上限1024B”，连续加入两个62B合成图片，再准备并统一完成。每项均满足单文件1024B限制，但两项替换后总量超限，因此只有一项发起本地请求，另一项保留ready原文件并报告max-total-size。删除成功项后，再准备剩余项可成功；重置清空队列、等待和请求计数。此处验证本地before-upload替换，不涉及原生文件选择或真实网络上传。

点击“准备并提交”后，`before-upload` 保持等待；重复提交不会重复创建同一尝试。取消准备后可以再次提交，再点击“完成准备”同时返回旧、新结果，只有当前有效尝试能发起请求。选择文本或超大图片替换时会再次检查类型和 1 KiB 大小限制，拒绝后保持 ready，可改为有效副本后重试。本示例使用公开 useUploader 和本地即时请求，不访问网络；重置、停用和卸载会释放等待任务。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/prepare-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const files = ref([])
const reasons = ref([])
const mode = ref('valid')
const preparing = ref(0)
const requestCount = ref(0)
const pending = new Set()
const modes = [
  { label: '有效副本', value: 'valid' },
  { label: '替换为文本', value: 'type' },
  { label: '替换为超大图片', value: 'size' },
  { label: '每项替换600B，合计上限1024B', value: 'total' },
]
let sequence = 0

function beforeUpload(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    pending.add({ file, resolve })
    preparing.value = pending.size
  })
}

const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  accept: () => 'image/*',
  maxFileSize: () => 1024,
  maxFiles: () => (mode.value === 'total' ? 2 : 1),
  maxTotalSize: () => 1024,
  resolveType: () => 'file',
  autoUpload: () => false,
  beforeUpload: () => beforeUpload,
  customRequest:
    () =>
    ({ onSuccess }) => {
      requestCount.value++
      onSuccess({ ok: true })
    },
  onRejected: (items) => {
    reasons.value = items.map((item) => item.reason)
  },
})

function add() {
  const svg = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1" height="1"/>'
  return uploader.addFiles([new File([svg], `prepare-${++sequence}.svg`, { type: 'image/svg+xml' })])
}

function submit() {
  reasons.value = []
  return uploader.submit()
}

function finish() {
  const jobs = [...pending]
  pending.clear()
  preparing.value = 0
  jobs.forEach(({ file, resolve }) => {
    const raw = file.file
    if (mode.value === 'type') {
      resolve(new File(['text'], 'replacement.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }))
    } else if (mode.value === 'size') {
      resolve(new File([new Uint8Array(1025)], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    } else if (mode.value === 'total') {
      resolve(new File([new Uint8Array(600)], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    } else {
      resolve(new File([raw], raw.name, { type: raw.type }))
    }
  })
}

function cleanup() {
  uploader.abort()
  pending.forEach(({ resolve }) => resolve(false))
  pending.clear()
  preparing.value = 0
}

function reset() {
  cleanup()
  uploader.reset()
  reasons.value = []
  requestCount.value = 0
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup)
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>

<template>
  <div class="upload-prepare-demo">
    <p>提交后暂停 before-upload；可取消后再次提交，再统一完成准备，只有当前有效尝试可以发起本地请求。</p>
    <mp-radio-group v-model="mode" edit-mode="direct" :options="modes" />
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button :disabled="files.length >= (mode === 'total' ? 2 : 1)" @click="add">加入示例图片</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!files.some((file) => ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status))" @click="submit"
        >准备并提交</mp-button
      >
      <mp-button :disabled="preparing === 0" @click="uploader.abort()">取消准备</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="preparing === 0" @click="finish">完成准备</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="reset">重置队列</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-upload
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :show-upload-button="false"
      :show-retry-button="false"
      :preview="false"
    />
    <p>待返回准备任务：{{ preparing }}</p>
    <p>请求次数：{{ requestCount }}</p>
    <p>队列状态：{{ files.map((file) => `${file.status} (${file.percent}%)`).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
    <p>队列字节：{{ files.map((file) => file.size).join(', ') || '0' }}</p>
    <p>拒绝原因：{{ reasons.join(', ') || '无' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

### 异步请求元数据

填写你控制的本地接收接口后，分别手动返回 headers 和 data，观察默认 XHR 的准备与取消。只返回一项时仍不发送；取消后再返回另一项不得启动请求。成功响应显示在示例下方，可由接收端核对 `X-Demo-Upload`、`auditMarker` 和 `attachment` 文件字段。接口地址默认留空，不预设外部上传服务；接收器必须允许文档站来源的 CORS。本例仅使用生成的合成文本，不选择真实文件。

使用“拒绝 headers / 拒绝 data”模拟准备失败，当前尝试只进入一次 error。可在另一项旧 Promise 未结清时重试，观察旧结果不会覆盖新尝试；取消后再拒绝不增加错误计数。返回/拒绝按钮会结清该类所有等待任务（包括旧尝试），便于验证竞争；重置会释放等待任务。准备失败不等同 HTTP 错误。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/metadata-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const endpoint = ref('')
const files = ref([])
const headers = shallowRef([])
const data = shallowRef([])
const successes = ref(0)
const errors = ref(0)
const response = ref(null)
let sequence = 0
function wait(queue, file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    queue.value = [...queue.value, { file, resolve, reject }]
  })
}
function finish(queue, kind) {
  const jobs = queue.value
  queue.value = []
  jobs.forEach((job) =>
    job.resolve(kind === 'headers' ? { 'X-Demo-Upload': job.file.name } : { auditMarker: 'audit-local' }),
  )
}
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  action: () => endpoint.value,
  headers: () => (file) => wait(headers, file),
  data: () => (file) => wait(data, file),
  name: () => 'attachment',
  autoUpload: () => false,
  resolveType: () => 'file',
  onSuccess: (file) => {
    successes.value++
    response.value = file.response
  },
  onError: () => {
    errors.value++
  },
})
function add() {
  return uploader.addFiles([
    new File(['Synthetic upload audit only.'], `metadata-${++sequence}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' }),
  ])
}
function cleanup() {
  uploader.abort()
  finish(headers, 'headers')
  finish(data, 'data')
}
function finishHeaders() {
  finish(headers, 'headers')
}
function finishData() {
  finish(data, 'data')
}
function rejectHeaders() {
  rejectPending(headers, 'headers')
}
function rejectData() {
  rejectPending(data, 'data')
}
function rejectPending(queue, kind) {
  const jobs = queue.value
  queue.value = []
  jobs.forEach((job) => job.reject(new Error(`Synthetic ${kind} rejection`)))
}
function reset() {
  cleanup()
  uploader.reset()
  successes.value = 0
  errors.value = 0
  response.value = null
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup)
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>
<template>
  <section class="metadata-upload-demo">
    <p>默认 XHR 请求；先配置你控制的本地接口。headers 与 data 分别等待手动返回，默认不访问任何地址。</p>
    <label
      >Local upload endpoint <mp-input v-model="endpoint" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="http://127.0.0.1:4197/upload"
    /></label>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button :disabled="files.length > 0" @click="add">加入合成文件</mp-button>
      <mp-button
        :disabled="!endpoint || !files.some((file) => ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status))"
        @click="uploader.submit()"
        >提交元数据请求</mp-button
      >
      <mp-button :disabled="!files.some((file) => file.status === 'uploading')" @click="uploader.abort()"
        >取消元数据请求</mp-button
      >
      <mp-button :disabled="!headers.length" @click="finishHeaders">返回 headers</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!data.length" @click="finishData">返回 data</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!headers.length" @click="rejectHeaders">拒绝 headers</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!data.length" @click="rejectData">拒绝 data</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="reset">重置元数据示例</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-upload
      v-model="files"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :show-upload-button="false"
      :show-retry-button="false"
      :preview="false"
    />
    <p role="status">
      headers 等待：{{ headers.length }}；data 等待：{{ data.length }}；成功：{{ successes }}；错误：{{ errors }}
    </p>
    <p>模型：{{ files.map((file) => file.name + ': ' + file.status).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
    <pre>{{ response }}</pre>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 请求句柄迟到与取消

本地模拟 custom-request 返回 Promise。取消后再返回旧句柄会立即调用其 abort；返回旧成功回调不会恢复已取消项。取消后再次发起、统一返回句柄和成功回调时，只接受当前尝试一次。计数展示回调是否被内核接受，不代表真实传输；本例不访问网络，重置/停用/卸载释放本地等待。

Example source: src/upload/example/demos/late-request.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import { useUploader } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const files = ref([])
const handles = shallowRef([])
const callbacks = shallowRef([])
const requests = ref(0)
const aborts = ref(0)
const accepted = ref(0)
let sequence = 0
let generation = 0
const uploader = useUploader({
  modelValue: () => files.value,
  onUpdateModelValue: (value) => {
    files.value = value
  },
  resolveType: () => 'file',
  autoUpload: () => false,
  customRequest: () => (options) => {
    const current = generation
    requests.value++
    callbacks.value = [...callbacks.value, options]
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      handles.value = [
        ...handles.value,
        {
          resolve: () =>
            resolve({
              abort: () => {
                if (current === generation) {
                  aborts.value++
                }
              },
            }),
        },
      ]
    })
  },
  onSuccess: () => {
    accepted.value++
  },
})
function add() {
  return uploader.addFiles([
    new File(['Local delayed transport; no network.'], `late-${++sequence}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' }),
  ])
}
function release() {
  const pending = handles.value
  handles.value = []
  pending.forEach((job) => job.resolve())
}
function complete() {
  const pending = callbacks.value
  callbacks.value = []
  pending.forEach((options) => options.onSuccess({ local: true }))
}
function cleanup() {
  generation++
  uploader.abort()
  release()
  callbacks.value = []
}
function reset() {
  cleanup()
  uploader.reset()
  requests.value = 0
  aborts.value = 0
  accepted.value = 0
}
onBeforeUnmount(cleanup)
onDeactivated(cleanup)
</script>

<template>
  <section class="late-upload-demo">
    <p>请求句柄延迟返回；先取消再返回句柄，旧句柄应立即 abort，迟到成功回调不能恢复取消项。不访问网络。</p>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button :disabled="files.length > 0" @click="add">加入本地文件</mp-button>
      <mp-button
        :disabled="!files.some((file) => ['ready', 'error', 'canceled'].includes(file.status))"
        @click="uploader.submit()"
        >发起模拟请求</mp-button
      >
      <mp-button :disabled="!files.some((file) => file.status === 'uploading')" @click="uploader.abort()"
        >取消模拟请求</mp-button
      >
      <mp-button :disabled="!handles.length" @click="release">返回所有句柄</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!callbacks.length" @click="complete">返回所有成功回调</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="reset">重置模拟</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-upload v-model="files" :show-upload-button="false" :show-retry-button="false" :preview="false" />
    <p role="status">
      句柄等待：{{ handles.length }}；发起：{{ requests }}；abort：{{ aborts }}；有效成功：{{ accepted }}
    </p>
    <p>模型：{{ files.map((file) => file.name + ': ' + file.status).join(', ') || '空' }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
```

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

附件确认提交的是文件列表关系，无法撤销已经发生的远程上传或永久删除；需要延迟网络副作用时配置 `auto-upload="false"`，由业务在最终提交后执行上传。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

### 覆盖已有附件与视频时长

`reupload` 默认 `false`。开启后，每个附件显示「替换」按钮；达到 `max-files` 后仍可替换已有项。也可调用 `replace(file, replacement?)`：未传 replacement 时选择一个文件，传入 `File` 时直接校验并提出替换。替换选择器不支持多选，且遵守 request-choose、disabled 与 readonly。

新文件先经过 before-add、before-read、accept、单文件/总大小与数量校验，再经过 before-remove。数量和总大小计算扣除被替换项。取消文件选择、校验失败、守卫拒绝或目标已被外部移除时保留原项。通过后以新 UID 原位替换并发出 `replace(next, previous)` 和 `change`，不发出 remove，也不请求删除服务器资源。受控父级决定是否接纳；接纳后旧上传回调失效。此后新上传失败会显示失败状态，可重试，不会自动恢复旧文件。

`UploadFileItem.duration?: number` 使用秒，有限且非负时显示为 `mm:ss` 或 `h:mm:ss`；0 显示 `00:00`，未知/无效值不显示。本地视频会尝试读取元数据（最多 5 秒），成功、错误、中止和卸载都会清理临时 URL、监听及定时器。远端回显记录可直接传 duration，不会为读时长主动请求远端视频。文本列表显示时长文字，图片布局显示角标。

| 新增入口                    | 类型 / 默认                                              |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| reupload                    | boolean / false                                          |
| replace(file, replacement?) | `Promise<void>`；方法，不代表远程上传已成功              |
| replace 事件                | next: UploadFileItem, previous: UploadFileItem；模型提案 |
| item 插槽 replace           | () => void；打开当前项替换选择器                         |
| duration                    | UploadFileItem 的可选秒数                                |

示例的完整表单使用 data-url 保留本地附件草稿，切换弹层时不依赖临时 object URL。生产上传成功后应由业务写入服务器 URL；object-url 的生命周期仍由创建它的组件与预览引用管理。


### 异步操作反馈

before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。不同文件保持并发，加载反馈汇总所有当前守卫任务，不把普通 change/progress 事件当成任务。

`useUploader()` 提供只读 `guardPending`，汇总当前 before 钩子的等待状态；它不代表文件上传进度。

### 准备否决与异常

`beforeUpload` 返回 `false` 或兑现为 `false` 属于业务否决：不发起请求，文件保持 `ready`，不触发 `error` 或 `rejected`。同步抛错或 Promise 拒绝属于准备异常：不发起请求，文件变为 `error`，通过已有 `error(item)` 事件报告一次，原始原因保存在 `item.error`。该事件覆盖准备和传输失败，并不代表已经发送 HTTP 请求。两种结果都允许后续以合法守卫结果重新提交；普通通知返回的 Promise 不延长准备任务，旧尝试或取消后的异常不得报告为新错误。
### 配置说明

两端公共后缀一致，所有默认值见下表（前缀分别为c/mp）。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### Upload Props

| 属性                                                         | 类型                                                     | 默认值/说明                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| model-value / default-value                                  | UploadFileItem[]                                         | 受控值 / 非受控初值[]                             |
| accept / capture                                             | `string / UploadCapture`<br>`UploadCapture: boolean \| 'user' \| 'environment' \| undefined` | 未指定                                            |
| multiple / directory / draggable                             | boolean                                                  | false                                             |
| disabled / readonly                                          | boolean                                                  | undefined，继承Form，显式false优先                |
| action / method                                              | string                                                   | 无 / post                                         |
| headers / data                                               | object 或 async(file) => object                          | 请求准备阶段仍可取消                              |
| name                                                         | string / (file) => string                                | file                                              |
| with-credentials                                             | boolean                                                  | false                                             |
| custom-request                                               | (UploadRequestOptions) => UploadRequest / Promise / void | 自定义transport，可返回abort                      |
| auto-upload                                                  | boolean                                                  | true；必须同时有action或custom-request才启动      |
| max-files / max-file-size / max-total-size                   | number                                                   | 未指定；大小单位字节，max-files>0生效             |
| resolve-type                                                 | file / data-url / object-url                             | object-url；所有文件生成url，图片生成thumbnailUrl |
| create-thumbnail-url                                         | (options) => string / Promise                            | 自定义URL归调用方所有，不自动回收                 |
| before-add                                                   | async(files) => File[]                                   | 批次筛选/替换                                     |
| before-read                                                  | async(file) => boolean / File                            | false/reject拒绝；替换后重新校验                  |
| before-upload                                                | async(item) => boolean / File / Blob                     | false 保留 ready；抛错/reject 进入 error；替换后重新校验              |
| before-remove                                                | async(item,list) => boolean                              | false/reject不删除                                |
| is-success-response                                          | (xhr,item) => boolean                                    | 默认HTTP2xx                                       |
| request-choose                                               | (chooseFile,event) => void / Promise                     | 接管选择入口，异常不会自动打开文件框              |
| list-type                                                    | text / picture / picture-card                            | text，两端均支持                                  |
| image-fit                                                    | fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down               | cover；item.fit优先                               |
| preview                                                      | boolean                                                  | true                                              |
| show-file-list / show-upload-button / show-remove-button     | boolean                                                  | true                                              |
| show-retry-button / show-cancel-button / show-preview-button | boolean                                                  | true                                              |
| show-download-button                                         | boolean                                                  | false；禁用时不可操作                             |
| elevation / ripple                                           | boolean或number / boolean                                | false / true                                      |

UploadFileItem 的 uid、status、percent 必填，name/size/type/file/url/thumbnailUrl/fit/response/error 可选。status为ready/reading/uploading/success/error/canceled/removed。

### Upload Events

- update:model-value(files)，change(files, changedFile?)：队列提议顺序，Form每次change仅一次。进度与状态更新也属于change。
- read(item)：读取完成，可自行接管业务上传；不是服务端成功。
- rejected(UploadRejectedFile[])：reason为accept/before-add/before-read/read-error/max-file-size/max-total-size/max-files。
- exceed(nativeFiles, acceptedList)：超过数量时通知。
- progress(item,event?)、success(item)、error(item)：当前有效请求通知；旧请求/取消回调不生效。
- remove(item)：通过删除钩子后的删除提议。
- preview(item, UploadPreviewEvent)：调用event.preventDefault()取消内建图片/视频预览；程序调用也可取消，originalEvent可选。

### Upload Slots

- trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled,describedBy})：自定义选择入口。

纯展示内容由外层提供按钮角色和 Enter/Space 入口；包含按钮、链接等交互内容时，外层不再增加按钮角色或 Tab 停靠点。自定义按钮应绑定插槽的 disabled，并负责自己的键盘行为。 需要将表单错误及 Upload 的 aria-describedby 关联到该按钮时，可将插槽的 describedBy 绑定到按钮的 aria-describedby；它随错误出现和清除更新。点击时直接调用 chooseFile 即可，无需 .stop；同次点击的冒泡不会再次选择，也不会额外调用 requestChoose。依赖默认冒泡的自定义按钮仍可使用 requestChoose。

```vue
<mp-upload aria-describedby="upload-hint">
  <template #trigger="{ chooseFile, disabled, describedBy }">
    <button type="button" :disabled="disabled" :aria-describedby="describedBy" @click="chooseFile">选择文件</button>
  </template>
</mp-upload>
<p id="upload-hint">请选择文件</p>
```

异步选择判断请使用 requestChoose，或先同步 event.preventDefault() 取消默认选择，再自行等待并调用 chooseFile；普通点击事件的 Promise 不会被收集。requestChoose 收到的选择回调每次操作至多执行一次，卸载或 KeepAlive 停用后的旧回调不会在重开时恢复。
- item({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace})：自定义整项。
- remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace})：自定义删除操作。
- read({value,text})：字段阅读内容；value 为文件模型或 null，text 为格式化文字，与读取完成的 read 事件不同。

### Upload Methods

提供 chooseFile()、replace(file,replacement?)、submit(file?)、abort(file?)、retry(file)、remove(file)、reset()、clearSuccess()、clearError()、getFiles(status?)、preview(file)、closePreview()。useUploader(options) 提供不含界面的上传逻辑，以及 addFiles(files) 和输入、拖放处理接口。

chooseFile、replace、submit、retry、remove 返回 `Promise<void>`，保留各自准备阶段的等待；submit/retry 等待准备钩子和请求工厂创建，不承诺网络传输结束，结果由 success/error 事件报告。chooseFile 的完成不表示用户已选完文件；remove 完成也不表示受控父级已接受删除提议。item/remove-button 的 remove、retry、replace 以及 trigger 的 chooseFile 保留相同 Promise 类型。

所有公开方法在编辑器首次挂载前即保持可调用。未挂载、已关闭或停用时，getFiles(status?) 返回已接受模型的浅拷贝快照并按状态筛选；异步修改命令以空操作完成，同步修改命令为空操作。需要执行时，先通过字段交互或受控 open 打开编辑器并等待挂载，或使用 editMode="direct"。保存的方法引用在关闭/重开后转发到当前实例，编辑器取消会保留已接受模型。

### 受控与生命周期

受控父级拒绝新增时只发读取与列表提议，不自动上传；后续父级接受该uid才会自动上传一次。同tick提议事务合并，跨tick仍以实际父级列表为真源，拒绝项目不占总大小；父级负责迟到列表替换的一致性。显式remove未接受项、reset或卸载会释放其生成URL；任意外部URL不会被回收。内建预览保留自己的URL使用权至关闭，不关闭其他组件后来打开的预览。

取消覆盖before-upload、异步headers/data/name及异步custom-request句柄阶段；重试和外部同uid换File令旧回调失效。before-read和before-upload的替换会复查限制，max-total-size只累计已接受项及当前正在准备的合法批次/请求。禁用/只读禁止选择、移除、提交等更改；只读允许预览/下载。KeepAlive停用取消当前准备/请求，恢复后允许新操作。

## Types

UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。

# 总览 Utilities

### 介绍

Maple / Cedar 语义与结构一致，**类名必须带库前缀**（`mp-` / `c-`），变量分别为 `--mp-*` / `--c-*`，避免混用撞名。  
不做无前缀别名，不做向后兼容。

| | Maple | Cedar |
|---|---|---|
| 类名 | `mp-text-1`、`mp-mt-16` | `c-text-1`、`c-mt-16` |
| 形态 | 独立 Utilities + Uno/TW preset | 固定 Utilities + Uno/TW preset |
| Token | `--mp-*` | `--c-*` |

### 引入

```js
// playground-ignore
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/utilities/style'
```

需已加载主题变量（`style/theme/css-variables`）。

### 分册

| 页面 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [颜色 Color](#/zh-CN/color) | 功能色、文字 / 填充 / 边框 / 背景层级 |
| [常用写法](#/zh-CN/atomic-usage) | Flex / 间距 / 尺寸 / 溢出 / 圆角等日常原子类 |
| [海拔 Elevation](#/zh-CN/styles) | `mp-elevation--0` … `--24` |
| [字体排版 Typography](#/zh-CN/typography) | Cedar 有完整包；Maple 用 token / 原子化 |
| [原子化 CSS](#/zh-CN/atomic-css) | Uno / TW 安装与配置 |
| [Utility 规范](#/zh-CN/utilitySpec) | 两端共用约定 |

色阶变量见 [色板 Palette](#/zh-CN/palette)，不进默认工具包。左侧预览为总览快照。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

Example source: src/utilities/example/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onThemeChange } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

onThemeChange()

const statusColors = ['primary', 'success', 'warning', 'danger', 'info']
const textLevels = [1, 2, 3, 4]
const spaceSamples = [
  { cls: 'mp-mt-16 mp-px-8', label: 'mp-mt-16 mp-px-8' },
  { cls: 'mp-p-16', label: 'mp-p-16' },
  { cls: 'mp-mx-24 mp-my-8', label: 'mp-mx-24 mp-my-8' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <div class="utilities-demo mp-px-16 mp-py-16">

        :key="name"
        class="mp-px-8 mp-py-4 mp-rounded-sm"
        :class="[`mp-${name}`, `mp-bg-${name}`]"
      >
        mp-{{ name }}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mp-flex mp-flex-wrap mp-mt-16" style="gap: 8px">
      <div v-for="n in textLevels" :key="`t-${n}`" :class="`mp-text-${n}`">mp-text-{{ n }}</div>
    </div>

        mp-fill-{{ n }}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mp-flex mp-flex-wrap mp-mt-8" style="gap: 8px">
      <div
        v-for="n in [0, 1, 2]"
        :key="`bg-${n}`"
        class="mp-px-8 mp-py-4 mp-rounded-sm mp-border-2"
        :class="`mp-bg-${n}`"
        style="border-width: 1px; border-style: solid"
      >
        mp-bg-{{ n }}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mp-text-1 mp-mt-24 mp-mb-8">Spacing</div>
    <div class="mp-fill-2 mp-rounded-md mp-p-8">
      <div v-for="item in spaceSamples" :key="item.label" class="mp-bg-primary mp-rounded-sm" :class="item.cls">

      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mp-text-1 mp-mt-24 mp-mb-8">Flex</div>
    <div class="mp-flex mp-flex-row mp-justify-between mp-items-center mp-fill-1 mp-rounded-md mp-px-16 mp-py-8">
      <span class="mp-text-1">start</span>
      <span class="mp-text-3">space-between</span>
      <span class="mp-primary">end</span>
    </div>

    <div class="mp-text-1 mp-mt-24 mp-mb-8">Rounded</div>
    <div class="mp-flex mp-flex-col" style="gap: 12px">
      <div class="mp-bg-1 mp-rounded-sm mp-px-16 mp-py-8">mp-rounded-sm</div>
      <div class="mp-bg-1 mp-rounded-md mp-px-16 mp-py-8">mp-rounded-md</div>
      <div class="mp-bg-1 mp-rounded-lg mp-px-16 mp-py-8">mp-rounded-lg</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style lang="less">
@import '../../style/theme/css-variables.less';
@import '../style/utilities.less';
</style>
```

# Utility 工具类规范

### 介绍

Cedar / Maple 共用同一套语义与结构；类名与变量均带库前缀，避免混用撞名。

| | Cedar | Maple |
|---|---|---|
| 类名前缀 | `c-`（如 `c-text-1`、`c-mt-16`） | `mp-`（如 `mp-text-1`、`mp-mt-16`） |
| CSS 变量 | `--c-*` | `--mp-*` |
| 形态 | `style/tools.less` | 独立 `utilities` + Uno/TW preset |

**不做无前缀别名，不做向后兼容。**

### 标准集合（两端一致）

- **Color**：功能色、文字 / 填充 / 边框 / 背景层级
- **Spacing / Size**：仅由 Uno / Tailwind preset 生成具体数值类，如 `mp-mt-16`、`mp-h-10`、`mp-w-full`。日常分类见 [常用写法](#/zh-CN/atomic-usage)。
- **Rounded / Shadow / Flex / Display / Position / Overflow**：溢出与省略由原子化生成，如 `mp-overflow-hidden`、`mp-truncate`、`mp-line-clamp-2`
- **Elevation**：`{p}-elevation--0` … `--24`（Maple 独立 CSS；Cedar 随 box-shadow 工具层）

### 平台差异（目录保留、能力不同）

| 项 | Cedar | Maple |
|---|---|---|
| Typography 工具包 | 有（PC 扩展） | 无（用 token / 原子化） |
| 原子化 CSS preset | `@cedar-design/preset-unocss-vue` / `@cedar-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue` | `@maple-design/preset-unocss-vue` / `@maple-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue` |

### 禁止

- 无前缀工具类与无前缀变量
- 固定 Utilities 内重复实现间距原子、完整色板原子类
- Maple 将 utilities 再打进全量组件 CSS

## 外观与状态

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置            | 作用                            | 相关示例                     |
| --------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `default-value` | `非受控初值`                    | 变体与掩码、只读、禁用和错误 |
| `length`        | `正整数格数（按 Unicode 码点）` | 变体与掩码、外观组合         |
| `aria-label`    | `组名和每格的序号名称`          | 变体与掩码、只读、禁用和错误 |
| `masked`        | `仅视觉隐藏字符，不是加密`      | 变体与掩码                   |
| `mask-symbol`   | `取首个 Unicode 码点`           | 变体与掩码                   |
| `variant`       | `输入外观`                      | 变体与掩码                   |

### 外观组合

适用于分格验证码输入。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。

Example source: src/verification-code/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('123456')
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'filled', size: 'md' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['filled', 'outline', 'standard'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'filled', value: 'filled' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'standard', value: 'standard' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'xs', value: 'xs' },
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
            { label: 'lg', value: 'lg' },
            { label: 'xl', value: 'xl' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">
      <span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span
      ><span lang="en-US"
        >Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same
        value.</span
      >
    </p>
    <mp-radio-group
      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      aria-label="Compare configuration"
      :options="demoCompareFields.map((field) => ({ label: field.name, value: field.name }))"
    />
    <div class="demo-config-comparison">
      <section v-for="sample in demoComparedOptions" :key="String(sample)">
        <p>
          <code>{{ demoCompareAxis }}={{ sample }}</code>
        </p>
        <mp-verification-code
          v-model="value"
          :length="6"
          v-bind="{ ...__demoAppearance, [demoCompareAxis]: sample }"
        ></mp-verification-code>
      </section>
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo-config-comparison {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

  min-width: 0;
```

## 数据与选项

### 粘贴、格式化和分隔符

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置              | 作用                                                                      | 相关示例             |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `type`            | `字符集合`                                                                | 粘贴、格式化和分隔符 |
| `paste-transform` | `粘贴预处理，先于 type 与 formatter`                                      | 粘贴、格式化和分隔符 |
| `formatter`       | `逐字符格式化，false 拒绝，true/undefined 保持；返回字符串取首个合法码点` | 粘贴、格式化和分隔符 |
| `aria-label`      | `组名和每格的序号名称`                                                    | 粘贴、格式化和分隔符 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/verification-code/example/demos/formatting.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const code = ref('')
const transform = (value) => value.replace(/[-\s]/g, '').toUpperCase()
</script>
<template>
  <div class="verification-demo">
    <p>可粘贴 ab-12-cd；从当前格开始写入。</p>
    <mp-verification-code
      v-model="code"
      type="alphanumeric"
      :paste-transform="transform"
      :formatter="(char) => char.toUpperCase()"
      aria-label="字母数字验证码"
      ><template #separator="{ index }"><span v-if="index === 2">−</span></template></mp-verification-code
    >
    <p>{{ code }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.verification-demo {
  max-width: 420px;
}
</style>
```

## 交互与控制

### 交互状态切换

适用于分格验证码输入。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。

Example source: src/verification-code/example/demos/state-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('123456')
const __demoState = __demoReactive({ disabled: false, readonly: false, error: false })
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="__demoState['disabled']">disabled</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="__demoState['readonly']">readonly</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="__demoState['error']">error</mp-checkbox>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-verification-code v-model="value" :length="6" v-bind="__demoState"></mp-verification-code>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。验证码是 LTR 内容区域，按原字符串顺序展示、粘贴和移动焦点；外围 align 的 start/end 仍随阅读方向。RTL 不会将验证码字符倒序，数字与文字验证码使用相同的顺序契约。

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。
### 配置说明

initial 表示未指定公开覆盖，实际 CSS 在组件元素处读取尺寸 fallback；可直接在组件 style 或主题中覆盖。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

显式 null 是受控空码，不回退到 default-value；默认值仅用于未提供 model-value 的初始状态。reset() 仍提议空字符串；展示层清空可通过 empty-value=null 提交 null，不会让 finish 收到 null。未设置 model-value 时仍为非受控整码。

延迟模式的 input / paste 仍表示编辑过程；finish 表示最终接受的完整值，取消、拒绝、只读、禁用、外部替换及卸载会丢弃未接受的完成通知。普通 finish 监听返回的 Promise 不参与确认等待。before-commit 同步返回 undefined 时等待 done。type / align 非法值诊断后分别按 digit / center 处理；gutter=0 和 0px 均有效。

### VerificationCode Props

| 属性                                    | 说明                                                                      | 类型                                            | 默认值           |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `model-value`                           | `受控整码`                                                                | `string \| null`                                        | `undefined`      |
| `default-value`                         | `非受控初值`                                                              | `string`                                        | `''`             |
| `length`                                | `正整数格数（按 Unicode 码点）`                                           | `number`                                        | `6`              |
| `type`                                  | `字符集合`                                                                | `digit / text / alphanumeric`                   | `digit`          |
| `size`                                  | `五档外壳尺寸`                                                            | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl`                        | `继承 / md`      |
| `variant`                               | `输入外观`                                                                | `filled / outline / standard`                   | `继承 / outline` |
| `disabled / readonly / error`           | `状态，显式值优先于 Form`                                                 | `boolean`                                       | `undefined`      |
| `masked`                                | `仅视觉隐藏字符，不是加密`                                                | `boolean`                                       | `false`          |
| `mask-symbol`                           | `取首个 Unicode 码点`                                                     | `string`                                        | `•`              |
| `autofocus`                             | `挂载后聚焦首个空格`                                                      | `boolean`                                       | `false`          |
| `gutter`                                | `格间距，number 为 px`                                                    | `number / string`                               | `组件 token`     |
| `align`                                 | `水平对齐`                                                                | `start / center / end`                          | `center`         |
| `allow-paste`                           | `是否允许粘贴，false 阻止原生粘贴`                                        | `boolean`                                       | `true`           |
| `paste-transform`                       | `粘贴预处理，先于 type 与 formatter`                                      | `(text: string) => string`                      | `undefined`      |
| `formatter`                             | `逐字符格式化，false 拒绝，true/undefined 保持；返回字符串取首个合法码点` | `(character, index, value) => string / boolean` | `undefined`      |
| `separator`                             | `非最后格后面的分隔内容`                                                  | `(index, character) => VNodeChild`              | `undefined`      |
| `aria-label`                            | `组名和每格的序号名称`                                                    | `string`                                        | `undefined`      |
| `text-color / focus-color / blur-color` | `逐实例动态颜色，静态主题优先 token`                                      | `string`                                        | `undefined`      |

| `empty-value` | 展示层清空输出，默认空字符串，可显式配置 null | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `''` |
| `clearable` | 延迟编辑层清空操作，不改变每格输入 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `empty-values` | 空值识别策略，字段优先于 FormItem 和 Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| `empty-text` | 阅读空文案，显式空字符串有效 | `string` | `'-'` |
| `edit-mode` | 编辑模式，继承 FormItem 和 Form | `'direct' \| 'popup'` | `'direct'` |
| `read-pretty` | 独立阅读状态，显式 false 覆盖父级 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `before-commit` | 延迟编辑保存前守卫；返回布尔值、Promise 或通过 done 完成 | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| `open` | 受控编辑层开关，不是内部原生输入焦点 | `boolean` | `-` |
| `default-open` | 非受控编辑层初始开关 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `popup-container` | 编辑层挂载容器 | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### VerificationCode Events

| 事件               | 参数                    | 语义                                                                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input              | character, index, event | 每次有效原生输入提议的起始字符与零基索引                               |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null                   | 整码提议                                                               |
| change             | value: string \| null    | 每次有效编辑的整码提议，不等同于受控父级接受                           |
| finish | value: string | direct 在父级本轮接受完整值后通知；延迟模式在确认守卫通过且父级接受后通知，草稿满码不通知 |
| update:open | open: boolean | 编辑层受控开关更新 |
| open-change | open: boolean | 编辑层实际开关变化 |
| paste              | text, event             | 经 paste-transform 与 type 处理的粘贴文本                              |
| focus / blur       | FocusEvent              | 进入/离开整个组件，格间切换不重复通知                                  |
| click              | MouseEvent              | 非禁用点击                                                             |

有效输入顺序是 input → update:modelValue → change，父级在本轮渲染接受完整值后才发 finish。拒绝的受控值会恢复原生输入；若父级异步接受，后续单独的模型赋值不会补发 finish。reset() 提议空值，发 update:modelValue / change，不模拟原生 input。禁用、只读及组合输入时 reset 不修改值。

粘贴从当前格开始覆盖，根元素的粘贴从第 1 格开始；超出首个空格的输入会归到首个空格。收到一次整码原生输入时会分配到后续格；是否显示短信建议由平台和浏览器决定，Cedar 首格提供 one-time-code 提示，Maple 保留所有格 autocomplete=off 的既有策略。已填格中单字符键入总是替换当前格，即使光标位于旧字符末尾；输入法优先使用本次 compositionend 提交文本（支持多码点分配），事件缺失提交文本时才回退原生值。type 过滤 → formatter → 长度裁剪，拒绝字符不占格。text 按 Unicode 码点（不是字素簇）计数。修改外部值只影响显示，不自动格式化写回。

### VerificationCode Slots

| 插槽      | 参数                 | 说明                                      |
| --------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| separator | { index, character } | 优先于 separator Prop；不在最后一格后渲染 |
| read | { value: string \| null, text: string } | 自定义阅读内容，优先于 empty-text |

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?)：零基索引；省略时定位首个空格，满码定位末格。direct 只读时可聚焦；延迟模式下先打开允许编辑的面板，禁用、只读或纯阅读时不打开。
- blur()：使当前编辑器失焦，不重新打开面板。
- reset()：direct 模式提议清空，遵守受控模型及禁用/只读/组合输入限制；延迟模式先打开并清空草稿，最终确认及 before-commit 通过前不发模型更新或 change，取消则保留原值。

公开方法从组件首次挂载起保持可调用；保存下来的方法每次查找当前编辑器，关闭、重开、切换模式后不会操作旧输入。尚未挂载或已经关闭的原生输入引用为 undefined。

### 键盘与表单

左右方向键切换格；Backspace 删除当前字符，空格时删除前一个；Delete 删除当前字符；删除后后续字符前移。IME 组合期间不裁剪、不删除、不跳焦。每个原生 input 有独立 SSR 稳定 id，所有输入格统一使用 autocomplete=off。请提供 aria-label。

调用方提供的 `aria-invalid` 会传给每个输入框；组件或表单错误优先标记输入框为无效，错误清除后恢复调用方的值。组元素保留调用方显式属性，不自动增加错误状态。

继承 InputGroup/Form 状态，显式 disabled/readonly/error/size 优先；内部每格 Input 不重复通知 Form，整体每次编辑仅通知一次 input/change。三种 variant 和五档 size 两端均实现；尺寸来自本库 FieldDecorator token。

## Types

VerificationCodeProps、VerificationCodeType、VerificationCodeAlign、VerificationCodeVariant、VerificationCodeFormatter、VerificationCodeSeparator、VerificationCodeEmits、VerificationCodeSlots、VerificationCodeExpose、VerificationCodeInstance。

# 水印

给页面或局部区域添加文字、图片水印。组件会自动响应属性和主题变化，无需手动刷新。

## 基础示例

### 文字水印

示例支持切换深浅背景、显示状态和水印文字；font.color 在深色底使用半透明白色，在浅色底使用半透明黑色。修改文字或颜色会重新生成水印。水印不拦截指针操作，内容按钮支持点击和 Enter；隐藏后重新显示只保留一层水印。

Example source: src/watermark/example/demos/text-watermark.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const dark = ref(false)
const shown = ref(true)
const content = ref('LOCAL DEMO 200')
const clicks = ref(0)
</script>

<template>
  <section class="watermark-contrast-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="dark" edit-mode="direct">Dark surface / 深色底</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="shown" edit-mode="direct">Show watermark / 显示水印</mp-checkbox>
    <label>Watermark text / 水印文字<mp-input v-model="content" edit-mode="direct" /></label>
    <mp-watermark
      v-if="shown"
      :content="content"
      :font="{ color: dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)' }"
      :style="{ background: dark ? '#1f2937' : '#ffffff', color: dark ? '#ffffff' : '#111827' }"
    >
      <div class="watermark-contrast-surface">
        <p>Local synthetic content / 本地合成内容</p>
        <mp-button html-type="button" @click="clicks++">Click through / 点击内容</mp-button>
      </div>
    </mp-watermark>
    <p role="status">Visible: {{ shown }} · Dark: {{ dark }} · Clicks: {{ clicks }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.watermark-contrast-surface {
  min-height: 240px;
  display: grid;
  place-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
</style>
```

## 内容与展示

### 多行文本

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | 单行或多行文字；图片加载失败时作为回退内容 | 多行文本、图片水印、全屏 |
| `image` | 图片地址，优先于文字 | 图片水印 |
| `width` | 单块水印宽度，默认按内容测量 | 图片水印 |
| `height` | 单块水印高度，默认按内容测量 | 图片水印 |
| `font` | 文字样式 | 图片水印 |
| `fullscreen` | 是否固定覆盖整个视口 | 全屏 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

Example source: src/watermark/example/demos/multiline.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-watermark :content="['Maple Design', 'Confidential']">
    <div class="watermark-wrapper"></div>
  </mp-watermark>
</template>

<style scoped>
.watermark-wrapper {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
}
</style>
```

### 图片水印

“本地图片失败”使用无效的 data URL，触发 source=image 错误通知并回退为 FALLBACK 201 文字。按 Enter 激活“恢复图片”后恢复原图，错误记录保留，水印层仍只有一层。

Example source: src/watermark/example/demos/image-watermark.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const failed = ref(false)
const errors = ref([])
const localImage =
  'data:image/svg+xml,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="48"><rect width="160" height="48" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/><circle cx="80" cy="24" r="14" fill="white"/></svg>',
  )
const image = computed(() => (failed.value ? 'data:image/png;base64,invalid-local-image' : localImage))
</script>
<template>
  <section class="watermark-image-failure-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="failed" edit-mode="direct">Fail local image / 本地图片失败</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-button html-type="button" :disabled="!failed" @click="failed = false">Restore image / 恢复图片</mp-button>
    <mp-watermark
      content="FALLBACK 201"
      :image="image"
      :width="160"
      :height="48"
      :font="{ color: '#be123c' }"
      style="background: white"
      @error="errors.push($event.source)"
    >
      <div style="height: 240px" />
    </mp-watermark>
    <p role="status">Mode: {{ failed ? 'failure' : 'image' }} · Errors: {{ errors.join(',') || '-' }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
```

### 全屏

全屏水印固定覆盖视口，不拦截指针操作；退出后回到局部容器，默认插槽内容保持原位。重复切换不会累积水印层，卸载会移除该实例的水印。

Example source: src/watermark/example/demos/fullscreen.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const fullscreen = ref(false)
const toggle = () => {
  fullscreen.value = !fullscreen.value
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-watermark content="Maple UI" :fullscreen="fullscreen" :z-index="99" :offset="[10, 10]">
    <div class="watermark-wrapper">
      <mp-button status="primary" @click="toggle">切换</mp-button>
    </div>
  </mp-watermark>
</template>

<style scoped>
.watermark-wrapper {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
}
</style>
```

### 水印间距、偏移与旋转

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |

## 使用说明

### 尺寸与重绘

- `gap` 和 `offset` 应为包含两个有限数的数组；建议 `gap` 非负。当前负间距仅在计算平铺尺寸时按 0 处理，绘制和背景偏移仍使用原值，因此不要依赖负间距实现重叠。`width`、`height` 和 `font.fontSize`、`font.lineHeight` 应为有限正数；宽高实际至少为 1。`rotate` 应为有限角度，`zIndex` 应为有限数。非法输入不保证自动纠正；`alpha` 的合法范围为有限的 0 到 1。
- `lineHeight` 未指定时为 `Math.round(fontSize * 1.4)`。文字颜色由 Canvas 解析：优先使用 `font.color`，否则使用计算后的颜色变量；应传 Canvas 支持的颜色值，不保证直接解析 CSS 变量表达式。异步字体就绪后不会自动重绘，可调用 `redraw()`。
- 图片加载失败通过 `error` 通知；有文字时尝试回退文字，Canvas 失败也通过 `error` 通知。`redraw()` 返回 Promise，正常情况下内部渲染失败会被处理；较早的异步结果在属性更新或卸载后不会覆盖最新图层或再报告错误，但底层图片请求不会因此取消。`default` 内容不会被绘入水印图片。

## API

### Watermark Props

| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | 单行或多行文字；图片加载失败时作为回退内容 | `string \| string[]` | `-` |
| `image` | 图片地址，优先于文字 | `string` | `-` |
| `width` | 单块水印宽度，默认按内容测量 | `number` | `-` |
| `height` | 单块水印高度，默认按内容测量 | `number` | `-` |
| `gap` | 水印间距 `[x, y]` | `[number, number]` | `[90, 90]` |
| `offset` | 第一块水印相对容器的偏移，默认是间距的一半 | `[number, number]` | `[gap[0] / 2, gap[1] / 2]` |
| `rotate` | 旋转角度 | `number` | `-22` |
| `font` | 文字样式 | `WatermarkFont` | `-` |
| `z-index` | 水印层级 | `number` | `6` |
| `alpha` | 整体透明度，范围为 `0..1` | `number` | `1` |
| `anti-tamper` | 水印节点被移除或修改后是否恢复 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `grayscale` | 是否灰阶渲染 | `boolean` | `false` |
| `repeat` | 是否重复水印 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `staggered` | 重复时是否错列 | `boolean` | `true` |
| `fullscreen` | 是否固定覆盖整个视口 | `boolean` | `false` |

### WatermarkFont Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | 图片加载或 Canvas 渲染失败 | `{ source: 'image' \| 'canvas'; error: unknown }` |

### WatermarkFont Methods

| 方法名 | 说明 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `redraw` | 按当前属性重新生成水印 | `Promise<void>` |

### WatermarkFont Slots

| 插槽名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | 被水印覆盖的页面内容 |

## Types

### WatermarkFont

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `string` | `var(--mp-watermark-content-color)` |
| `fontSize` | `number` | `16` |
| `fontFamily` | `string` | `sans-serif` |
| `fontStyle` | `'normal' \| 'italic' \| 'oblique'` | `normal` |
| `fontWeight` | `string \| number` | `normal` |
| `textAlign` | `CanvasTextAlign`<br>`'center' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'start'` | `center` |
| `lineHeight` | `number` | `Math.round(fontSize × 1.4)` |

## CSS Variables

水印颜色取自组件计算后的 CSS 变量；组件及其当前祖先的 `class` 或 `style` 改变导致颜色变化时会自动重绘。通过 CSSOM、媒体查询等无法观察到的变化，以及移动到新祖先后，可调用 `redraw()` 更新。`anti-tamper` 仅恢复受管水印层的移除及 class/style 修改，不能作为安全防护。

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

通过以下变量定制组件外观。默认值随表中注明的主题或选择器条件变化；变量仅在对应的尺寸、变体和交互状态下生效。

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| 变量 | 默认值／条件 | 影响的样式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-watermark-content-color` | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)` | 组件样式 |

</div>

将覆盖设置在组件实际根节点或弹层真实挂载祖先上。例如给该元素添加下列 class，再按需替换变量值：

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-watermark-content-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
```

显式行内样式及直接写入同一 CSS 属性的 Props 优先于样式表默认值。Teleport 后，普通 CSS 变量按实际挂载位置继承；使用 ThemeProvider 时，请遵循其局部主题与弹层配置规则。局部定制请直接覆盖组件变量；仅修改后代的 system 变量不会重新计算从根继承的组件别名。内部变量不属于公共 API。

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

# Zod 验证

### 介绍

我们在 `3.5.0+` 支持了基于 [Zod](https://zod.dev/) 的表单验证方式，`Zod` 是一个非常强大的数据验证工具，并且对 `Typescript` 十分友好。

### 安装 Zod

为了控制组件库的尺寸，我们不内置 `Zod`，所以需要手动安装。

```shell
# npm
npm i zod -S   

# yarn
yarn add zod    

# pnpm
pnpm add zod
```

### 基本使用

`FormItem` 的 `rules` 属性支持传入一个或多个 `Zod Schema`。
组件将使用该 `Schema` 的规则进行验证，验证失败时将使用其定义的错误信息作为用户提示。

```html
<script setup>
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'
import { z } from 'zod'

const form = ref(null)
const user = reactive({
  name: '',
  email: '',
  password: '',
  repeatPassword: ''
})

function handleSubmit(valid) {
  console.log(valid)
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-form ref="form" :model="user" @submit="handleSubmit">
    <mp-space direction="column" size="lg">
      <mp-form-item field="name" :rules="z.string().min(1, '名称不能为空')">
        <mp-input placeholder="名称" v-model="user.name" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="email" :rules="z.string().email('邮箱格式有误')">
        <mp-input placeholder="邮箱" v-model="user.email" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="password" :rules="z.string().min(6, '密码最少6位')">
        <mp-input type="password" placeholder="密码" v-model="user.password" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item
        field="repeatPassword"
        :rules="[z.string().min(6, '密码最少6位'), (v) => v === user.password || '与密码不一致']"
      >
        <mp-input type="password" placeholder="确认密码" v-model="user.repeatPassword" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-button status="primary" native-type="submit">提交</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
  </mp-form>
</template>
```

<!-- Source: src/action-sheet/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/action-sheet -->

# ActionSheet

### Intro

An action sheet pops up to give the user the ability to select options.
`ActionSheet` supports service and component calls. The service uses a separate application and mounts to body; the component uses its host application context and `popup-container`.
The function returns a `Promise`, on selection return `action`. Click modal close to return `close`.

## Basic examples

### Function Call

Example source: src/action-sheet/example/demos/function-call.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'
import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const rawActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
  },
]
const rawDisabledActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    disabled: true,
  },
]
const rawCustomStyleActions = [
  {
    name: 'Item 01',
    icon: 'user-circle-fill',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-success)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 02',
    icon: 'notebook',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-warning)',
  },
  {
    name: 'Item 03',
    icon: 'wifi',
    color: 'var(--mp-color-info)',
  },
]
const actions = reactive(rawActions)
async function createBasic() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({ actions: rawActions })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function modifyTitle() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawActions,
    title: '选择一个你喜欢的吧',
  })
  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function disableAction() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawDisabledActions,
  })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
async function customActionStyles() {
  const action = await ActionSheet({
    actions: rawCustomStyleActions,
  })

  action !== 'close' && Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`)
}
function disableCloseOnClickAction() {
  ActionSheet({
    actions: [
      {
        name: 'Item 01',
        icon: 'user-circle-fill',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 02',
        icon: 'notebook',
      },
      {
        name: 'Item 03',
        icon: 'wifi',
      },
    ],
    closeOnClickAction: false,
    onSelect: (action) => Message(`${'您选择的是:'}${action.name}`),
  })
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">基本使用</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="modifyTitle">修改标题</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="disableAction">禁用选项</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="disableCloseOnClickAction">禁用点击选项时关闭动作面板 </mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="customActionStyles">自定义选项样式</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Disabled options

Set `disabled` on options to disable them.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  async function handleSelect() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
          disabled: true,
        },
      ],

  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="handleSelect">Disabled options</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Keep actions open after selection

`closeOnClickAction` prevents `ActionSheet` from closing automatically on selection, allowing repeated choices.
Since a `Promise` resolves only once, use `onSelect` to observe repeated user choices.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  async function handleSelect() {
    await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
      closeOnClickAction: false,
      onSelect: (action) => Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`),
    })
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="handleSelect">Keep actions open</mp-button>
</template>
```

## Keyboard and dialog name

Default actions use native buttons; disabled actions cannot be focused or selected. The title or title slot names the dialog, unless an explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` overrides it. The visible cancel button requests closure through the close guard.

## Controlled state

When an action is selected, `close-on-click-action` requests an `open` update. A controlled parent that keeps `open=true` keeps the sheet `open`. Without `open`, `default-open` initializes internal state.

## Usage notes

### Closing from the title dropdown

`swipe-to-close` defaults to false. When enabled, the header can be dragged down to close; `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 CSS px. Custom title slots use the surrounding header handle. Body options and header buttons do not initiate dragging. See Popup for gesture details.
`before-close` forwards to Popup. Overlay, Esc, route, dropdown and post-action `open` changes may be rejected asynchronously. Exceptions emit `close-error(error, reason)`. An action `select` event does not mean closing was approved.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

## Close guards

The guard signature is `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`.

Return true/false or `Promise<boolean>`; a normally resolved async void result allows closing. Call done() to allow or done(false) to reject; synchronous void waits for done. The first result wins. Pending requests are deduplicated; errors retain the sheet and restore temporary button state. The third context argument supplies `signal` and the optional original `event`. Closing, unmounting or replacing the hook invalidates stale results.

Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons are overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api and model. Rejecting an external open=false requests update:open(true). The component does not expose `requestClose()`; use an existing guarded close entry. Direct destruction does not wait for the hook.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.
`ActionSheet.close()` requests closing and respects `beforeClose`. A veto retains the service owner so closing can be requested again. A new programmatic invocation replaces the previous singleton: it disposes the previous host and settles its result as `close`, without waiting for that `close` guard or synthesizing lifecycle notifications.

### Disabled, CSS mode and manual update

Example source: src/affix/example/demos/controls.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue'

const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement>()
const affixRef = ref<{ updatePosition: () => Promise<void> }>()
const disabled = ref(false)
const cssMode = ref(false)
const spacerHeight = ref(40)
const updates = ref(0)
async function updateLayout() {
  spacerHeight.value = spacerHeight.value === 40 ? 100 : 40
  await nextTick()
  await affixRef.value?.updatePosition()
  updates.value++
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap size="12px" style="margin-bottom: 12px">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="disabled">Disabled</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="cssMode">CSS sticky</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-button @click="updateLayout">Change layout and update position</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <p aria-live="polite">Position updates: {{ updates }}</p>
  <div ref="containerRef" class="scroller">
    <div class="scroll-content">
      <div :style="{ height: `${spacerHeight}px` }"></div>
      <mp-affix
        ref="affixRef"
        :target="containerRef"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :css-mode="cssMode"
        :offset-top="12"
        :z-index="2"
      >
        <mp-button status="primary">Scroll to pin</mp-button>
      </mp-affix>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.scroller {
  height: 200px;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
}
.scroll-content {
  min-height: 600px;
  padding: 16px;
}
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
### Affix Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| offset-top | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | `number / string` | `0` |
| offset-bottom | Distance from the bottom; takes precedence over offset-top, including 0 | `number / string` | `undefined` |
| target | Scroller or selector; finds nearest scrolling ancestor when omitted, falling back to window | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| target-container | Extra outer scroller to listen to; omitted means no extra listener, and it is not a clipping boundary | `string / HTMLElement / Window` | `undefined` |
| z-index | Stacking level | `number / string` | `10` |
| disabled | Disable affixing | `boolean` | `false` |
| css-mode | Use native position: sticky, subject to ancestor overflow and container boundaries | `boolean` | `false` |

### Affix Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| change | `(fixed: boolean, offset: number)`, emitted when the fixed state changes. While fixed, offset is the affix threshold; otherwise it is the distance to the corresponding container edge. Disabling affixing reports 0. |

### Affix Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Content to affix | — |

### Affix Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| updatePosition | Rebind scrollers and recalculate on the next animation frame | — | `Promise<void>` |

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments, slots and public methods match across platforms. CSS mode follows browser sticky rules; examples use independent scroll containers.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

`change` only reports transitions in fixed state: repeated measurements while fixed do not repeat true, and disabling releases fixation with false and 0. Viewport units are reevaluated on measurement. CSS mode delegates valid lengths to native sticky; JS mode resolves numbers, numeric strings, px, rem, vw, vh, vmin and vmax. target controls listeners and JS measurement, while native sticky remains constrained by actual CSS ancestors. After deactivation, a pending `updatePosition()` cannot restore listeners from an older activation.


### Imports and event types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

```ts
import Affix, { Affix as NamedAffix } from '@maple-design/ui-vue/affix'
import { Affix as RootAffix } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import type { AffixProps, AffixInstance } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import type { AffixProps as SubAffixProps } from '@maple-design/ui-vue/affix'
const options: AffixProps = { onChange: (fixed: boolean, offset: number) => fixed && offset.toFixed() }
```


### Units and diagnostics

JS mode parses only finite numbers, decimal/scientific numeric strings, and px, rem, vw, vh, vmin or vmax, including negative offsets. Unsupported JS lengths such as em, %, calc() and var() warn in development and measure as zero instead of treating a numeric prefix as pixels. CSS mode delegates to native sticky, converting numeric strings to px and leaving other valid CSS expressions to the browser. NaN/Infinity/blank values receive Vue prop validation warnings. Invalid CSS offsets are removed and JS measurement falls back to zero. target changes listeners and JS measurement, not the actual native sticky scroll ancestor or clipping boundary.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

# Alert

### Intro

Alerts display brief messages for the user without interrupting their use.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

```vue
<template>
  <mp-alert message="这是一条提示信息。" />
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Appearance combinations

Use this example for the emphasis of informational messages. Adjust variant, status and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

#### Type

`type`: `info` / `success` / `warning` / `danger` / `default`. `default` has no built-in icon; use `#icon` to customize.

</details>

## Content and presentation

### Title, alignment and banners

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
