## Icons and layout

### Icons and label layouts

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | Icons and label layouts |
| `variant` | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | Icons and label layouts |
| `size` | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | Icons and label layouts |
| `stacked` | Stack icon and text; inherits group when omitted | Icons and label layouts |
| `round` | Round button | Icons and label layouts |
| `block` | Full available width | Block buttons |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Use built-in icons to compare icon-only, inline and stacked labels across four variants and five sizes. Stacked buttons grow with content and keep at least 8px of top and bottom padding. Omit the default slot for icon-only buttons; round controls shape and stacked controls label layout.

Example source: src/button/example/demos/icons.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const sizes = ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const
const variants = ['default', 'text', 'outline', 'tonal'] as const
const layouts = ['icon', 'inline', 'stacked'] as const
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>('md')
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>('tonal')
const items = [
  { status: 'default', icon: 'plus', label: 'Add' },
  { status: 'primary', icon: 'reply', label: 'Reply' },
  { status: 'info', icon: 'info-circle', label: 'Info' },
  { status: 'success', icon: 'check', label: 'Confirm' },
  { status: 'warning', icon: 'delete', label: 'Delete' },
  { status: 'danger', icon: 'close', label: 'Close' },
] as const
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical" size="sm">
      <mp-form-item label="Variant" field="variant">
        <mp-radio-group v-model="variant" :options="variants" aria-label="Icon button variant" variant="button" />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item label="Size" field="size">
        <mp-radio-group v-model="size" :options="sizes" aria-label="Icon button size" variant="button" />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <mp-space v-for="layout in layouts" :key="layout" direction="column" :size="8">
      <span>{{
        layout === 'icon'
          ? 'Icon only / 纯图标'
          : layout === 'inline'
            ? 'Icon and text / 横排图文'
            : 'Stacked / 上下堆叠'
      }}</span>
      <mp-space wrap>
        <mp-button
          v-for="item in items"
          :key="item.label"
          :status="item.status"
          :variant="variant"
          :size="size"
          :stacked="layout === 'stacked'"
          :round="layout === 'icon'"
          :aria-label="item.label"
        >
          <template #icon>
            <m-icon-plus v-if="item.icon === 'plus'" />
            <m-icon-reply v-else-if="item.icon === 'reply'" />
            <m-icon-info-circle v-else-if="item.icon === 'info-circle'" />
            <m-icon-check v-else-if="item.icon === 'check'" />
            <m-icon-delete v-else-if="item.icon === 'delete'" />
            <m-icon-close v-else-if="item.icon === 'close'" />
          </template>
          <template v-if="layout !== 'icon'" #default>{{ item.label }}</template>
        </mp-button>
      </mp-space>
    </mp-space>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Forms and events

### Form control size comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | Form control size comparison |
| `variant` | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | Form control size comparison |
| `html-type` | Native button type | Native form, focus and touch events |
| `focusable` | Allow sequential Tab focus; does not prevent programmatic focus | Native form, focus and touch events |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Compare Input, Button, Select, date/time fields and other single-line controls at the same size. Field variants share the height scale; Button uses outline here. DatePicker/TimePicker are panels; this example uses Date/Time fields. The example includes selected and clearable values, removable tags and long multiple selections. Select/Cascader keep the same size height with tag-nowrap. Long tag text uses ellipsis while removal icons remain available; tags scroll horizontally while clear and arrow controls stay outside the scrolling area. Hover, focus or tap truncated tag text to read its full content; dismiss with an outside click or Escape without changing the selected value. Restore values after clearing to repeat the comparison. Multiline text and wrapping multiple selections can grow with content.

## Loading and action feedback

### Loading animations, layouts and sizes

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Loading; blocks activation and navigation | Loading animations, layouts and sizes, Loading indicator appearance |
| `loading-size` | Indicator size; xs/sm/md/lg/xl map to 12/14/16/18/20px; numbers are px; follows button size when omitted; not used in line mode | Loading animations, layouts and sizes, Loading indicator appearance |
| `loading-type` | Spinner animation; same as Loading.type; not used in line mode | Loading animations, layouts and sizes |
| `loading-mode` | Inline, covering, or bottom progress line; line only uses loading-color | Loading animations, layouts and sizes |
| `loading-color` | Loading indicator color | Loading indicator appearance |
| `ripple` | Click ripple | Ripple and elevation feedback |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Choose a loading layout and indicator size to compare five animations. Click a select arrow to open its menu, then choose an option to close it. Loading buttons keep their label and prevent repeated actions.

### Controlled loading and failure recovery

Example source: src/button/example/demos/controlled-loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const saving = ref(false)
const failing = ref(false)
const message = ref('点击保存，观察业务控制的 loading / Click Save to start')
const delay = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
async function save() {
  if (saving.value) {
    return
  }
  saving.value = true
  try {
    await delay()
    message.value = '保存完成 / Saved'
  } finally {
    saving.value = false
  }
}
async function recover() {
  if (failing.value) {
    return
  }
  failing.value = true
  try {
    await delay()
    throw new Error('模拟请求失败 / Simulated failure')
  } catch (error) {
    message.value = (error as Error).message
  } finally {
    failing.value = false
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="12">
    <p>
      click 支持 async 回调；业务通过 loading 展示等待，在 finally 中恢复。Async click handlers own their loading state.
    </p>
    <mp-space wrap :size="12">
      <mp-button :loading="saving" @click="save">保存 / Save</mp-button>
      <mp-button :loading="failing" @click="recover">失败与恢复 / Failure recovery</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons and content follow reading order; stacked content remains top to bottom without mirroring custom graphics. ButtonGroup uses its direction for horizontal arrangement, joined borders and end radii; individual buttons may override text direction. Single buttons retain full radii, and vertical groups keep top-to-bottom order. Native Tab, Enter and Space remain available; ordinary groups do not intercept arrow keys. Disabled and loading behavior is unchanged.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Button Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| status | Semantic color; inherits group, otherwise default | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `undefined` |
| variant | Appearance; inherits group, otherwise default | `default / text / outline / tonal` | `undefined` |
| size | Size; inherits group, otherwise md | `xs / sm / md / lg / xl` | `undefined` |
| html-type | Native button type | `button / submit / reset` | `button` |
| component | Root tag; link attributes fall through | `button / a` | `button` |
| round | Round button | `boolean` | `false` |
| block | Full available width | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading | Loading; blocks activation and navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-type | Spinner animation; same as Loading.type; not used in line mode | `circle / wave / cube / rect / disappear` | `circle` |
| loading-mode | Inline, covering, or bottom progress line; line only uses loading-color | `default / fill / line` | `default` |
| loading-size | Indicator size; xs/sm/md/lg/xl map to 12/14/16/18/20px; numbers are px; follows button size when omitted; not used in line mode | `ComponentSize / number`<br>`ComponentSize: 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `undefined` |
| loading-color | Loading indicator color | `string` | `currentColor` |
| disabled | Disabled; inherits group, explicit false overrides | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| ripple | Click ripple | `boolean` | `true` |
| focusable | Allow sequential Tab focus; does not prevent programmatic focus | `boolean` | `true` |
| autofocus | Native autofocus | `boolean` | `false` |
| text-color | Custom text color | `string` | `undefined` |
| color | Custom background or variant base color | `string` | `undefined` |
| elevation | Default variant shadow; true=2, false=off, rounded/clamped 0–24; group owns grouped elevation | `boolean / number` | `true` |
| stacked | Stack icon and text; inherits group when omitted | `boolean` | `undefined` |

### Button Events

| Event | Arguments and behavior |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| click | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` |

`click` is a notification event. The component does not process listener return values or automatically change its loading state. Business code controls `loading`; for asynchronous operations, reset it in `finally`. Disabled or loading links have no effective `href`.

### Button Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------- | -------------------------------- | ---- |
| default | Button label; retained while loading | — |
| icon | Leading icon; above label when stacked | — |

### Button Methods

No custom public methods.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### ButtonGroup Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| status | Default semantic status for child buttons; individual buttons may override it | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | default |
| size | Default child button size; individual buttons may override it | xs / sm / md / lg / xl | undefined |
| variant | Default child appearance; adjacent buttons join using their effective variants, including mixed variants | default / text / outline / tonal | default |
| color | Default custom child color; individual buttons may override it | string | undefined |
| text-color | Default child text color; individual buttons may override it | string | undefined |
| disabled | Default disabled state; an explicit child false overrides group true | boolean | false |
| stacked | Stack child icon and text vertically by default; a child may explicitly override with false | boolean | false |
| vertical | Vertical group layout, independent of button content stacking | boolean | false |
| elevation | Group elevation; true means 2, numbers normalize to 0–24, and it applies only to an enabled group using the default variant | boolean / number | true |

The root defaults to `role="group"`. Supply `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` when the action group needs a name. Native attributes can override role. Ordinary groups retain native Tab / Enter / Space handling without arrow-key focus management.

**Inheritance:** explicit child status, size, variant, color, text-color, disabled and stacked values take precedence. The group always owns elevation; individual button elevation is ignored. Nested groups use their nearest group's configuration and defaults without automatically accumulating outer disabled state.

### ButtonGroup Events

No custom events. `@click` forwards a native root event and may receive descendant bubbling; listen to each Button's click for its action. The group does not collect event Promises or manage tasks or selection.

### ButtonGroup Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Joined styling supports directly adjacent Button DOM nodes under the group root | — |

**Composition:** extra DOM wrappers, surrounding text and other controls are outside the joined appearance contract. Wrapped buttons may inherit configuration but do not receive the same joined styling. The group owns outer radii and does not preserve a standalone round button's circular appearance. Use Space for separate buttons or mixed content. In narrow areas, business code chooses scrolling, shorter labels or vertical layout; groups do not wrap automatically.

### ButtonGroup Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| buttonGroupProvider | Reactive group configuration with readonly ComputedRef fields; elevation is boolean / number and other fields match the Props |

No additional group action methods.

## Types

ButtonProps、ButtonVariant、ButtonLoadingMode、ButtonInstance、ButtonGroupProps、ButtonGroupInstance。

## CSS Variables

Button exposes 58 appearance tokens. `{status}-color` controls the solid background, `{status}-foreground-color` controls text/outline/tonal foreground, and `{status}-tonal-color` controls soft backgrounds. `solid-text-color` and `solid-state-layer-color` are shared by semantic statuses; default/tertiary foregrounds and primary/tertiary state layers retain theme-specific roles.

Sizes use xs/sm/md/lg/xl. Font sizes, transition duration, focus width/offset and stacked-height increments reuse system variables. Button groups and stacked buttons share border-radius. Four state opacity variables preserve hover/active differences. loading-duration controls only the bottom progress line; Loading controls other loading animations. Internal variables and fixed animation geometry are not public customization points.

<!-- Source: src/card/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/card -->

# Card

Source changes synchronously invalidate render generations. Close, row direction, newer work, deactivation or disposal prevent old nextTick/timer/double-frame continuations from changing newer phases. Render/timer deliveries consume once. Recheck lifecycle/request/node after geometry hooks to reject reentrant disposal. Suspension cancels both timers and retained close/click input is inert; activation starts a fresh phase from current props without replay, and initial KeepAlive activation does not duplicate the wait.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage and subtitle

```vue
      description="Keep the team informed."
      top-divider
      bottom-divider

      <template #footer><mp-button status="primary">View details</mp-button></template>
    </mp-card>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef } from 'vue'

const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'default', size: 'md' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['default', 'outline', 'tonal'] },
  { name: 'size', values: ['sm', 'md'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)

__demoAppearance['elevation'] = 2
demoCompareFields.push({ name: 'elevation', values: [0, 2, 6] })
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="16">
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="variant">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['variant']"
          aria-label="variant"
          :options="[
            { label: 'default', value: 'default' },
            { label: 'outline', value: 'outline' },
            { label: 'tonal', value: 'tonal' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="size">
        <mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['size']"
          aria-label="size"
          :options="[
            { label: 'sm', value: 'sm' },
            { label: 'md', value: 'md' },
          ]"
          variant="button"
          size="sm"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item label="elevation"
        ><mp-radio-group
          v-model="__demoAppearance['elevation']"
          aria-label="elevation"
          :options="[
            { label: '0', value: 0 },
            { label: '2', value: 2 },
            { label: '6', value: 6 },
          ]"
      /></mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p class="demo-config-comparison-hint">
      <span lang="zh-CN">选择一个对比维度；其他配置和内容保持一致。输入类示例共享同一个值，便于比较外观。</span
      ><span lang="en-US"
        >Compare one dimension while keeping the other settings and content identical. Input specimens share the same
        value.</span
      >

      v-model="demoCompareAxis"
      aria-label="Compare configuration"

        </p>
        <mp-card
          title="Project overview"
          description="Keep the team informed."
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Floating scheduler lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `floating` | Fullscreen state; supports v-model:floating | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `ripple` | Click ripple | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `floating-duration` | Fullscreen transition duration in ms | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
| `title` | Title | Floating scheduler lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/card/example/demos/en-US/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const floating = ref(false)
const ripple = ref(true)
const duration = ref(250)
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="floating = !floating">Float / 浮起与回落</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / 卸载与挂载</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="ripple = !ripple">Ripple wait / 涟漪等待</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="duration = duration ? 0 : 250">Duration / 零与默认时长</mp-button>
    <p>
      Toggle floating rapidly, suspend during500ms ripple wait or layout settlement, then activate. Old tasks must not
      reset a newer phase. Underlying doubleRaf frames are not physically canceled.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-card
        v-if="active"
        v-model:floating="floating"
        :ripple="ripple"
        :floating-duration="duration"
        title="Floating lifecycle / 浮起生命周期"
      >
        Card content / 卡片内容
        <template #floating-content>
          <mp-button @click.stop="floating = false">Collapse / 回落</mp-button>
          <mp-button @click.stop="active = false">Deactivate / 停用</mp-button>
          <mp-button @click.stop="mounted = false">Unmount / 卸载</mp-button>
        </template>
      </mp-card>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

The same scenarios, parameters and interactions as Cedar. Only component prefixes differ; themes and site shells remain independent.

## Reading direction

Title, content and actions follow reading order. Default floating actions sit at inline end; images and custom slots are not mirrored.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
`row-reverse` reverses the horizontal cover and body order, with reading direction still following the container. Collapsed `floating-content` keeps its nodes and state but is inert to keyboard and assistive technology; it becomes interactive when expanded. Floating is available only in column direction.

The floating layer remains at the Card’s original DOM location. An ancestor’s transform or similar property may change the fixed-position containing block, and ancestor clipping may obscure the layer, so viewport coverage is not guaranteed. When focus is inside an expanded Card, Escape requests closing unless an inner control has already handled the key; a nested topmost popup handles Escape first. The layer does not provide modal focus management; use Dialog when modal interaction is required.

When focus is still inside the floating content or close controls, closing attempts to return focus to the element focused before expansion. If focus has moved elsewhere, it is left unchanged.

The default close button uses the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. `floating-duration` is a finite nonnegative duration in milliseconds; 0 means no delay and invalid values fall back to 250. When reduced motion is enabled, opening and closing skip the ripple and transition waits, including when the preference changes during a transition.

| hoverable | Hover styling | `boolean` | `false` |
| title-style | Title row styles | `CSSProperties` | `undefined` |
| title | Title | `string` | `undefined` |
| subtitle | Subtitle | `string` | `undefined` |
| description | Description | `string` | `undefined` |

| bottom-divider | Bottom divider | `boolean` | `false` |

| fit | Cover image fit | `fill / contain / cover / none / scale-down` | `cover` |

| --- | --- |

### Card Methods

No public methods.

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments and slots match. Cedar inherits the global size when size is omitted: xs/sm map to sm, all others to md. Maple falls back to md. Pass size explicitly for identical density. Themes and CSS prefixes remain platform-specific.
Use the Loading directive to compose a loading overlay on Card.

## CSS Variables

Regular/filled backgrounds and borders use `surface-default`, `surface-muted` and `border-default`. Titles, body and secondary text use `content-primary`, `content-tertiary` and `content-secondary`. Expanded floating buttons use `content-primary`; text and icons on dark close buttons use `content-on-dark`.

When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. ### Sizing and motion

Use `--mp-card-content-row-margin` for horizontal content spacing. Card supports only sm / md sizes. `--mp-card-animation-duration` defaults to `var(--mp-sys-motion-duration-slow)` and `--mp-card-animation-easing` to `var(--mp-sys-motion-easing-standard)`. Reduced motion disables Card transitions.

# Carousel

Autoplay interval is business playback cadence (business-clock), not CSS duration. Autoplay remains off by default; true uses3000ms, with existing numeric/config intervals and hover/focus/hidden pause rules. Cancellation/replacement invalidates old playback work; delivery consumes once before navigation. Retained inactive/disposed next/prev/to, keyboard and wheel cannot navigate or intercept input. Activation creates fresh observer/event bindings; detached deliveries cannot use a newer active state to reschedule.

### Multiple Slides Per View

The demo shows 2.5 items and lets you drag or toggle acceptance and looping. Current is the parent-accepted page index starting at 1, Proposal records requests, and Changes counts change notifications. When updates are rejected, a request or change does not mean the model changed. Accepted updates allow dragging in either direction; disabling looping prevents crossing the ends.

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/multi-slides.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const current = ref(1)
const proposal = ref(1)
const changes = ref(0)
const accept = ref(true)
const loop = ref(true)
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value
  if (accept.value) {
    current.value = value
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <section class="multi-slides-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="accept" edit-mode="direct">Accept changes / 接受切换</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="loop" edit-mode="direct">Loop / 循环</mp-checkbox>
    <p role="status">Current: {{ current }} · Proposal: {{ proposal }} · Changes: {{ changes }}</p>
    <mp-carousel
      class="carousel"
      :slides-per-view="2.5"
      :space-between="10"
      :model-value="current"
      :loop="loop"
      draggable
      keyboard
      @update:modelValue="update"
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <mp-carousel-item v-for="i in 6" :key="i">
        <div class="carousel-custom-slide">{{ i }}</div>
      </mp-carousel-item>
    </mp-carousel>
  </section>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.carousel {
  height: 160px;
}

.carousel-example {
  height: 160px;
}

.carousel-item {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.carousel-custom-slide {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: #4a90d9;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.carousel-custom-indicators {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 10px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}

.carousel-custom-indicator {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  color: #fff;
```

### auto-sized

Reverse cards reorders the same uniquely keyed cards (their distinct widths are the Demo keys). Current is positional, not a business-card identity: slide number 2 changes from 220px to 180px without changing the index or event count. Drag left to slide number 3, restore order to show 180px there, then drag right to slide number 2. Reordering alone emits no change. Arbitrary insertion/sorting, identity-following selection, reordering during a held gesture and physical touch remain unverified.

When the active fifth card is removed, parent Current stays 5 without another change; the view clamps it to the remaining fourth card and centers that card. A subsequent left drag wraps to 1 and updates the model once. Applications that need immediate parent-index correction must update current themselves. Arbitrary reordering and deletion during a held gesture remain unverified.

Empty temporarily removes every card: navigation is disabled and dragging emits no change. Turning it off restores the configured cards without switching. Clearing and restoring from slide number 1 allows a subsequent right drag to wrap to the last item. This does not cover nonzero out-of-range controlled indices or clearing during a held gesture.

Clearing from slide number 4 retains the parent Current and change count. Restoring centers the last card; the next left drag wraps to 1 and emits once. Empty content does not force the controlled parent value to 0. Active-card deletion, arbitrary invalid indices and clearing during a held gesture remain unverified.

Extra card appends a 200px fifth item without changing a valid current index or incrementing Changes. Drag right from the first item to reach it, then right again to the original last item before removing the extra card. The index and count stay unchanged; dragging left then wraps across the restored four-item boundary. This covers removing an inactive final item, not deleting the active item, arbitrary reordering, or changes during a held gesture.

Drag to the last item, then enable Wider cards (80px added per item) and the 300px viewport. Resizing does not change the model or increment Changes: the current 340px card recenters, and a left drag can wrap to the first item. Restoring both switches recenters again. This paragraph describes ResizeObserver updates after a completed gesture, not resizing while holding a drag.

Items have different widths. Dragging keeps the current item centered and can loop across either end. Current shows the accepted page index starting at 1; Changes counts change notifications.

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/auto-sized.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const current = ref(1)
const changes = ref(0)
const wider = ref(false)
const compact = ref(false)
const extra = ref(false)
const empty = ref(false)
const reversed = ref(false)
const widths = computed(() => {
  const items = empty.value ? [] : [140, 220, 180, 260, ...(extra.value ? [200] : [])]
  return (reversed.value ? items.reverse() : items).map((width) => width + (wider.value ? 80 : 0))
})
</script>

<template>
  <section class="auto-sized-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="wider" edit-mode="direct">Wider cards / 加宽卡片</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="compact" edit-mode="direct">300px viewport / 窄容器</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="extra" edit-mode="direct">Extra card / 增加末项</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="empty" edit-mode="direct">Empty / 清空项目</mp-checkbox>
    <mp-checkbox v-model="reversed" edit-mode="direct">Reverse cards / 反转顺序</mp-checkbox>
    <p role="status">Current: {{ current }} · Changes: {{ changes }}</p>
    <mp-carousel
      v-model="current"
      slides-per-view="auto"
      :space-between="12"
      height="180px"
      :style="{ width: compact ? '300px' : '100%' }"
      centered-slides
      draggable
      @change="changes++"
    >
      <mp-carousel-item v-for="width in widths" :key="width" :style="{ width: width + 'px' }">
        <div class="carousel-demo-panel">{{ width }}px</div>
      </mp-carousel-item>
    </mp-carousel>
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.carousel-demo-panel {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  background: #e0e7ff;
  color: #312e81;
}
</style>
```

### Indicator style and position

All indicator presets use the same three local slides and active-slide model. Click an indicator or a navigation arrow in any specimen: every specimen changes to the same slide. The first group compares dot, line and slider; the second compares top and outer positions. The grid stacks on narrow screens.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Indicator Types

Use `indicator-type` for `dot`, `line`, or `slider`. Hide indicators with `indicator`.

</details>

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/indicator-comparison.vue


### Transition effects

Change adjacent slides to compare fade, card and slide effects independently of autoplay and input methods.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Fade Effect

Use the indicator buttons to switch pages. Inactive slides become transparent and inert. All slides overlap in one grid cell, keeping the active slide at the viewport width rather than splitting the track into columns.

#### Card Effect

The active slide uses full scale and opacity; neighboring slides are scaled down and dimmed. Previous/next buttons retain native keyboard activation.

</details>

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/effect-comparison.vue

## Playback and interaction

### Forbid Loop

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | Container height; numbers are px | Autoplay, controlled, interactive-content |
| `keyboard` | Scoped arrow/Home/End navigation | Keyboard Control, controlled, interactive-content |
| `auto-play` | Autoplay configuration | Autoplay, Autoplay with Hover to Pause |
| `draggable` | Mouse dragging, independent of touch | controlled、interactive-content |
| `loop` | Loop without duplicating instances | Forbid Loop |
| `trigger` | Indicator trigger | Trigger with Hover |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

### Autoplay

The demo uses a 2000ms interval. Displayed slide numbers start at 1; API indices remain one-based. Toggle playback off/on to stop/resume. Focus inside the carousel also pauses playback.

Enable autoplay with `auto-play`. `true` uses a 3000ms interval; a number is the interval in milliseconds.

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/autoplay.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')
watchLang((value) => {
  language.value = value
})
const current = ref(1)
const playing = ref(true)
const changes = ref(0)
const sources = ['cat.jpg', 'cat2.jpg', 'cat3.jpg']
</script>

<template>
  <section class="carousel-autoplay-demo">
    <mp-checkbox v-model="playing" edit-mode="direct">{{ english ? 'Autoplay' : '自动播放' }}</mp-checkbox>
    <p role="status">
      {{ english ? 'Current slide' : '当前页' }}：{{ current }}；{{ english ? 'Changes' : '切换次数' }}：{{ changes }}
    </p>
    <mp-carousel
      v-model="current"
      height="180px"
      :auto-play="playing ? 2000 : false"
      @focusin="playing = false"
      @change="changes += 1"
    >
      <mp-carousel-item v-for="(source, index) in sources" :key="source">
        <img
          class="carousel-autoplay-demo__image"
          :src="source"
          :alt="(english ? 'Demo image ' : '示例图片 ') + (index + 1)"
        />
      </mp-carousel-item>
    </mp-carousel>
  </section>
</template>

<style scoped>
.carousel-autoplay-demo__image {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const current = ref(1)
const accept = ref(true)
const proposal = ref(1)
function update(value) {
  proposal.value = value
  if (accept.value) {
    current.value = value
  }
}
</script>
<template>
```

### Scheduler lifecycle

Changing content, restarting navigation or unmounting cancels pending slide movement. Autoplay timing is independent of CSS transitions.

Example source: src/carousel/example/demos/en-US/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const current = ref(1)
const playing = ref(false)
const moves = ref(0)
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="playing = !playing">Autoplay / 自动播放</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / 卸载与挂载</mp-button>
    <p>
      Current / 当前: {{ current }}; changes / 通知: {{ moves }}. Suspend during autoplay or loop settlement, then
      activate. Old work must not replay.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-carousel
        v-if="active"
        v-model="current"
        :auto-play="playing ? { interval: 1000 } : false"
        :move-speed="600"
        :height="180"
        keyboard
        mousewheel
        @change="moves++"
      >
        <mp-carousel-item v-for="item in 3" :key="item">Slide / 幻灯片 {{ item }}</mp-carousel-item>
      </mp-carousel>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Intro

Displays a collection of items that can be scrolled and swiped. Demos match Cedar Design Web; `effect` and `centered-slides` are shared.

## Usage notes

### Looping and autoplay

Each slide always has one component instance. Ordinary previous/next navigation recycles positions after the departing slide exits. Multi-slide or centered jumps that would require one slide in two positions settle immediately without animation, cloning interactive content or queuing unlimited transitions. Fewer items than visible slides are not cloned to fill space. Accessible names follow global Locale; explicit label props take precedence.

Native root listeners such as `keydown`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin` and `focusout` run alongside internal navigation and autoplay pause handling. Native `.once` listeners fire once for the root element lifetime.

`space-between` also accepts valid CSS lengths such as percentages and `calc()`. Multi-slide layout uses unscaled CSS pixels, so ancestor scaling does not change the gap-to-slide proportion.

If a focused slide becomes inaccessible through navigation or removal, focus moves to the carousel container. Focus in a still-visible slide or outside the carousel is preserved. The container is programmatically focusable but is not in the Tab order unless `keyboard` is enabled; an explicit `tabindex` remains under caller control.

The autoplay example sets `auto-play=false` on focus entry and provides an external switch for an explicit restart. The component itself only pauses temporarily while focus is inside; playback resumes on blur. This differs from the WAI-ARIA APG recommendation to stop on focus until the user explicitly restarts, and is not a claim of full APG conformance; applications requiring that behavior should control playback state. Reduced motion disables transitions but does not by itself stop automatic navigation.

Slide numbers start at 1; finite fractions are truncated toward zero and then wrapped or clamped according to `loop`. Finite `move-speed` values use non-negative milliseconds; non-finite values use the CSS transition duration. The root is a named region and default indicator buttons have localized slide names and current state; their container has no separate group name. `line` and `slider` share the same default bar dimensions; `slider` can grow into available container space and is not draggable.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current slide number, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only on creation; later changes do not reset it. An explicit bound value takes precedence. Initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`.

### Carousel Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model-value` | Controlled one-based slide number | `number` | `undefined` |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial index | `number` | `1` |
| `loop` | Loop without duplicating instances | `boolean` | `true` |
| `auto-play` | Autoplay configuration | `boolean \| number \| CarouselAutoPlayConfig` | `false` |
| `move-speed` | Explicit duration in milliseconds | `number` | `undefined (token)` |
| `trigger` | Indicator trigger | `click \| hover` | `click` |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical axis of carousel sliding, default horizontal; does not determine indicator position | `horizontal \| vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `show-arrow` | Arrow visibility | `always \| hover \| never` | `always` |
| `arrow-class` | Additional arrow class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator` | Show indicators | `boolean` | `true` |
| `indicator-type` | Indicator appearance | `dot \| line \| slider` | `dot` |
| `indicator-position` | Indicator edge or outer region of the carousel container, default bottom. Not a trigger-relative popup placement | `bottom \| top \| left \| right \| outer` | `bottom` |
| `indicator-class` | Additional indicator class | `string` | `undefined` |
| `indicator-color` | Custom indicator background | `string` | `undefined` |
| `height` | Container height; numbers are px | `number \| string` | `undefined` |
| `transition-timing-function` | Explicit timing function | `string` | `undefined (token)` |

| `draggable` | Mouse dragging, independent of touch | `boolean` | `false` |
| `mousewheel` | Wheel navigation | `boolean` | `false` |
| `keyboard` | Scoped arrow/Home/End navigation | `boolean` | `false` |

| `space-between` | Item gap; numbers/numeric strings are px | `number \| string` | `0` |

| `previous-button-aria-label` | Previous button accessible name | `string` | Locale |
| `next-button-aria-label` | Next button accessible name | `string` | Locale |

### Model and interaction
Public slide numbers start at 1. Controlled actions emit update:model-value, then change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual), and do not move until the parent accepts current. External assignments do not emit change. Method option event:false suppresses only change, not the model proposal. isManual is true for user actions and false for autoplay.

loop moves existing children across boundaries without cloning component instances. Without looping or centering, the final viewport is clamped to avoid empty space; selection can move within the final visible group without moving the track. Partly visible slides remain accessible; fully offscreen slides are inert. fade displays one slide. auto uses explicit CarouselItem width horizontally or height vertically; vertical mode requires a container height. Only CarouselItem children, including those inside Vue Fragments, count as slides; comments and ordinary elements do not.

auto-play=true uses 3000ms and pauses on hover; a number sets milliseconds without hover pausing; an object configures interval/hoverToPause. Focus within, dragging, hidden documents/ancestors and KeepAlive deactivation always pause playback. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Interactive children such as inputs/buttons keep native behavior; mark custom interactive areas with data-carousel-no-drag. show-arrow=hover also shows arrows on keyboard focus.

### Carousel Events
| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | slideNumber: number |
| change | slideNumber: number, previousSlideNumber: number, isManual: boolean |

### Carousel Slots
| Slot | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| default | CarouselItem |
| prev / next / indicator | { slideNumber, length, hovering, prev, next, to, resize } |

### Carousel Methods
| Method | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| prev / next | (options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| to | (slideNumber: number, options?: CarouselToOptions) => void |
| resize | () => void |

CarouselItem has no own props, events or methods. Its default slot supplies slide content.

<!-- Source: src/cascader/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/cascader -->

# Cascader

In multiple mode, the inline dropdown contains options only; the field owns selected values, removal and clearing. The popup editor retains the selected-items summary and clear action, and commits its draft on confirmation.

When cascading multiple selections, toggling a parent affects only selectable descendants; already selected disabled descendants are retained.

## Reading direction

Inherits source dir. Child columns, expansion icons and separators follow reading direction. Horizontal keys enter loaded children or return to the parent in the visible direction, skipping disabled children; vertical keys retain logical order. Search preserves native horizontal caret editing. Path and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Clearing the last value while closed resets navigation before reopening.

`empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

### Form control size comparison

Compare selected, clearable and nowrap multiple values with Input and Button. Long labels use ellipsis; removal icons stay available and the tag row scrolls horizontally without moving clear or arrow controls.

Example source: src/field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const sizes = ['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] as const
const variants = ['outline', 'filled', 'standard'] as const
const disabled = ref(false)
const readonly = ref(false)
const error = ref(false)
const size = ref<(typeof sizes)[number]>('md')
const variant = ref<(typeof variants)[number]>('outline')
const options = [
  { value: 'beijing', label: 'Beijing' },
  { value: 'shanghai', label: 'Shanghai' },
]
const cascaderOptions = [{ value: 'china', label: 'China', children: options }]

const inputValue = ref('Beijing')
const textareaValue = ref('Textarea value')
const selectValue = ref('beijing')
const cascaderValue = ref('beijing')
const selectMultiple = ref(['beijing', 'shanghai'])
const cascaderMultiple = ref(['beijing', 'shanghai'])
const selectOverflow = ref(['long', 'beijing', 'shanghai'])
const cascaderOverflow = ref(['long', 'beijing', 'shanghai'])
const selectedOptions = [
  ...options,
  {
    value: 'long',
    label:
      'A very long selected option label for overflow comparison — full text preview keeps the selected value unchanged.',
  },
]
const selectedCascaderOptions = [{ value: 'china', label: 'China', children: selectedOptions }]
function resetSelections() {
  inputValue.value = 'Beijing'
  selectValue.value = 'beijing'
  cascaderValue.value = 'beijing'
  selectMultiple.value = ['beijing', 'shanghai']
  cascaderMultiple.value = ['beijing', 'shanghai']
  selectOverflow.value = ['long', 'beijing', 'shanghai']
  cascaderOverflow.value = ['long', 'beijing', 'shanghai']
}
</script>
```

## Selection modes and paths

### Multiple cascade

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------- |
| `path-mode` | Return a complete path instead of a node value | Multiple cascade, Picker multiple, List multiple |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder | Multiple cascade, Picker multiple, List multiple |
| `options` | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | Multiple cascade, Picker multiple, List multiple |
| `multiple` | Multiple selection; enables search by default | Multiple cascade, Picker multiple, List multiple |
| `show-tags` | Show tags; false displays separated text | Multiple cascade, Picker multiple, List multiple |
| `edit-mode` | Field presentation; inherits FormItem / Form when omitted. | Picker multiple, List multiple |

### Presentation and commit rules

Inline commits immediately. Popup and dialog edit a draft for both single and multiple values. Confirm publishes once; cancel, overlay dismissal, Escape and presentation changes discard edits. External model replacements win over drafts. Search is inside the editor and keeps the existing filtering, search event and lazy loading API.

### Manage selected items

Multi-select panels include a selection summary and Clear. Cedar shows removable tags above list options. Maple opens selected-item details from the count row, with per-item removal and a way back to options. Popup/popover and dialog use the same behavior. Removal and Clear edit the draft; Cancel restores the value and Confirm publishes it. Disabled items remain selected, and confirmation locks selection actions. The panel Clear action is independent of the field clear icon.

### Panel data and customization

Compare panel options, selection and custom content. Select a node or clear the selection and inspect the displayed value; panel behavior is separate from the field opening protocol.

Example source: src/cascader/example/demos/panel-review.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import type { CascaderOption } from '../../types'

const value = ref<string | number | (string | number)[] | (string | number)[][]>()
const multiple = ref(false)
const pathMode = ref(false)
const empty = ref(false)
const loads = ref(0)
const options = computed(() =>
  empty.value
    ? []
    : [
        {
          value: 'frontend',
          label: '前端',
          children: [
            { value: 'vue', label: 'Vue', isLeaf: true },
            { value: 'react', label: 'React', isLeaf: true },
          ],
        },
        { value: 'backend', label: '后端', children: [{ value: 'node', label: 'Node.js', isLeaf: true }] },
        { value: 'lazy', label: '异步节点', isLeaf: false },
      ],
)
watch([multiple, pathMode], () => {
  value.value = multiple.value ? [] : undefined
})
function loadMore(option: CascaderOption, done: (children: CascaderOption[]) => void) {
  loads.value++
  done([{ value: `${option.value}-child`, label: '异步子节点', isLeaf: true }])
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-space>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="multiple">面板多选</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="pathMode">完整路径</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="empty">空数据</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-button @click="value = multiple ? [] : undefined">清空面板选择</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-cascader-panel
      v-model="value"
      :options="options"
      :multiple="multiple"
      :path-mode="pathMode"
      :load-more="loadMore"
    >
      <template #empty><mp-tag>子面板空状态</mp-tag></template>
    </mp-cascader-panel>
    <p role="status">面板值：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}；加载回调：{{ loads }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Configuration and composition

### Typed passthrough configuration

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `edit-mode` | Field presentation; inherits FormItem / Form when omitted. | Typed passthrough configuration, Copying and editing |
| `options` | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | Typed passthrough configuration, Copying and editing |
| `trigger-props` | Menu Trigger props; field owns open state | Typed passthrough configuration |
| `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening area: field includes the whole field; icon uses only the suffix trigger. Clear/remove actions are excluded; explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | Copying and editing |
| `filterable` | Enable search | Copying and editing |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Use `CascaderTriggerOptions` from `@maple-design/ui-vue` for opt-in boundary checking. Published wide prop types and runtime precedence remain unchanged. Visibility, disabled state and owned updates belong to the host. Top-level popupContainer wins when defined (including false), otherwise the existing nested fallback applies. Select/Cascader keep nested overrides for existing presentation defaults, including unmountOnClose. Date/DateRange filter owned state, rules and listeners; their interaction/offset settings and mobile unmountOnClose are fixed by the renderer.

Example source: src/cascader/example/demos/passthrough-options.vue

```vue
  <mp-space direction="column" fill>
    <mp-button @click="open = !open">{{ open ? '关闭面板' : '打开面板' }}</mp-button>

      v-model:open="open"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :options="options"
      :trigger-props="triggerOptions"
      aria-label="透传配置示例"
    />
    <p role="status">顶层 open：{{ open }}；嵌套配置：向上展开并调整偏移。</p>
  </mp-space>
```


## Async loading and value resolution

### Callback lazy loading

Example source: src/cascader/example/demos/load-more.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'
import type { CascaderOption } from '../../types'

const roots = () => [{ value: 'root', label: 'Remote group', isLeaf: false }]
const options = ref<CascaderOption[]>(roots())
const requests = shallowRef<((children?: CascaderOption[]) => void)[]>([])
const stale = shallowRef<((children?: CascaderOption[]) => void)[]>([])
const status = ref('展开 Remote group 后选择返回结果 / Expand Remote group, then settle below')
const loadMore = (_option: CascaderOption, done: (children?: CascaderOption[]) => void) => {
  requests.value = [...requests.value, done]
}
function settle(success: boolean) {
  const callbacks = requests.value
  requests.value = []
  callbacks.forEach((done) => done(success ? [{ value: 'leaf', label: 'Loaded child', isLeaf: true }] : undefined))
  status.value = success
    ? '子项已返回 / Children received'
    : 'done() 结束等待，可重新展开重试 / Retry by expanding again'
}
function replace() {
  stale.value = [...stale.value, ...requests.value]
  requests.value = []
  options.value = roots()
  status.value = '已替换数据，旧回调失效 / Data replaced; old callbacks are invalid'
}
function settleOld() {
  stale.value.forEach((done) => done([{ value: 'stale', label: 'Stale child', isLeaf: true }]))
  stale.value = []
  status.value = '旧请求已返回，不应出现 Stale child / Old responses must not add Stale child'
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" size="lg">
    <mp-cascader
      :options="options"
      edit-mode="direct"
      :load-more="loadMore"
      placeholder="展开远程分组 / Expand remote group"
    />
    <mp-cascader-panel :options="options" :load-more="loadMore" />
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button :disabled="!requests.length" @click="settle(true)">返回子项 / Resolve</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!requests.length" @click="settle(false)">结束并重试 / Retry</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="replace">替换数据 / Replace data</mp-button>
      <mp-button :disabled="!stale.length" @click="settleOld">返回旧请求 / Resolve old</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p role="status">{{ status }}</p>
    <p>
      load-more 使用 done(children) 成功、done() 结束等待；返回值不作为子项。loadMore uses a callback; its return value
      does not supply children.
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Async device labels

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ |
| `edit-mode` | Field presentation; inherits FormItem / Form when omitted. | Async device labels |
| `options` | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | Async device labels |
| `loading` | Loading state; blocks selection and confirmation | Async device labels |
| `path-mode` | Return a complete path instead of a node value | Async device labels |
| `filterable` | Enable search | Async device labels |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing; preserve disabled selections | Async device labels |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/cascader/example/demos/en-US/async-devices.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const editMode = ref<'direct' | 'popup'>('popup')
const value = ref(['factory', 'device-2'])
const options = ref<Record<string, unknown>[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)
async function load() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    options.value = await Promise.resolve([
      {
        id: 'factory',
        name: 'Factory',
        nodes: [
          { id: 'device-1', name: 'Device one' },
          { id: 'device-2', name: 'Device two' },
          { id: 'device-3', name: 'Unavailable device', disabled: true },
        ],
      },
    ])
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" align="stretch" :size="16">
    <mp-form-item layout="vertical" size="sm" label="Presentation">
      <mp-radio-group
        v-model="editMode"
        aria-label="Presentation"
        :style="{ width: '200px' }"
        :options="[
          { label: 'inline', value: 'inline' },
          { label: 'popup', value: 'popup' },
        ]"
        variant="button"
        size="sm"
      />
    </mp-form-item>
    <mp-button @click="load">Load device tree</mp-button>
    <mp-cascader
      v-model="value"
      :edit-mode="editMode"
      :options="options"
      :loading="loading"
      path-mode
      filterable
      clearable
      :field-names="{ label: 'name', value: 'id', children: 'nodes' }"
      placeholder="Choose a device path"
    />
    <p>Committed path: {{ value }}. Labels resolve automatically after the tree loads.</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Intro

Cascading selection via dropdown menu or bottom popup picker.

Single selection uses the built-in check icon on the right. Multiple selection uses Checkbox controls: no checked descendants is unchecked, some is indeterminate, and all selectable leaf descendants is checked. Disabled leaves are excluded from select-all. With checkStrictly, parent and child selections are independent. Panel selections remain drafts until confirmation.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

### Lazy-loading completion and errors

When an expandable option has unloaded children, Enter, Space, or the forward arrow starts lazy loading and displays its pending state. The forward arrow moves into children only if focus remains on the input or option that received the key. Search results do not expand children.

`loadMore(option, done)` keeps a callback-only contract in the field and standalone panel. Call `done(children)` to accept children or `done()` to end waiting and allow retry. Only the first callback is accepted; return values, including a resolved Promise, do not replace `done`. A synchronous loader exception releases waiting and reaches Vue's `errorCaptured` / application `errorHandler`. The `load-error` event remains specific to the `options` data source; it does not report `loadMore` exceptions. Handle asynchronous callback-based request failures in business code and call `done()`.

Replacing options (including nested mutations), field names, or the loader invalidates old work and cached lazy children. Unmount/deactivation invalidates pending callbacks; an old result cannot change a replacement node or clear a newer wait.

## Usage notes

### Editing mode
Use `edit-mode` to choose direct editing or a mobile editor panel.

### Editing and confirmation
This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Field editing uses edit-mode: Cedar supports direct/click/dblclick, and Maple supports direct/popup. The old menu/list/picker editing values are not retained. Popup editors reuse the existing option index, search, asynchronous loading and virtual-list algorithms.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Search fields
`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

### Selection actions during loading
While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

option({ data }) receives normalized CascaderOptionInfo; data.raw is the original option and data.path is the normalized root-to-current path. label({ data }) receives the field display item key/value/label/closable/tagProps. arrow-icon({ focus, menuOpen }) receives the real field focus and open state. read({ value, text }) retains null/undefined and the original model shape.

Public types include CascaderBaseValue, CascaderOptionInfo, CascaderReadScope, CascaderEmits, CascaderSlots and CascaderExpose from the root and cascader entry points. Standalone CascaderPanel accepts option arrays and does not own a root candidate loader.

## API

A panel branch’s `aria-expanded` indicates whether its child column is actually visible; focus or hover does not mark it expanded before that column opens. Leaf options have no `aria-expanded`. In hierarchical single-select menus, selectable leaves and selectable strict-mode branches use `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked`; expansion-only branches remain `menuitem`, and multiple selection continues to use checkboxes. Hierarchical single-select panels provide one Tab entry across their menu items; arrow keys navigate options and columns, while Tab or Shift+Tab leaves the menu. With virtual scrolling the entry stays among rendered options; interactive controls in custom option slots manage their own focus. Search results do not advertise submenus that are not displayed. Direct single-select search uses a `listbox` with `option` elements, and the input references the popup and active option. Editor single-select search uses `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked` and one Tab stop; hovering another option does not move that entry while an option has focus. Multiple-select search retains its checkboxes. In direct single-select search, the popup icon is excluded from the Tab sequence; click the icon or press Arrow Down in the input to open it.

In a virtual column, appending or removing other options at the end preserves the nodes and focus of options that remain rendered; switching parent does not reuse the previous column’s scroll position. Options may unmount when removed or scrolled out of the virtual window, so keep persistent slot input state in application data.

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Cascader Props

Use `v-model`, `v-model:open` and `v-model:input-value` for controlled state. Clear values are `''` for single selection and `[]` for multiple selection. Select uses `undefined` when an actual empty-string option exists.

### Cascader Events / Methods

In direct mode, Arrow Down requests opening when the field is closed. Once opened, the first enabled option becomes active if no option is already active and focus remains in the field, including when options arrive asynchronously. Losing focus, closing, or interacting again cancels the pending activation. A controlled `open` changes only when the parent accepts the request.

When a menu option has focus, Enter or Space activates it. Search inputs and nested checkboxes keep their own keyboard behavior.

- `keydown(event)`: keyboard event from the field, candidate menu, or editor panel; `preventDefault()` suppresses internal keyboard handling.

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- `load-error(error)`: current options source failure notification; listener Promises are not collected.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()` and `refresh(): Promise<void>`; refresh does not open the editor.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

Buttons, links, inputs, list options, tree items, grid cells, and nested Cascaders inside custom option content own their clicks without selecting the outer option; ordinary content still selects it. A click canceled with `preventDefault` does not activate the option, and events continue to bubble normally.

`CascaderPanel` (`mp-cascader-panel`), also `Cascader.CascaderPanel`, works independently as a Menu panel without input/popup. Supports options, modelValue/defaultValue, multiple, pathMode, checkStrictly, fieldNames, loadMore, disabled, expandTrigger and expandChild. Events are update:modelValue/change; empty customizes empty state.

### CascaderPanel Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :---------------------: |
| path-mode | Return a complete path instead of a node value | `boolean` | `false` |
| multiple | Multiple selection; enables search by default | `boolean` | `false` |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Bound value | `string\| number\| Record<string, any>\| (    \| string    \| number    \| Record<string, any>    \| (string \| number \| Record<string, any>)[]  )[]\| undefined` | `-` |
| default-value | Default value (uncontrolled state) | `string\| number\| Record<string, any>\| (    \| string    \| number    \| Record<string, any>    \| (string \| number \| Record<string, any>)[]  )[]\| undefined` | `'' \| undefined \| []` |
| options | Tree options; leaf values must be unique in scalar mode; paths distinguish branches | `CascaderOption[]` | `[]` |
| expand-trigger | Menu / List expansion: click or hover | `string` | `'click'` |
| check-strictly | Allow parent selection; unlink parent/child checks | `boolean` | `false` |
| load-more | Load children asynchronously; call done(children), or done() to allow retry | `(  option: CascaderOption,  done: (children?: CascaderOption[]) => void) => void` | `-` |
| field-names | Customize fields in `CascaderOption`; when option `value` is an object, `value` is also used as the key property | `CascaderFieldNames` | `-` |

### CascaderPanel Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------ | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| change | Emitted when the selected value changes | value: `string \| number \| (string \| number \| (string \| number)[])[] \| undefined` |

### CascaderPanel Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------ | :------------------: | ---- |
| empty | Content displayed when no options are available | - |

Async search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest current-query response. `update:input-value` can react immediately; `loading`/`filter-option` can display remote results. Popup arrows/Enter operate current candidates only; bottom confirmation saves. Validation failure preserves drafts, confirmation locks editing/closing, and Form reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form's unified field-presentation examples.

# Cell

### Intro

The cell is a single display item in the list. `title` renders the main text; the default slot overrides it when provided.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/cell/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-cell title="这是单元格" />
  <mp-cell title="标题会被默认插槽覆盖">自定义单元格内容</mp-cell>
</template>
```

## Content and presentation

### Icons, descriptions and dividers

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border` | Whether to show border | Icons, descriptions and dividers, Use As List Item |
| `title` | Main title; overridden by the default slot | Icons, descriptions and dividers |
| `description` | Cell description | Icons, descriptions and dividers |
| `ripple` | Whether to enable the water wave effect | Use As List Item |
| `border-offset` | Border offset | Use As List Item |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Compare leading icons, supplementary descriptions and row separators according to information hierarchy.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Show Icon

The examples render `<m-icon-fire />` in the `#icon` slot. The Resolver imports it on demand without manual imports or registration. The string API `icon="fire"` only resolves icons already registered in the app; string values do not trigger the Resolver.

#### Show Description

The leading icon, title/description text block, and trailing content are vertically centered. Cell manages spacing and alignment for the icon slot; place the icon directly in the slot without internal CSS classes.

</details>

### Use As List Item

Example source: src/cell/example/demos/list.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const items = ref([
  {
    name: 'Vue2',
    icon: 'star-fill',
    enabled: false,
  },
  {
    name: 'Vue3',
    icon: 'heart-fill',
    enabled: false,
  },
  {
    name: 'React',
    icon: 'close-circle-fill',
    enabled: false,
  },
])
const handleClick = (item) => {
  item.enabled = !item.enabled
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-paper :elevation="2">
    <mp-cell
      v-for="(item, index) in items"
      :key="item.name"
      ripple
      :action-aria-label="`查看${item.name}`"
      :border="index !== items.length - 1"
      :border-offset="0"
      @click="handleClick(item)"
    >
      {{ item.name }}

      <template #icon>
        <m-icon-star-fill v-if="item.icon === 'star-fill'" />
        <m-icon-heart-fill v-else-if="item.icon === 'heart-fill'" />
        <m-icon-close-circle-fill v-else />
      </template>

      <template #extra>
        <mp-switch v-model="item.enabled" @click.stop />
      </template>
    </mp-cell>
  </mp-paper>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons, labels, values and extra content follow reading order, with logical start/end spacing. Explicit device safe-area and physical-position contracts do not reverse.

## API

`clickable` gives the main content button semantics, focus and Enter/Space activation. When omitted it follows `ripple`; explicit false omits the main action semantics. Use `action-aria-label` when the content does not name the action. `extra` is separate and can contain independent controls; their clicks bubble by default, so use `.stop` for independent actions. Do not nest interactive controls in the main content of an actionable cell. `title-class` and `description-class` affect only their default nodes; slot content owns its styles. Numeric `border-offset` must be finite; negative values and zero are valid, while invalid numbers use default spacing.

### Cell Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----- | -------------- | -------- | ---------- |
| `title` | Main title; overridden by the default slot | _string_ | `-` |
| `icon` | Registered left-icon name | _string_ | `-` |
| `description` | Cell description | _string_ | `-` |
| `border` | Whether to show border | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `border-offset` | Border offset | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `icon-class` | Extra class for the leading icon container, for both the icon prop and slot | _string_ | `-` |
| `title-class` | Title className | _string_ | `-` |
| `description-class` | Description className | _string_ | `-` |
| `extra-class` | Extra className | _string_ | `-` |
| `ripple` | Whether to enable the water wave effect | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `clickable` | Enable the main action; follows ripple when omitted | `boolean` | `—` |
| `action-aria-label` | Accessible name of the main action | `string` | `—` |

### Cell Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `click` | Triggered when the cell is clicked | `event: Event` |

### Cell Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ----- | -------------- | -------- |
| `default` | Main content; overrides title | `-` |
| `icon` | Custom left-icon area | `-` |
| `description` | Description content | `-` |
| `extra` | Extra of cell | `-` |

# Checkbox

Standalone Checkbox modelValue is a boolean checked state, or an array of selected option values in array mode. The value prop identifies this option; it is not the checked state. CheckboxGroup modelValue is the selected values array. defaultValue initializes uncontrolled state only and does not write into the parent.

### Intro

Basic demos follow the site language without changing business values or selection. Group demos cover accepted/rejected updates, readonly state and asynchronous option labels; removing options does not clear the model. Use `direction="column"` on the outer Space and `orientation="vertical"` on the choice group itself.

A group of options for multiple choices.

## Reading direction

Checkbox labels and groups follow source dir without reversing value arrays. Space keeps its toggle meaning; disabled and readonly behavior remains effective. Changing direction does not select or clear options.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/checkbox/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, reactive, ref, toRefs } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

const demoLanguage = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => demoLanguage.value === 'en-US')
watchLang((value) => {
  demoLanguage.value = value
})

const values = reactive({
  value: false,
  value2: false,
  value3: false,
  value4: false,
  value5: false,
  value6: [],
  value9: [],
  value10: false,
  value11: [],
  group: null,
  indeterminate: true,
  optionsValue: [],
  fieldValue: [],
})
const {
  value,
  value2,
  value3,
  value4,
  value5,
  value6,
  value9,
  group,
  value10,
  value11,
  indeterminate,
  optionsValue,
  fieldValue,
} = toRefs(values)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="value">{{ english ? 'Current value' : '当前的值' }}: {{ value }}</mp-checkbox>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.relation {
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.space {
  height: 40px;
}
</style>
```

### Group state and readonly

A defined `model-value` is controlled: rejected updates do not change the selection. `default-value` initializes uncontrolled state only. Only Group emits `update:model-value → change(value, event?)` and notifies FormItem once; children do not duplicate these notifications.
Group inherits `disabled`, `readonly` and `error` from the form when omitted. An explicit `false` overrides the form; children cannot bypass a locked group.

Example source: src/checkbox/example/demos/en-US/group-state.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const accepted = ref(['a'])
const proposed = ref([])
const readonly = ref(false)
const options = [
  { label: 'Device A', value: 'a' },
  { label: 'Device B', value: 'b' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <div>
      <p>Uncontrolled: default-value initializes only</p>
      <mp-checkbox-group :default-value="['a']" :options="options" />
    </div>
    <div>
      <p>Controlled: parent accepts updates {{ accepted }}</p>
      <mp-checkbox-group v-model="accepted" :options="options" :readonly="readonly" />
      <mp-button size="sm" @click="readonly = !readonly">{{ readonly ? 'Unlock' : 'Read only' }}</mp-button>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p>Parent rejects updates; proposals only {{ proposed }}</p>
      <mp-checkbox-group :model-value="[]" :options="options" @update:model-value="proposed = $event" />
    </div>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```
