### Complete inspection-task workflow

Fill, validate, confirm, simulate failure and retry. Returning to edit preserves submitted records.

Example source: src/form/example/demos/task-workflow.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'

const fresh = () => ({ title: '', department: 'ops', priority: 'normal' })
const draft = ref(fresh())
const saved = ref(null)
const stage = ref('edit')
const message = ref('填写任务后进入确认；也可以直接提交空表单查看校验。')
const busy = ref(false)
const failNext = ref(false)
const formRef = ref()
const rules = [(value) => !!value?.trim() || '请输入任务名称']
const departments = [
  { value: 'ops', label: '运营部' },
  { value: 'dev', label: '研发部' },
  { value: 'design', label: '设计部' },
]
const priorities = [
  { value: 'normal', label: '普通' },
  { value: 'urgent', label: '紧急' },
]
const departmentLabel = computed(() => departments.find((item) => item.value === draft.value.department)?.label)
let timer
let epoch = 0
function cancelPending() {
  epoch++
  clearTimeout(timer)
  busy.value = false
}
onBeforeUnmount(cancelPending)
onDeactivated(cancelPending)
function review({ errors }) {
  if (errors) {
    message.value = '请补全必填项，任务尚未提交。'
    return
  }
  stage.value = 'review'
  message.value = '核对信息后确认提交；返回修改不会改变上次提交记录。'
}
function submit() {
  if (busy.value) {
    return
  }
  const current = ++epoch
  const snapshot = { ...draft.value }
  const shouldFail = failNext.value
  failNext.value = false
  busy.value = true
  message.value = '正在本地模拟保存…'
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    if (current !== epoch) {
      return
    }
    busy.value = false
    if (shouldFail) {
      message.value = '保存失败：草稿已保留，请点击“重试提交”。'
      return
    }
    saved.value = snapshot
    stage.value = 'done'
    message.value = '提交成功，已生成任务记录。'
  }, 500)
}
function reset() {
  cancelPending()
  draft.value = fresh()
  saved.value = null
  stage.value = 'edit'
  failNext.value = false
  message.value = '已重置，可以重新演示。'
  formRef.value?.clearValidate()
}
function fill() {
  draft.value = { title: '展厅设备巡检', department: 'ops', priority: 'urgent' }
  formRef.value?.clearValidate()
}
</script>
<template>
  <section class="workflow-demo" aria-label="巡检任务完整流程">
    <ol class="workflow-demo__steps" aria-label="任务流程">
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'edit' ? 'step' : undefined">01 填写与校验</li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'review' ? 'step' : undefined">02 核对与提交</li>
      <li :aria-current="stage === 'done' ? 'step' : undefined">03 结果与记录</li>
    </ol>
    <mp-form v-if="stage === 'edit'" ref="formRef" :model="draft" layout="vertical" @submit="review">
      <mp-form-item label="任务名称" field="title" :rules="rules" feedback
        ><mp-input v-model="draft.title" edit-mode="direct" placeholder="例如：展厅设备巡检"
      /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item label="执行部门" field="department"
        ><mp-select v-model="draft.department" :options="departments" edit-mode="popup"
      /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item label="任务优先级" field="priority"
        ><mp-select v-model="draft.priority" :options="priorities" edit-mode="popup"
      /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-space wrap
        ><mp-button html-type="submit" status="primary">校验并预览</mp-button
        ><mp-button @click="fill">填入演示数据</mp-button></mp-space
      >
    </mp-form>
    <div v-else-if="stage === 'review'">
      <h4>确认巡检任务</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>任务</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.title }}</dd>
        <dt>部门</dt>
        <dd>{{ departmentLabel }}</dd>
        <dt>优先级</dt>
        <dd>{{ draft.priority === 'urgent' ? '紧急' : '普通' }}</dd>
      </dl>
      <mp-checkbox v-model="failNext" :disabled="busy">模拟下一次保存失败（本地）</mp-checkbox>
      <mp-space wrap
        ><mp-button status="primary" :loading="busy" :disabled="busy" @click="submit">{{
          message.includes('保存失败') ? '重试提交' : '确认提交'
        }}</mp-button
        ><mp-button :disabled="busy" @click="stage = 'edit'">返回修改</mp-button></mp-space
      >
    </div>
    <div v-else>
      <h4>任务已创建</h4>
      <p>{{ saved.title }} · {{ saved.priority === 'urgent' ? '紧急处理' : '普通处理' }}</p>
      <mp-button @click="stage = 'edit'">继续编辑</mp-button>
    </div>
    <p role="status" aria-live="polite">{{ message }}</p>
    <mp-collapse>
      <mp-collapse-item title="查看已提交记录" name="saved">
        <pre>{{
          saved ? JSON.stringify(saved, null, 2) : '尚无记录；校验失败、返回修改或保存失败都不会创建记录。'
        }}</pre>
      </mp-collapse-item>
    </mp-collapse>
    <mp-button @click="reset">重新演示</mp-button>
    <small>本例使用本地模拟保存，不访问业务服务。校验、确认、保存与失败恢复由业务流程组合。</small>
  </section>
</template>
<style scoped>
.workflow-demo {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}
.workflow-demo__steps li {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--mp-color-fill-1);
}
.workflow-demo__steps [aria-current] {
  color: var(--mp-sys-color-content-brand);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.workflow-demo dl {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}
.workflow-demo dd {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo pre {
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.workflow-demo small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 12px;
  color: var(--mp-color-text-2);
}
</style>
```

### Empty markers and required validation

The API uses -1 for no selection. Validate initially shows a required error; selecting a department makes validation pass. Clearing restores -1 and validation fails again. Form supplies the recognition list, while each field specifies its clear output. Custom validators still receive the original value.

Example source: src/form/example/demos/en-US/empty-values-validation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const model = reactive({ department: -1 as number | null | undefined })
const form = ref()
const result = ref('Not validated')
const options = [
  { value: 1, label: 'Engineering' },
  { value: 2, label: 'Product' },
]
async function validate() {
  const errors = await form.value.validate()
  result.value = errors ? 'Required error' : 'Valid'
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <p>Validate the initial -1, then select a department and validate again. Clearing restores -1.</p>
    <mp-form ref="form" :model="model" layout="vertical" :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]">
      <mp-form-item field="department" label="Department" required>
        <mp-select v-model="model.department" :options="options" edit-mode="direct" clearable :empty-value="-1" />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <mp-button @click="validate">Validate</mp-button>
    <p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.department) }}</output>
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Reading placeholders and configuration inheritance

Initially in reading mode, name inherits Form's default dash, code uses FormItem's Unassigned text, nickname uses the field's Anonymous text, and numeric zero stays visible. Changing placeholders affects only inheriting fields. Switching reading/editing does not change the model. Priority is field > FormItem > Form; a custom read slot takes precedence.

Example source: src/form/example/demos/en-US/empty-text.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const reading = ref(true)
const emptyText = ref('-')
const model = reactive({
  name: null as string | null,
  code: null as string | null,
  nickname: null as string | null,
  quantity: 0 as number | null | undefined,
})
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <p>
      Initially, reading mode shows “-” for Name, overrides for Code and Nickname, and the valid number 0 for Quantity.
    </p>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="reading = !reading">Toggle reading/editing</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="emptyText = 'No data'">Use “No data”</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="emptyText = '-'">Use default “-”</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-form :model="model" layout="vertical" :read-pretty="reading" :empty-text="emptyText">
      <mp-form-item field="name" label="Name: inherits Form"><mp-input v-model="model.name" /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="code" label="Code: FormItem override" empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><mp-input v-model="model.code"
      /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="nickname" label="Nickname: field override" empty-text="Unassigned"
        ><mp-input v-model="model.nickname" empty-text="Anonymous"
      /></mp-form-item>
      <mp-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity"><mp-input-number v-model="model.quantity" /></mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ JSON.stringify(model) }}</output>
    </p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Validation results and errors

A function rule returns true to pass, or an error string/false for business validation failure. Unexpected throws or Promise rejection still reject public `validate()`, and callers must handle that exception. The current task releases validating without synthesizing a business error; existing business error messages remain. An older task's exception cannot clear a newer task's wait.

## API

Use edit-mode for editing presentation and read-pretty for reading state. The internal descriptor fieldEditModeProp is not a public Form or FormItem prop.

### Empty values and reading placeholders

Form / FormItem provide empty recognition through `empty-values`; each field defines clear output with its own `empty-value`. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Form Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `id` | Native form id; an explicit value prefixes normalized field container ids | _string_ | `-` |
| `model` | The form data object, `FormItem` reads and writes to it using `field` | _Record<string, any>_ | `-` |
| `layout` | Form-item layout: `vertical`/`horizontal`/`inline`; overridable by `FormItem.layout` | _'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'inline'_ | `'vertical'` |
| `label-align` | Label alignment | _'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right'_ | `'end'` |
| `content-align` | Content alignment shared by direct fields, editor triggers and readPretty output; independent of label-align | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'` | `'start'` |
| `read-pretty` | Independent reading toggle. When true, displays the saved value; when false, restores the current edit-mode. FormItem inherits Form when unset | `boolean` | `-` |
| `edit-mode` | Shared editing mode for form fields; when unset, preserves each field default | `'direct' \| 'popup'` | `-` |
| `label-col-props` | Horizontal label Col options, including breakpoints | _FormColProps_ | `{ span: 5, offset: 0 }` |
| `wrapper-col-props` | Horizontal control Col options | _FormColProps_ | `{ span: 19, offset: 0 }` |
| `label-col-style` | Per-instance label column style | _CSSProperties_ | `-` |
| `wrapper-col-style` | Per-instance control column style | _CSSProperties_ | `-` |
| `label-col-flex` | Label flex; unit strings set width, numbers are grow ratios | _number \| string_ | `-` |
| `auto-label-width` | Align eligible horizontal labels to their maximum natural width | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `size` | Form-control size inherited by FormItem/controls | _'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'_ | `-` |
| `rules` | Validation rules keyed by field name | `FormRules` | `-` |
| `readonly` | Whether readonly | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `disabled` | Whether disabled | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `scroll-to-error` | After failed validation, scroll to the first (`start`) or last (`end`) invalid field in document order; these values do not specify viewport alignment | _'start' \| 'end'_ | `-` |
| `scroll-to-error-offset-y` | Scroll to the position offset of the form item that fails validation | _number \| string_ | `0` |

### Form Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `validate` | Trigger Form validation | `callback?: (errors) => void` | `Promise<undefined \| Record<string, ValidatedError>>` |
| `validateField` | Validate the given form item(s) | `field: string \| string[]`、`callback?: (errors) => void` | `Promise<undefined \| Record<string, ValidatedError>>` |
| `resetFields` | Reset the value and validation message of the form item(s) to their initial value, resets all items when `field` is omitted | `field?: string \| string[]` | `-` |
| `clearValidate` | Clear `field` validation messages; omit `field` to clear all items | `field?: string \| string[]` | `-` |
| `setFields` | Set field values or error states in batches | `Record<string, { value?; status?; message? }>` | `-` |
| `scrollToField` | Scroll to the given form item | `field: string` | `-` |

### Form Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `submit` | Triggered when the form is submitted | `data: { values; errors }`、`event: Event` |
| `submit-success` | Triggered after successful validation | `values`、`event: Event` |
| `submit-failed` | Triggered after failed validation | `data: { values; errors }`、`event: Event` |
| `reset` | Fired when the form is reset | `event: Event` |

### Form Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | -------- | ---- |
| `default` | Form content | `-` |

### FormItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `field` | Field path in `Form.model`, supports `a.b` | _string_ | `''` |
| `label` | Label text; a nonempty label renders externally and disables the control's floating hint | _string_ | `-` |
| `tooltip` | Label hint (hover, keyboard focus or touch click) | _string_ | `-` |
| `show-colon` | Append a colon to the label | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `label-component` | Native label element name | _string_ | `'label'` |
| `label-attrs` | Native label attributes; for targets the control's actual id | _HTMLAttributes & Record<string, unknown>_ | `-` |
| `content-class` | Content container class | _string \| array \| object_ | `-` |
| `content-flex` | Enable flex layout; disable for custom Grid | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `layout` | Layout: `vertical`/`horizontal`/`inline`; inherits `Form.layout` when omitted | _'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'inline'_ | `-` |
| `label-align` | Label alignment | _'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right'_ | `-` |
| `content-align` | Content alignment shared by direct fields, editor triggers and readPretty output; independent of label-align | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'` | `-` (inherits Form) |
| `read-pretty` | Independent reading toggle. When true, displays the saved value; when false, restores the current edit-mode. FormItem inherits Form when unset | `boolean` | `-` |
| `edit-mode` | Editing mode; inherits Form when unset and may be overridden by individual fields | `'direct' \| 'popup'` | `-` |
| `label-col-props` | Horizontal label Col options, including breakpoints | _FormColProps_ | `-` |
| `wrapper-col-props` | Horizontal control Col options | _FormColProps_ | `-` |
| `label-col-style` | Per-instance label column style | _CSSProperties_ | `-` |
| `wrapper-col-style` | Per-instance control column style | _CSSProperties_ | `-` |
| `label-col-flex` | Label flex; unit strings set width, numbers are grow ratios | _number \| string_ | `-` |
| `row-props` | Form item Row options, including gutter, align, justify and wrap | _RowProps_ | `-` |
| `row-class` | Layout container class | _string \| array \| object_ | `-` |
| `required` | Required (asterisk + auto required rule) | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `hide-label` | Hide label | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `feedback` | Show input validation feedback, including pending async validation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `validate-status` | Explicit feedback state; otherwise derived from validation | _'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error' \| 'validating'_ | `-` |
| `hide-asterisk` | Hide required asterisk | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `asterisk-position` | Logical start/end position of the required asterisk within the field label, default start; not the form or popup position | _'start' \| 'end'_ | `'start'` |
| `help` | Help text, displayed when no error exists | _string_ | `-` |
| `extra` | Extra text | _string_ | `-` |
| `disabled` | Disabled; inherits Form when omitted | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `readonly` | Readonly state; inherits from Form when omitted | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `size` | Control size; inherits Form when omitted | _'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'_ | `-` |
| `no-style` | Remove label/error UI, keep validation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `rules` | Validation rules: function / Zod / array | `FormRule \| FormRule[]` | `-` |
| `validate-trigger` | Validation triggers; `clear` fires only for a control's `clear` action, not for `change` | _FormItemValidateTrigger \| FormItemValidateTrigger[]_<br>`FormItemValidateTrigger: 'input' \| 'change' \| 'focus' \| 'blur' \| 'clear'` | `'change'` |

### FormItem Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ---------- | -------------- | ---------------- |
| `validate` | Emitted when validation completes | `valid: boolean` |

### FormItem Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --------- | -------------- |
| `default` | Form control |
| `label` | Custom label |
| `help` | Custom help content |
| `extra` | Custom extra content |

### FormItem Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------------- | ---------------------------- | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `validate` | Trigger validation | `-` | `Promise<undefined \| ValidatedError>` |
| `clearValidate` | Clear validation state | `-` | `-` |
| `resetField` | Reset value to initial and clear validation | `-` | `-` |

## Types

```ts
type FormItemValidateTrigger = 'change' | 'input' | 'focus' | 'blur' | 'clear'
type FormItemLayout = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'inline'
```

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Maple rule protocol

FormRules maps field names to a FormRule or rule array. FormRule supports functions and Zod schemas rather than Cedar FieldRule objects; unsupported structures produce development prop diagnostics. Use FormItem.required for required validation and markers rather than a decorative-only rules.required object. Functions receive `(value, context)` with model and field; candidate saves validate a candidate model. Only true passes; other normal returns become error text through String. Promises are supported. Zod uses safeParseAsync and the first issue message.

Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate for try/catch handling. The current task releases validating and retains its previous business error, without a business-failure notification. Stale exceptions do not clear newer pending feedback. FormItem validate only notifies the latest normal boolean result. Form.useValidation, Form.useForm, Form.useFormItem and FormItem.useFormItem retain their composition roles.

```ts
import type { FormRule, FormRules, FormRuleContext } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
const nameRule: FormRule<string> = async (value, context) => {
  await Promise.resolve()
  return value.length > 0 || `${context.field} is required`
}
const rules: FormRules = { name: nameRule }
```

### Public validation and notification contract

Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. FormItem also provides label, help and extra slots without model helpers. Form manages state through the model object and field paths.

`validate(callback?)` and `validateField(fields, callback?)` await their rules, returning undefined on success or an error record by field on business failure. Callbacks only notify for a current task. Errors contain field, message, label, value, type and isRequiredError. The value remains the original field value.

submit-success precedes submit; business failure sends submit-failed before submit. An unfinished editing session sends only submit-failed. Its errors.editing contains only field="editing" and message, without fabricated field-validation data. FormSubmitError distinguishes this notice from a full ValidatedError.

These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Native reset prevents default behavior, resets fields and then notifies reset. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope.

`beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point.

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

# Grid

CSS Grid columns, spans, gaps, collapse and suffix items. Use Row / Col for 24-column Flex layouts.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Basic examples

### Columns, spans and offsets

Example source: src/grid/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"
      ><mp-grid-item v-for="i in 8" :key="i" class="cell">{{ i }}</mp-grid-item></mp-grid
    >
    <mp-grid :cols="4" :col-gap="12" :row-gap="12"
      ><mp-grid-item :span="2" class="cell">span 2</mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item :offset="1" class="cell soft">offset 1</mp-grid-item
      ><mp-grid-item :span="4" class="cell">span 4</mp-grid-item></mp-grid
    >
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.controls {
  display: flex;

  gap: 12px;

  padding: 12px;

  border-radius: 4px;

  color: var(--mp-color-white);
  text-align: center;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;

  opacity: 0.7;
}
</style>
```

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Grid Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cols | Columns per row, minimum 1 | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `24` |
| row-gap | Row gap in px | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| col-gap | Column gap in px | `number / ResponsiveValue` | `0` |
| collapsed | Collapse overflowing rows | `boolean` | `false` |
| collapsed-rows | Visible rows while collapsed, minimum 1 | `number` | `1` |

### Grid Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |

### Grid Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Layout content |

### Grid Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

### GridItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| span | Grid span | number / ResponsiveValue | 1 |
| offset | Empty tracks from the logical inline start | number / ResponsiveValue | 0 |
| suffix | Suffix at the end of the row | boolean | false |

The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether the parent Grid hides ordinary items due to collapse. Every GridItem, including suffix items, reads this shared state; it does not describe that item’s own overflow. It is false when expanded. SSR and the initial pre-mount render show every item; collapse is computed after mounting, which can change the initial layout. Offset reserves space from the logical inline start and mirrors in RTL. Span counts content tracks, while offset is included separately in the track budget. There are no custom events or public methods.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them.

## Numeric values and collapse budgeting

Numeric inputs must be finite. Existing finite-value rules remain: cols is rounded down with a minimum of 1; collapsed-rows has a minimum of 1; negative gaps and offsets become zero; nonpositive spans are hidden. Non-finite or malformed inputs fall back to the property default: cols=24, collapsed-rows=1, span=1, and gaps/offset=0. Responsive objects accept only the six breakpoints and retain valid fields; undefined is omitted. Development diagnostics use standard Vue prop validation.

Collapse budgeting follows actual DOM order. Suffix items may appear first, in the middle or last; budgeting never moves content nodes. A suffix occupies the logical end of its row, so later ordinary items may wrap. Ordinary items retain the fitting continuous prefix, while every suffix remains visible. If suffix items alone exceed the row budget, keeping them visible takes precedence over limiting total rows. Layout does not change DOM, keyboard or assistive technology reading order.

# HighlighterProvider

Provide a shared syntax highlighter configuration to code displays.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/highlighter-provider/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const custom = ref(false)
const highlighter = computed(() => {
  const prefix = custom.value ? 'Custom: ' : ''
  return {
    async codeToHtml(code: string) {
      const escaped = code.replaceAll('&', '&amp;').replaceAll('<', '&lt;').replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
      return '<pre><code>' + prefix + escaped + '</code></pre>'
    },
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义着色器 / Custom highlighter</mp-checkbox>
  <mp-highlighter-provider :highlighter="highlighter" theme="local">
    <mp-code code="const message = 'Hello Maple'" language="typescript" />
  </mp-highlighter-provider>
</template>
```

## API

### HighlighterProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ |
| `highlighter` | Code Highlighter | `Highlighter` | `-` |
| `theme` | Code Theme | _string_ | `-` |
| `tag` | Custom tag name | _string_ | `div` |

### HighlighterProvider Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Component content | `-` |

Import the `Highlighter` and `CodeToHtmlOptions` types from the package root or `highlighter-provider` entry. `codeToHtml` can return an HTML string synchronously or a Promise. The nearest nested provider replaces the outer configuration as a whole; an unset `highlighter` is not inherited. `tag` is the rendered native container element. The creator owns external highlighters and their resources; the provider does not dispose them.

# Maple Design Mobile

Maple Design Mobile is a mobile component library built with Vue 3, TypeScript and Less, maintained by 孟帅 and 吴甲明. It is the mobile counterpart to [Cedar Design Web](https://cedar.show), sharing component API conventions, interaction semantics and design tokens.

## Features

- One architecture with Cedar: consistent component APIs, behavior conventions and theme language

- Components and touch interactions for mobile applications
- On-demand imports and TypeScript definitions
- Semantic tokens, brand themes, and light and dark modes
- Chinese and English documentation and internationalization
- CLI, icons, component resolver and styling presets

## Cedar × Maple

Use [Cedar Design Web](https://cedar.show) for desktop applications and [Maple Design Mobile](https://maple.show) for mobile applications. Shared API conventions and semantic tokens carry familiar patterns across platforms, while each library adapts its layout and interactions to its platform.

## Installation

```shell
pnpm add @maple-design/ui-vue
```

## Project Packages

| Package | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `@maple-design/cli-vue` | Component development, documentation and build tools |
| `@maple-design/icons-vue` | SVG Vue icon components |
| `@maple-design/resolver-vue` | On-demand component and icon imports |
| `@maple-design/preset-unocss-vue` | UnoCSS preset |
| `@maple-design/preset-tailwindcss-vue` | Tailwind CSS preset |

## Contributors

- 孟帅
- 吴甲明

# Hover

### Intro

Style binding is performed when the pointer hovers the binding element, and the current hovering state can also be obtained through a function, which supports selective enablement on desktop or mobile.

## Basic examples

### Style Binding

The style binding is performed when the pointer hovers over the bound element, and the style binding is canceled when the pointer leaves the element.

Example source: src/hover/example/demos/style-binding.vue

```vue
<script setup></script>

<template>
  <mp-paper
    v-hover="{ color: 'var(--mp-color-white)', background: ' var(--mp-color-primary)' }"
    class="paper"
    :elevation="2"
    :width="100"
    :height="100"
    ripple
  >
    HOVER
  </mp-paper>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.paper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.image-container {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.image-overlay {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  color: var(--mp-color-white);
  background-color: var(--mp-color-primary);
  font-size: 50px;
}
</style>
```

## Interaction and control

### Function Binding

The function is triggered when the pointer hovers and leaves, and carries the current hover state.

Example source: src/hover/example/demos/function-binding.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const translateY = ref('100%')
function handleHover(hovering) {
  translateY.value = hovering ? '0' : '100%'
}
</script>

<template>
  <div v-hover="handleHover" class="image-container">
    <mp-image src="tree.jpeg" />
    <div class="image-overlay" :style="{ transform: `translateY(${translateY})` }">HOVER</div>
  </div>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.paper {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.image-container {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.image-overlay {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  color: var(--mp-color-white);
  background-color: var(--mp-color-primary);
  font-size: 50px;
}
</style>
```

### Selectively Enable For Different Devices

Considering the differences in `hover` effects on different platforms, the hover command can only be enabled on specific platforms.

#### Only Enabled On Desktop

```html
// playground-ignore
<mp-paper v-hover:desktop="{ color: '#fff' }">HOVER</mp-paper>
```

#### Only Enabled On Mobile

```html
// playground-ignore
<mp-paper v-hover:mobile="{ color: '#fff' }"">HOVER</mp-paper>
```

## HoverOverlay and helper

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hovering` | boolean | false | Hover decoration state |
| `focusing` | boolean | false | Focus decoration state |

`useHoverOverlay()` returns `hovering` and `handleHovering(boolean)` for use with directive callbacks. The overlay has no declared events, slots or business instance methods and does not capture interaction; its host needs a positioning context.

## Usage notes

### Motion

Object styles override only the supplied properties. Leaving or disabling restores their original inline values and `!important` priorities; changing the desktop/mobile argument removes old listeners.

### Motion

HoverOverlay opacity transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and are disabled when reduced motion is requested.

# Icon

Icons are independent SVG Vue components. Use the Resolver for on-demand imports and the Icon wrapper to control size, color, and rotation.

The wrapper reuses static namespace and predicate helpers from maple-shared. CSS size conversion and prop defaults remain in the UI utilities. On-demand imports retain only the helpers and individual SVG components you use.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/icon/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconCheckCircleFill } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'
</script>
<template>
  <div class="icon-demo-row">
    <div>
      <p>Resolver 自动按需导入</p>
      <mp-icon size="40" color="red"><m-icon-check-circle-fill /></mp-icon>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p>手动按需导入</p>
      <mp-icon size="40" color="red"><IconCheckCircleFill /></mp-icon>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.icon-demo-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 32px;
}
p {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
</style>
```

### All Icons

Both libraries use the same canonical names. Search ignores surrounding whitespace and case; clearing restores all icons. Larger cards wrap the complete name. Click or press Enter / Space to copy a tag. Copying uses the Clipboard API and requires a secure context and clipboard permission; failures display an error.

Example source: src/icon/example/demos/icon-list.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { iconNames as icons } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'
import * as MapleIcons from '@maple-design/icons-vue'
import { pascalCase } from '@maple-design/shared-vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const demoText = {
  basic: '基础用法',
  iconSize: '图标尺寸',
  iconColor: '图标颜色',
  rotateAndSpin: '旋转与持续旋转',
  clickEvent: '点击事件',
  iconAnimation: '动态名称（特殊场景，点击切换）',
  iconList: '图标列表 (点击复制)',
  copySuccess: '复制成功：',
  clickSuccess: '点击成功',
  searchIcon: '搜索图标',
  groupDirection: '方向',
  groupFeedback: '状态与反馈',
  groupEditing: '编辑',
  groupFiles: '文件',
  groupMedia: '媒体',
  groupCommunication: '通信与用户',
  groupBrands: '品牌',
  groupWeather: '天气',
  groupCommerce: '商业',
  groupGeneral: '通用',
}

const searchText = ref('')
const searchIcons = computed(() =>
  searchText.value ? icons.filter((name) => name.includes(searchText.value.trim().toLowerCase())) : icons,
)
const groupRules = [
  [
    'groupDirection',
    /(^|-)(arrow|caret|chevron|left|right|up|down|expand|shrink|swap|rotate|fullscreen|backward|forward)(-|$)/,
  ],
  ['groupFeedback', /(^|-)(alert|check|close|error|exclamation|info|question|success|warning|empty|stop)(-|$)/],
  [
    'groupEditing',
    /(^|-)(align|attachment|bold|brush|copy|delete|edit|eraser|filter|font|formula|italic|link|list|paste|quote|redo|scissor|sort|underline|undo|zoom)(-|$)/,
  ],
  ['groupFiles', /(^|-)(archive|book|bookmark|drive|file|folder|save|storage)(-|$)/],
  ['groupMedia', /(^|-)(camera|image|live|music|mute|pause|play|record|skip|sound|video|voice)(-|$)/],
  ['groupCommunication', /(^|-)(email|message|notification|phone|send|share|subscribe|user|robot)(-|$)/],
  ['groupBrands', /(alipay|bytedance|codepen|facebook|github|gitlab|google|lark|qq|tiktok|twitter|wechat|weibo|xigua)/],
  ['groupWeather', /(^|-)weather-|(^|-)sun(-|$)|(^|-)moon(-|$)/],
  ['groupCommerce', /(^|-)(barcode|cart|gift|shopping|tag)(-|$)/],
]
const iconGroups = computed(() => {
  const groups = new Map()
  for (const name of searchIcons.value) {
    const key = groupRules.find(([, rule]) => rule.test(name))?.[0] ?? 'groupGeneral'
    if (!groups.has(key)) {
      groups.set(key, [])
    }
    groups.get(key).push(name)
  }
  return [...groupRules.map(([key]) => key), 'groupGeneral'].flatMap((key) => {
    const names = groups.get(key)
    return names?.length ? [[demoText[key] ?? String(key), names.sort()]] : []
  })
})
function resolveIcon(name) {
  return MapleIcons[`Icon${pascalCase(name)}`]
}

async function copyIcon(name) {
  const markup = `<m-icon-${name} />`
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(markup)
    Message.success(`已复制 ${markup}`)
  } catch {
    Message.error('复制失败，请检查浏览器剪贴板权限')
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <mp-input
      v-model.trim="searchText"
      class="icon-example__search"
      size="sm"
      variant="outline"
      placeholder="搜索图标名称"
      clearable
    >
      <template #suffix>
        <m-icon-search class="search-icon" />
      </template>
    </mp-input>

    <section v-for="[group, names] in iconGroups" :key="group" class="icon-example__group">
      <h3>
        {{ group }} <small>{{ names.length }}</small>
      </h3>
      <div class="icon-example__icons">
        <mp-button
          v-for="name in names"
          :key="name"
          class="icon-example__icon"
          variant="outline"
          @click="copyIcon(name)"
        >
          <span class="icon-example__icon-content">
            <component :is="resolveIcon(name)" :size="40" />
            <span class="icon-example__icon-name">{{ name }}</span>
          </span>
        </mp-button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
@import '../../../style/elevation';

.icon-example {
  &__icons {
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: ~'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 168px), 1fr))';
    gap: 16px;
  }

  &__group {
    margin: 24px 8px 0;

    h3 {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    small {
      margin-left: 6px;
      color: var(--mp-color-text-3);
      font-weight: normal;
    }
  }

  &__icon {
    min-height: 132px;
    height: auto;
    justify-content: center;
    font: inherit;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--mp-color-text-1);
    background: var(--mp-paper-background);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 20px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--mp-color-border-2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    user-select: none;
    transition: background-color 0.25s;
  }

  &__search {
    width: auto;
    margin: 6px 8px 22px;
  }

  &__icon-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }

  &__icon-name {
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 13px;
    text-align: center;

    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    white-space: normal;
    margin-top: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
}

.search-icon {
  margin-left: 6px;
}
</style>
```

### Dynamic Name

`name` is a kebab-case name such as `arrow-left`. It only resolves icons registered in the current Vue app and does not load the entire library. Click the button to switch the name and icon together. When a default slot is provided, its content takes priority over `name`.

Example source: src/icon/example/demos/icon-animation.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { getCurrentInstance, ref } from 'vue'
import {
  IconArrowLeft,
  IconArrowRight,
  IconCheckCircle,
  IconInfoCircle,
  IconRefresh,
  IconSearch,
} from '@maple-design/icons-vue'

const iconName = ref('arrow-left')
const app = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext.app
const icons = { IconArrowLeft, IconArrowRight, IconCheckCircle, IconInfoCircle, IconRefresh, IconSearch }
for (const [name, component] of Object.entries(icons)) {
  if (app && !app.component(name)) {
    app.component(name, component)
  }
}
function toggle() {
  iconName.value = iconName.value === 'arrow-left' ? 'arrow-right' : 'arrow-left'
}
</script>
<template>
  <p>
    name 是已注册图标的名称。本例提供
    arrow-left、arrow-right、check-circle、info-circle、refresh、search；默认插槽存在时优先显示插槽内容。
  </p>
  <div class="icon-name-demo">
    <mp-space wrap align="center" :size="24">
      <mp-button @click="toggle">切换图标</mp-button>
      <mp-icon :name="iconName" :size="32" :transition="300" />
    </mp-space>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Name Changes and Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | icon name | Name Changes and Lifecycle |
| `transition` | Transition animation time(ms) | Name Changes and Lifecycle |
| `size` | `inherit` | Name Changes and Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/icon/example/demos/lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, getCurrentInstance, KeepAlive, ref } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'
import { IconArrowLeft, IconArrowRight } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'

const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')
watchLang(
  (value) => {
    language.value = value
  },
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash.includes('language=') ? 'mobile' : 'pc',
)
const active = ref(true),
  iconName = ref('arrow-left'),
  duration = ref(300)
const app = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext.app
if (app && !app.component('IconArrowLeft')) {
  app.component('IconArrowLeft', IconArrowLeft)
}
if (app && !app.component('IconArrowRight')) {
  app.component('IconArrowRight', IconArrowRight)
}
function toggleName() {
  iconName.value = iconName.value === 'arrow-left' ? 'arrow-right' : 'arrow-left'
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-button @click="toggleName">{{ english ? 'Switch name' : '切换名称' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">{{ english ? 'Toggle active' : '切换激活' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="duration = duration ? 0 : 300"
      >{{ english ? 'Toggle duration' : '切换时长' }} {{ duration }}ms</mp-button
    >
    <KeepAlive><mp-icon v-if="active" :name="iconName" :transition="duration" :size="32" /></KeepAlive>
  </mp-space>
  <p>
    {{
      english
        ? 'Inactive changes commit on activation without replay. Duration changes cancel the old phase; zero shows the latest name immediately.'
        : '停用后切换名称，激活直接显示最新图标，不重放旧动画；时长变更取消旧阶段，0立即显示最新名称。'
    }}
  </p>
</template>
```

## API

### Standalone icon styles and usage boundaries

Resolver auto-imports include the lightweight rotation styles for standalone icons. With `importStyle: false`, applications must import those styles. The UI Icon style entry also includes them; loading every icon is unnecessary.

When manually importing standalone SVG components, import this stylesheet once in your application entry when using `spin`:

```ts
import '@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'
```

`rotate` and `spin` can be combined; built-in rotation respects reduced motion. `transition` controls registered-name changes only, using milliseconds as a number or numeric string, such as `200` / `"200"`; it does not parse `"200ms"` / `"1s"`. The default slot owns content and skips name-`transition` animation. Removing it immediately shows the latest name. Custom `animation-class` should avoid overriding the `transform` used for continuous rotation and should implement reduced-motion behavior.

`name` only resolves icons explicitly registered in the current application before rendering; it does not download resources. Registration after mount does not refresh an existing icon automatically. The container's native `title` is not forwarded to its SVG. Set `title` on standalone icons for image naming, and use an accessibly named Button for actions. `click` is a notification supporting Vue `.once`; listener Promises do not manage waiting. `stroke-*` affects strokes only; filled or fixed multicolor artwork may not respond.


### Icon Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------ | ------- |
| `name` | icon name | _string_ | `-` |
| `size` | `inherit` | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `color` | Icon color | _string_ | `-` |
| `rotate` | Rotation angle | _number_ | `-` |
| `spin` | Whether to rotate continuously | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `animation-class` | Name of the transition animation class | _string_ | `-` |
| `transition` | Transition animation time(ms) | _string \| number_ | `0` |

### Standalone SVG icon props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `size` | `inherit` | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `color` | Icon color | _string_ | `-` |
| `rotate` | Rotation angle | _number_ | `-` |
| `spin` | Whether to rotate | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `title` | Accessible title | _string_ | `-` |
| `stroke-width` | Stroke width | _number_ | `4` |
| `stroke-linecap` | Stroke line cap | _'butt' \| 'round' \| 'square'_ | `'butt'` |
| `stroke-linejoin` | Stroke line join | _'bevel' \| 'inherit' \| 'miter' \| 'round'_ | `'miter'` |

### Icon Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| `click` | Triggered when you click on the icon | `event: MouseEvent` |

| --- | --- |

## Types

```ts
import type { IconProps, IconInstance } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

## Usage notes



Only resolves icons registered in the current application. Repeated name changes display the latest requested icon, and unmounting stops pending switches.

Icons inherit the host font size on both platforms. For a fixed 20px icon, set size="20" or icon-size explicitly. The size prop overrides the variable; color inherits from the host by default.

## CSS Variables

The following CSS variables support customization with [ThemeProvider](#/en-US/theme-provider).

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-icon-size` | `inherit` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-icon-spin-duration` | `1s` | `animation` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-icon-size: inherit;
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Motion

Built-in motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: reduce: content and state feedback remain, while decorative spinning, shimmer and ripples stop. Icon name changes display the latest value immediately and cancel unfinished phases, keeping CSS and JS durations aligned. Callers must adapt custom animation classes. Ripple duration/cleanup follows Ripple documentation; its historical 250ms rule is not an Icon duration limit.

<!-- Source: src/image/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/image -->

# Image

Single and grouped previews default to body-mounted viewport overlays. Only explicit `:popup-container="false"` renders inline and requires a positioned, sized parent. Only the active image's load/error settles its loading indicator; returning to a cached image does not leave the spinner visible.

Closing the preview, changing the image or changing looping cancels pending movement. Deactivation or unmounting stops movement; reactivation uses the current image.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Set `src` to render an image with preview enabled.

Example source: src/image/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-image width="200" src="/cat.jpg" />
</template>
```

## Image presentation and states

### Fit mode

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | Image width | Fit mode, Captions and additional content, Error state |
| `src` | Image URL | Fit mode, Captions and additional content, Error state |
| `height` | Image height | Fit mode, Error state, Loading |
| `preview-disabled` | Whether click preview is disabled | Fit mode, Loading, Lazy load and fallback |
| `object-fit` | Fit: fill/contain/cover/none/scale-down | Fit mode, Lazy load and fallback |
| `title` | Image `title` text, the same as with the native attributes of the `img` tag | Captions and additional content |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Use `object-fit` to control how the image fills its box.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const fits = ['fill', 'contain', 'cover', 'none', 'scale-down'] as const

<template>
  <mp-space :size="16" wrap>
    <mp-space v-for="fit in fits" :key="fit" direction="column" align="center" :size="8">
      <mp-image width="120" height="120" :object-fit="fit" preview-disabled src="/cat.jpg" />
      <span class="label">{{ fit }}</span>
    </mp-space>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style scoped>
.label {
  color: var(--mp-color-text-3);
  font-size: 12px;
```

### Imperative preview

The imperative API returns the same handle for single and multiple images.

Example source: src/image/example/demos/imperative-preview.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { imagePreview } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const images = ['/cat.jpg', '/cat2.jpg']
let handle: { next: () => void; close: () => void } | undefined

function previewSingle() {
  imagePreview(images[0])
}

function previewMultiple() {
  handle = imagePreview({ images, modelValue: 1 })
}

function next() {
  handle?.next()
}

function close() {
  handle?.close()
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space :size="12" wrap>
    <mp-button status="primary" size="sm" @click="previewSingle">预览单图</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" size="sm" @click="previewMultiple">预览多图</mp-button>
    <mp-button size="sm" @click="next">下一张</mp-button>
    <mp-button size="sm" @click="close">关闭</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Use local paths

In `.vue` files, Vue components are not processed like native `img` tags, so image assets need to be imported manually.
Here is how different bundlers handle it.

#### Vite

Automatic preprocessing with [@vitejs/plugin-vue](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/plugin-vue#asset-url-handling).

```ts
// playground-ignore
// vite.config.js
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    vue({
      template: {
        transformAssetUrls: {
          'mp-image': ['src'],
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
})
```

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<template>
  <mp-image src="../../assets/logo.png" />
</template>
```

Or import separately

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<script setup>
  import logo from '../../assets/logo.png'
</script>

<template>
  <mp-image :src="logo" />
</template>
```

#### Webpack

```html
<!-- playground-ignore -->
<template>
  <mp-image :src="require('../../assets/logo.png')" />
</template>
```

## Lifecycle

### PreviewGroup track lifecycle

Example source: src/image/example/demos/en-US/track-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const open = ref(false)
const current = ref(1)
const loop = ref(true)
const images = ref(['/cat.jpg', '/cat2.jpg'])
function replaceImages() {
  images.value = [...images.value].reverse()
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="open = true">Open / 打开</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="loop = !loop">Loop / 循环</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="replaceImages">Replace images / 等长换图</mp-button>
    <p>
      Current / 当前: {{ current }}. Navigate across the loop edge; deactivate, close or replace images. Old work must
      not replay.
    </p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <mp-image-preview-group v-if="active" v-model:open="open" v-model="current" :images="images" :loop="loop">
        <template #actions>
          <mp-image-preview-action name="Replace images / 换图" @click="replaceImages">换图</mp-image-preview-action>
          <mp-image-preview-action name="Deactivate / 停用" @click="active = false">停用</mp-image-preview-action>
        </template>
      </mp-image-preview-group>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

Preview long press500ms and double-tap recognition320ms are interaction policy, not CSS duration/close delay. Release/move/close/source replacement/deactivation/disposal invalidate stale timers; consumed callbacks cannot replay. Inactive/disposed input entries are inert. Deactivation detaches keyboard/mode observation, releases capture and clears moving; activation reads current mode and accepts fresh gestures. Scoped17 each/full Cedar35/Maple87 pass using controlled timers/MQL/events, not native touch/browser/OS proof. PreviewGroup track scheduling remains separately pending; no API/token change.

Display images with captions, loading fallback and preview. Example groups match Cedar.

### Preview Interaction Lifecycle

Example source: src/image/example/demos/en-US/controller-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
const active = ref(true)
const source = ref('/cat.jpg')
const presses = ref(0)
const switchSource = () => {
  source.value = source.value === '/cat.jpg' ? '/cat2.jpg' : '/cat.jpg'
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="open = true">Open / 打开预览</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</mp-button>
    <p>Long presses / 长按通知: {{ presses }}. Cancel or deactivate; old input must not replay.</p>
    <KeepAlive>
      <mp-image-preview
        v-if="active"
        v-model:open="open"
        :src="source"
        interaction="touch"
        :keyboard="true"
        @long-press="presses++"
      >
        <template #actions>
          <mp-image-preview-action name="Switch source / 换图" @click="switchSource">换图</mp-image-preview-action>
          <mp-image-preview-action name="Deactivate / 停用" @click="active = false">停用</mp-image-preview-action>
        </template>
      </mp-image-preview>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Previous/next preview navigation, horizontal keys and swipes follow reading direction without reversing the value array. Direction changes cancel unfinished gestures while preserving the current image, zoom and rotation. Images and zoomed drag coordinates are not mirrored automatically. Image indices retain LTR numeric display.

## Usage notes

### Image-preview group numbering

`modelValue/defaultValue` start at `1`. `open(imageNumber = 1)` and `to(imageNumber)` use the same numbering; invalid/noninteger values are ignored. `prev()/next()` retain this numbering at loop boundaries. Model events are `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`; navigation emits `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`, while external assignments do not. Long press emits `long-press(imageNumber)`; the indicator slot receives `{ imageNumber, length }`. Internal array indices remain zero-based.

Root `class` and `style` merge with the Image wrapper. Use `img-props.class/style` to `style` the inner image. Preview `open-change` is a Vue notification event: each state transition emits once, `.once` uses Vue event semantics, and returned Promises do not control loading. The typed `onOpenChange` listener uses this same event path.

## API

ImagePreviewGroup binds a one-based image number through ordinary `v-model`; `defaultValue` initializes the uncontrolled index. Panel opening uses `v-model:open` and `defaultOpen` independently. Programmatic preview options also use modelValue/`defaultValue` and onUpdate:modelValue.

### Image Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| src | string | - | Thumbnail source |
| preview-src | string | - | Preview URL, falling back to src |
| fallback-src | string | - | One fallback after a source error |
| width | string \| number | - | Root width; numbers are px |
| height | string \| number | - | Root height; numbers are px |
| object-fit | ImageFit | fill | Image fitting mode |
| object-position | string | 50% 50% | Native object position |
| radius | string \| number | 0 | Root border radius |
| alt | string | - | Image alternative text; empty is preserved |
| title | string | - | Image title and footer title |
| description | string | - | Footer text and alt fallback |
| load-description | string | - | Last alt fallback |
| hide-footer | boolean \| 'never' | false | Hide footer, or show it in every load state |
| footer-position | 'inner' \| 'outer' | inner | Footer position |
| footer-class | string \| array \| object | - | Footer classes |
| lazy | boolean | false | Use native image lazy loading |
| img-props | ImgHTMLAttributes | - | Thumbnail element attributes |
| previewed-img-props | ImgHTMLAttributes | - | Single preview image attributes |
| show-loader | boolean | false | Show default loader while loading |
| ripple | boolean | false | Enable ripple |
| block | boolean | true | Render block layout |
| preview-disabled | boolean | false | Disable image preview |
| open / v-model:open | boolean | - | Controlled standalone preview state |
| default-open | boolean | false | Initial uncontrolled preview state |
| preview-props | `Partial<ImagePreviewProps>` | - | Standalone preview options |
| popup-container | string \| HTMLElement \| false | body | Preview mount target |

### Image Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | Preview state request | open: boolean |
| open-change | Preview state request | open: boolean |
| click | Image activation | event: Event |
| load | Image resource loaded | event: Event |
| error | Image resource failed | event: Event |

### Image Slots

| Slot | Description | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| extra | Footer content | - |
| placeholder | Loading placeholder; takes precedence over loader | - |
| loader | Custom loading indicator | - |
| error | Error content | - |
| error-icon | Default error icon replacement | - |
| preview-actions | Standalone preview toolbar extra actions | - |

### Imperative preview

`imagePreview(url | url[] | options)` returns a unified handle exposing open/close/prev/next/to/reset/zoomTo/zoomIn/zoomOut/rotateLeft/rotateRight/toggleFullscreen.

### ImagePreview Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| src | string | - | Preview image URL |
| open / v-model:open | boolean | - | Controlled preview state |
| default-open | boolean | false | Initial uncontrolled state |
| interaction | 'auto' \| 'desktop' \| 'touch' | auto | Interaction mode |
| popup-container | string \| HTMLElement \| false | body | Preview mount target |
| lock-scroll | boolean | true | Lock background scrolling |
| closable | boolean | true | Show separate close button |
| overlay-closable | boolean | true | Allow backdrop to close |
| esc-to-close | boolean | true | Allow Escape to close |
| image-prevent-default | boolean | false | Prevent image context menu |
| default-scale | number | 1 | Initial and reset scale |
| min-scale | number | 0.5 | Lower scale bound |
| max-scale | number | 8 | Upper scale bound |
| scale-step | number | 0.5 | Zoom increment |
| wheel-zoom | boolean | desktop | Enable wheel zoom; automatic when omitted |
| keyboard | boolean | desktop | Enable preview keyboard shortcuts |
| draggable | boolean | true | Enable pointer gestures |
| keep-drag-offset | boolean | false | Keep offset when scale returns to 1 or less |
| show-toolbar | boolean | true | Show toolbar and its actions slot |
| actions-layout | ImagePreviewActionName[] | desktop defaults / touch [] | Ordered toolbar actions |
| previewed-img-props | ImgHTMLAttributes | - | Preview image element attributes |

When `images` is omitted or `undefined`, the group collects previewable child Images in DOM order; updating a child URL preserves its identity and position. An explicitly supplied array is the source, and `[]` means no images. Set it back to `undefined` to resume child collection. In array mode use the group `open` / `to` methods to select an image; child Images do not map themselves to array indices.

Public indices start at 1. The displayed index is clamped when data shrinks, and child reordering preserves the selected image identity. A controlled `modelValue` receives an update request when adjustment is needed; its owner can accept or reject it. No preview content is shown when the list is empty; the open state remains, so content may reappear when images return.

A previewable image exposes a named button action supporting Tab, Enter and Space. When preview closes, focus is restored to its opener when possible if focus is still in the preview or has fallen to the document body. The action is absent when preview is disabled or the image has failed. Explicit `alt=""` stays empty; a previewable decorative image still has a separately named preview action. When `alt` is omitted, `imgProps.alt`, `description`, then `loadDescription` supply the fallback.

When keyboard shortcuts are enabled, only the topmost preview handles arrow keys and Space. Inputs, editable regions and other interactive controls retain their own key behavior.

### ImagePreviewGroup Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open / v-model:open | boolean | - | Controlled preview state |
| default-open | boolean | false | Initial uncontrolled state |
| interaction | 'auto' \| 'desktop' \| 'touch' | auto | Interaction mode |
| popup-container | string \| HTMLElement \| false | body | Preview mount target |
| lock-scroll | boolean | true | Lock background scrolling |
| closable | boolean | true | Show separate close button |
| overlay-closable | boolean | true | Allow backdrop to close |
| esc-to-close | boolean | true | Allow Escape to close |
| image-prevent-default | boolean | false | Prevent image context menu |
| default-scale | number | 1 | Initial and reset scale |
| min-scale | number | 0.5 | Lower scale bound |
| max-scale | number | 8 | Upper scale bound |
| scale-step | number | 0.5 | Zoom increment |
| wheel-zoom | boolean | desktop | Enable wheel zoom; automatic when omitted |
| keyboard | boolean | desktop | Enable preview keyboard shortcuts |
| draggable | boolean | true | Enable pointer gestures |
| keep-drag-offset | boolean | false | Keep offset when scale returns to 1 or less |
| show-toolbar | boolean | true | Show toolbar and its actions slot |
| actions-layout | ImagePreviewActionName[] | desktop defaults / touch [] | Ordered toolbar actions |
| images | string[] | - | Explicit images; undefined collects children, [] is empty |
| model-value / v-model | number | - | Controlled image number, starting at 1 |
| default-value | number | 1 | Initial image number, starting at 1 |
| loop | boolean | false | Wrap when navigating |

### ImagePreviewGroup Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |

### ImagePreview Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |

| extra | Extra preview content | - |

### ImagePreview Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| open() | Request open |
| close() | Request close |
| reset() | Reset scale, rotation and offset |
| zoomTo(scale) | Set finite scale within bounds |
| zoomIn() / zoomOut() | Change scale by scale-step |
| rotateLeft() / rotateRight() | Rotate by 90 degrees |
| toggleFullscreen() | Toggle fullscreen; returns the browser Promise or undefined when unsupported |

`Image.showPreview()` requests the current image preview. The `imagePreview`, `previewImage`, and `ImagePreviewFn` service accepts a URL, URL array, or options and returns `ImagePreviewHandle | undefined` (for example during SSR). Its handle offers the 12 Group operations; paging operations have no effect for a single image. The service also exposes `close()`, `setDefaultOptions()`, and `resetDefaultOptions()`. Native `lazy` is browser-scheduled and does not promise automatic retries.

Scale parameters must be finite and positive; invalid min/max/default/step values fall back to 0.5/8/1/0.5. If max is below min it resolves to min. Initial and reset scales are clamped, changes to bounds clamp the current value, and `zoomTo` ignores nonfinite input. `close` in `actionsLayout` is a toolbar action, independent of the separate button controlled by `closable`.

### Image Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| showPreview() | Request the current image preview when available |

### ImagePreviewAction Slots

| Slot | Description | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Action button content | - |

<!-- Source: docs/importOnDemand.en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/importOnDemand -->

# Import On Demand

### Intro

On-demand import avoids the full import of components, which can effectively reduce the size of the release package.

### Automatic Import

via plugin
[unplugin-vue-components](https://github.com/antfu/unplugin-vue-components) and
[unplugin-auto-import](https://github.com/antfu/unplugin-auto-import)
Implement components to automatically import on demand, This is our most recommended way.

#### Install Plugin

```shell
# playground-ignore
# npm
npm i @maple-design/resolver-vue unplugin-vue-components unplugin-auto-import -D

# yarn
yarn add @maple-design/resolver-vue unplugin-vue-components unplugin-auto-import -D

# pnpm
pnpm add @maple-design/resolver-vue unplugin-vue-components unplugin-auto-import -D
```

Install the standalone SVG icon package as an application dependency:

```shell
pnpm add @maple-design/icons-vue
```

#### Vite

```js
// playground-ignore
// vite.config.js
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import components from 'unplugin-vue-components/vite'
import autoImport from 'unplugin-auto-import/vite'
import { MapleResolver } from '@maple-design/resolver-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    vue(),
    components({
      resolvers: [MapleResolver()]
    }),
    autoImport({
      resolvers: [MapleResolver()]
    })
  ]
})
```

The same resolver selects the UI or icon package from the component name; no second resolver is required:

```vue
<template>
  <mp-button>Confirm</mp-button>
  <mp-icon-info-circle-fill :size="32" />
</template>
```

`MpButton` is imported from `@maple-design/ui-vue`, while `MpIconInfoCircleFill` is imported from `@maple-design/icons-vue`. `MpIcon` remains the wrapper component for dynamic names and icon transitions.

#### Vue CLI
```js
// playground-ignore
// vue.config.js
const Components = require('unplugin-vue-components/webpack')
const AutoImport = require('unplugin-auto-import/webpack')
const { MapleResolver } = require('@maple-design/resolver-vue')

module.exports = {
  configureWebpack: {
    plugins: [
      Components.default({
        resolvers: [MapleResolver()]
      }),
      AutoImport.default({
        resolvers: [MapleResolver()]
      })
    ]
  }
}
```

#### Typescript configuration note

In order to get good IDE syntax highlighting, 
please make sure that the type declaration files generated by the above two plugins are include by `typescript`,
which can be configured as follows in `tsconfig.json`:

```json
// playground-ignore
{
  "include": ["auto-imports.d.ts", "components.d.ts"]
}
```

### Manual import

Each component is a `Vue plugin` and consists of `component logic` and `style files`, which are manually imported and used as follows.

```js
// playground-ignore
import App from './App.vue'
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { Button } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/button/style'

createApp(App).use(Button)
```

OR

```html
// playground-ignore
<script setup>
import { Button as VarButton } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/button/style'
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button>Say Hello</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Manual import and automatic import comparison

Manual import

```html
// playground-ignore
<script setup>
import { Button as VarButton, Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/button/style'
import '@maple-design/ui-vue/message/style'

function handleClick() {
  Message('Hello!')
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button @click="handleClick">Say Hello</mp-button>
</template>
```

Automatic import

```html
// playground-ignore
<script setup>
function handleClick() {
  Message('Hello!')
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button @click="handleClick">Say Hello</mp-button>
</template>
```

# IndexBar

### Intro

Hyperlinks to scroll on one page.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

When you click the index bar, it will automatically jump to the corresponding `IndexAnchor` anchor position.

Example source: src/index-bar/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { AppType, onThemeChange, watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')
const list = Array.from({ length: 26 }, (_, index) => String.fromCharCode(65 + index))
const active = ref('A')
const languagePlatform = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash.includes('language=') ? 'mobile' : 'pc'

watchLang((value) => {
  language.value = value
}, languagePlatform)
onThemeChange()

function handleChange(value) {
  active.value = String(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <app-type>{{ english ? 'Basic Usage' : '基本使用' }} · {{ english ? 'Active' : '当前' }} {{ active }}</app-type>
  <div class="index-bar-demo-surface">
    <mp-index-bar duration="300" @change="handleChange">
      <div v-for="item in list" :key="item">
        <mp-index-anchor
          :index="item"
          class="index-bar-example-anchor"
          :style="{
            background: 'var(--mp-tag-status-primary-color)',
            color: 'var(--mp-tag-status-primary-text-color)',
          }"
        >
          {{ english ? 'Title' : '标题' }} {{ item }}
        </mp-index-anchor>
        <mp-cell>{{ item }} {{ english ? 'Item' : '文本' }}</mp-cell>
        <mp-cell>{{ item }} {{ english ? 'Item' : '文本' }}</mp-cell>
      </div>
    </mp-index-bar>
  </div>
</template>

<style lang="less">
.index-bar-demo-surface {
  position: relative;
  height: 520px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  border: 1px solid var(--mp-color-border-2);
  border-radius: 8px;

  .mp-index-bar__anchor-list-container {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    right: auto;
    bottom: auto;
    left: auto;
    width: 100%;
    height: 0;
    transform: none;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mp-index-bar__anchor-list {
    position: absolute;
    top: 26px;
    right: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
}

.index-bar-example-anchor {
  height: 42px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 12px;
  transition: all 0.25s;
}
</style>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Deactivation, disposal and retained commands

Example source: src/index-bar/example/demos/lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { computed, KeepAlive, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { AppType, watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'

const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')
watchLang(
  (value) => {
    language.value = value
  },
  typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.hash.includes('language=') ? 'mobile' : 'pc',
)
const mounted = ref(true),
  active = ref(true),
  bar = ref(),
  changes = ref([])
let retained
watch(bar, (value) => {
  if (value) {
    retained = value
  }
})
const command = (index) => retained?.scrollTo(index)
const record = (value) => {
  changes.value.push(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <app-type>{{ english ? 'Lifecycle and retained commands' : '生命周期与保留命令' }}</app-type>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-button @click="command('C')">{{ english ? 'Scroll to C' : '跳转 C' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">{{ english ? 'Toggle active' : '切换激活' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="mounted = !mounted">{{ english ? 'Toggle mounted' : '切换挂载' }}</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="command('A')">{{ english ? 'Retained command A' : '保留命令 A' }}</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
  <p>{{ english ? 'Changes' : '变化事件' }}: {{ changes.join(' / ') }}</p>
  <div class="index-lifecycle-surface">
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-index-bar v-if="active" ref="bar" :duration="600" @change="record">
        <div v-for="index in ['A', 'B', 'C']" :key="index" class="index-lifecycle-group">
          <mp-index-anchor :index="index" />
          <p>{{ english ? 'Group' : '分组' }} {{ index }}</p>
        </div>
      </mp-index-bar>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
  <p>
    {{
      english
        ? 'Inactive/disposed retained commands do not scroll or notify. Activation restores active without another change event.'
        : '停用／卸载后保留命令不滚动、不通知；激活恢复当前定位，不重复变化事件。'
    }}
  </p>
</template>

<style lang="less">
.index-lifecycle-surface {
  height: 180px;
  overflow: auto;
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--mp-color-border-2);
}
.index-lifecycle-group {
  height: 240px;
}
</style>
```

## Reading direction

The default index list sits at inline end. Letter/item order and vertical scroll coordinates do not reverse. Safe areas and sticky top offsets retain their physical meaning.

No index is initially active until scrolling or `scrollTo` selects one. Navigation uses native buttons supporting Tab, Enter and Space. Provide readable, noninteractive content in `anchor-name`.

Identifiers use strict equality: numeric `0` differs from string `"0"`. An omitted index is excluded; an empty string is valid. Use unique identifiers; with duplicates, programmatic navigation uses the first match. `duration` is read as milliseconds from a number or numeric string; nonpositive or nonfinite values scroll immediately. `sticky-offset-top` uses the existing length conversion and refers to the physical top. A new scroll command replaces the previous one; deactivation and unmount cancel pending scrolling.

## API

### IndexBar Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------ | ------- |
| `sticky` | Whether to enable anchor sticky top | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `sticky-offset-top` | Anchor offset top when sticky | _number \| string_ | `0` |
| `hide-list` | Whether to hide anchor list | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `sticky-css-mode` | Enable native `css sticky` mode | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `z-index` | z-index | _number \| string_ | `1` |
| `highlight-color` | Index character highlight color | _string_ | `-` |
| `duration` | Animation duration | _string \| number_ | `0` |

### IndexAnchor Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------- | -------- | ------------------ | ------ |
| `index` | Index | _number \| string_ | `-` |

### IndexBar Events

| Event | Description | Callback arguments |
| -------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `click` | Emitted when an index is clicked | `index: number \| string` |
| `change` | Emitted when active index changed | `index: number \| string` |

| Name | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------- | ---- |
| `default` | Index-bar content | `-` |
| `anchor-name` | Navigation button content; use noninteractive content | `{ anchorName: number \| string }` |

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ------------- | -------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `default` | Custom index character | `-` |

### IndexBar Methods
