<!-- Source: src/infinite-scroll/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/infinite-scroll -->

# InfiniteScroll

Bottom checks use coalesced RAF (zero-delay timeout fallback), not CSS motion duration. Rebinding/deactivation/disposal invalidates old tasks and detached observers; consumed callbacks cannot replay or clear newer handles. Retained inactive/disposed check/retry remain inert; activation uses fresh binding/checks. Business request cancellation belongs to the caller. Controlled lifecycle audit:10/10 per copy, not native browser/OS or cross-document proof.

Demo scroll containers use the current theme background to keep list text readable in dark mode.

A behavioral infinite loader. It handles bottom detection and pagination status only; compose it with `List`, `Cell`, or custom content.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/infinite-scroll/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>()
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
const items = ref<number[]>([])
const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')

watchLang((value) => {
  language.value = value
})

function load() {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined
    for (let index = 0; index < 12; index++) {
      items.value.push(items.value.length + 1)
    }
    status.value = items.value.length >= 60 ? 'finished' : 'idle'
  }, 500)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
onDeactivated(() => {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = undefined
  if (status.value === 'loading') {
    status.value = 'idle'
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="scroller" class="infinite-scroll-demo">
    <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" :target="scroller" :bottom-offset="24" @load="load">
      <mp-cell v-for="item in items" :key="item">{{ english ? 'List item' : '列表项' }} {{ item }}</mp-cell>
    </mp-infinite-scroll>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.infinite-scroll-demo {
  height: 280px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--mp-color-bg-1);
}
</style>
```

## Content and presentation

### Retry on Error

Example source: src/infinite-scroll/example/demos/error.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>()
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
const items = ref<number[]>([])
let failedOnce = false
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')

watchLang((value) => {
  language.value = value
})

function load() {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined
    if (!failedOnce && items.value.length >= 12) {
      failedOnce = true
      status.value = 'error'
      return
    }
    for (let index = 0; index < 12; index++) {
      items.value.push(items.value.length + 1)
    }
    status.value = items.value.length >= 48 ? 'finished' : 'idle'
  }, 500)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
onDeactivated(() => {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = undefined
  if (status.value === 'loading') {
    status.value = 'idle'
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="scroller" class="infinite-scroll-demo">
    <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" :target="scroller" @load="load" @retry="load">
      <mp-cell v-for="item in items" :key="item">{{ english ? 'List item' : '列表项' }} {{ item }}</mp-cell>
      <template #error="{ retry }">
        {{ english ? 'Load failed.' : '加载失败，' }}
        <mp-button variant="text" size="sm" status="primary" @click="retry">{{
          english ? 'Try again' : '点击重试'
        }}</mp-button>
      </template>
    </mp-infinite-scroll>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.infinite-scroll-demo {
  height: 280px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--mp-color-bg-1);
}
</style>
```

## Customization and slots

### Custom Status

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | Scroll container or CSS selector | Custom Status |
| `bottom-offset` | Bottom threshold | Custom Status |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/infinite-scroll/example/demos/custom-status.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onDeactivated, ref } from 'vue'
import { watchLang } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'
import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const scroller = ref<HTMLElement>()
const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
const items = ref<number[]>([])
const language = ref('zh-CN')
const english = computed(() => language.value === 'en-US')

watchLang((value) => {
  language.value = value
})

function load() {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timer = undefined
    for (let index = 0; index < 12; index++) {
      items.value.push(items.value.length + 1)
    }
    status.value = items.value.length >= 48 ? 'finished' : 'idle'
  }, 500)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
onDeactivated(() => {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  timer = undefined
  if (status.value === 'loading') {
    status.value = 'idle'
  }
})
</script>

<template>
  <div ref="scroller" class="infinite-scroll-demo">
    <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" :target="scroller" bottom-offset="2rem" @load="load">
      <mp-cell v-for="item in items" :key="item">{{ english ? 'List item' : '列表项' }} {{ item }}</mp-cell>
      <template #loading>{{ english ? 'Loading more' : '正在努力加载' }}</template>
      <template #finished>{{ english ? 'All content loaded' : '已加载全部内容' }}</template>
    </mp-infinite-scroll>
  </div>
</template>

<style scoped>
.infinite-scroll-demo {
  height: 280px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--mp-color-bg-1);
}
</style>
```

## Lifecycle and edge cases

### Measurement Binding Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | Scroll container or CSS selector | Measurement Binding Lifecycle |
| `immediate` | Check after mounting | Measurement Binding Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/infinite-scroll/example/demos/scheduler-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const first = ref()
const second = ref()
const alternate = ref(false)
const active = ref(true)
const status = ref('idle')
const loads = ref(0)
const load = () => {
  loads.value++
  status.value = 'finished'
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="alternate = !alternate">Switch target / 切换目标</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / 停用与激活</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="status = 'idle'">New status cycle / 新状态循环</mp-button>
    <p>Loads / 加载次数: {{ loads }}. Old checks must not replay / 旧检查不能重放。</p>
    <div ref="first" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto"><div style="height: 300px">Target A</div></div>
    <div ref="second" style="height: 100px; overflow: auto"><div style="height: 300px">Target B</div></div>
    <KeepAlive>
      <mp-infinite-scroll
        v-if="active"
        v-model:status="status"
        :target="alternate ? second : first"
        :immediate="false"
        @load="load"
      >
        <div>Detector / 触底检测</div>
      </mp-infinite-scroll>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Usage notes

```html
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

  const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
  const items = ref([])

  async function loadMore() {
    try {
      const next = await fetchNextPage()
      items.value.push(...next.items)
      status.value = next.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
    } catch {
      status.value = 'error'
    }
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" @load="loadMore" @retry="loadMore">
    <mp-list :data="items">
      <template #item="{ item }">
        <mp-list-item>{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item>
      </template>
    </mp-list>
  </mp-infinite-scroll>
</template>
```

At the bottom threshold, the component synchronously emits `update:status('loading')`, then `load` and locks immediately. After requests, parents must set `idle`/`error`/`finished`. `retry()` emits `retry` only, not `load`.

## Error slot

Use a button for custom retry, supporting Enter/Space. Simulated requests clean timers on unmount/deactivation to avoid later writes.

Basic/custom-status/retry examples all clean simulated requests. KeepAlive reactivation can load again from idle without reusing canceled timers.

The default error area retries on click. Custom error areas can use the same `retry` method:

```html
<template #error="{ retry }">
  <mp-button html-type="button" @click="retry">Reload</mp-button>
</template>
```

## Scroll containers and thresholds

Without `target`, the nearest scrolling ancestor is resolved automatically. CSS selectors/`HTMLElement` are accepted. Numeric `bottomOffset` uses px; strings use full CSS lengths including `rem`/`em`/`vh`/`vw`/`calc(...)`.

## Composing PullRefresh

Use `disabled` to pause pagination while refreshing. Then replace data, reset `status`, re-enable and check:

```ts
async function refresh() {
  infiniteDisabled.value = true
  const firstPage = await fetchFirstPage()
  items.value = firstPage.items
  status.value = firstPage.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
  infiniteDisabled.value = false
  await nextTick()
  infiniteScrollRef.value?.check()
}
```

Hidden tabs do not load; reactivation checks automatically. Business activation callbacks may also call `check()`.

When `target` is a selector, its element must exist when binding occurs. `check()` uses the current binding and does not resolve the selector again; pass the element or change `target` to rebind. Accept the emitted `loading` via `v-model:status`, then set `idle`, `error`, or `finished` when the request settles; assigning the original `idle` alone does not release the request lock. A negative numeric offset requires scrolling past the bottom. String offsets are resolved as CSS widths: negative lengths fall back to zero, and percentages use the measurement element’s CSS containing-block width.

## API

### InfiniteScroll Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `v-model:status` | Pagination status | `'idle' \| 'loading' \| 'error' \| 'finished'` | `'idle'` |
| `bottom-offset` | Bottom threshold | `string \| number` | `0` |
| `immediate` | Check after mounting | `boolean` | `true` |
| `disabled` | Pause loading and retry | `boolean` | `false` |
| `target` | Scroll container or CSS selector | `string \| HTMLElement` | `-` |

### InfiniteScroll Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --------------- | ---------------- | ---------- |
| `update:status` | Requests a pagination status update | `(status)` |
| `load` | Requests the next page at the threshold | `-` |
| `retry` | Retries from the error state | `-` |

### InfiniteScroll Slots

| Name | Description | Prop |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `default` | Content | `-` |
| `loading` | Loading state | `-` |
| `error` | Error state | `{ retry }` |
| `finished` | Finished state | `-` |

### InfiniteScroll Methods

| Method | Description |
| --------- | -------------------- |
| `check()` | Checks the current threshold |
| `retry()` | Retries while in the error state |

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-error-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-danger)` | `color` |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-loading-gap` | `8px` | `gap` |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-status-color` | `var(--mp-color-text-3)` | `color` |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-status-font-size` | `var(--mp-font-size-md)` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-status-min-height` | `50px` | `min-height` |
| `--mp-infinite-scroll-status-padding` | `12px 0` | `padding` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-infinite-scroll-error-color: var(--mp-sys-color-content-danger);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

Document: llms/en-US/input-number.md

<!-- Source: src/input-number/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/input-number -->

# InputNumber



Long-press stepping stops on release, cancellation, deactivation or unmounting. Starting a new hold replaces the previous one. Reactivation requires a new gesture instead of resuming an old hold. CSS motion variables do not control the repeat cadence.

InputNumber edits and commits numeric values.

- A defined model-value is controlled; default-value only initializes uncontrolled state. Drafts may differ while editing. A rejected proposal restores the parent value after commit. External updates never emit user events or trigger validation.
- By default, Enter or blur commits. With model-event="input", complete numeric edits update immediately; change still represents a commit. Enter followed by blur does not commit twice.
- Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value.
- Intermediate signs and decimal points are preserved while editing. A trailing decimal point commits as a number; a lone sign/dot restores the previous value. Invalid text and non-finite numbers are never published. IME input is processed once after composition.
- Range limits win over precision. Both copies use isolated Decimal configuration; the public model remains a JavaScript number, not arbitrary-precision storage.
- disabled/readonly/size inherit from InputGroup and Form. Explicit false overrides inheritance. variant/hint inherit InputGroup. An outer FormItem label suppresses a duplicate floating label. Cedar also reads ConfigProvider for fallback size; Maple uses its existing defaults.
- Mouse/touch long press stops on release, cancel, leave, window blur, deactivation, disposal or state changes. Button mode offers larger touch targets. Arrow keys step; Enter commits.

Native inputs always use `autocomplete="off"`; native attribute bags cannot enable autofill.

## Reading direction

The numeric input inherits its source `dir`; step buttons follow reading order. Values, precision and vertical keys retain their meaning: ArrowUp increases and ArrowDown decreases. Neither values nor display strings are reversed.

### Form control size comparison

Compare Input, Button, Select, date/time fields and other single-line controls at the same size. Field variants share the height scale; Button uses outline here. DatePicker/TimePicker are panels; this example uses Date/Time fields. The example includes selected and clearable values, removable tags and long multiple selections. Select/Cascader keep the same size height with tag-nowrap. Long tag text uses ellipsis while removal icons remain available; tags scroll horizontally while clear and arrow controls stay outside the scrolling area. Hover, focus or tap truncated tag text to read its full content; dismiss with an outside click or Escape without changing the selected value. Restore values after clearing to repeat the comparison. Multiline text and wrapping multiple selections can grow with content.

## Numeric input and formatting

### Quantity controls and commit guards

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ----------- | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `clearable` | Allow clearing an editable field | Quantity controls and commit guards, Formatting and slots, Small steps and boundaries |
| `mode` | Step-button layout | Quantity controls and commit guards, Formatting and slots |
| `min` | Minimum | Quantity controls and commit guards, Small steps and boundaries |
| `max` | Maximum | Quantity controls and commit guards, Small steps and boundaries |
| `step` | Positive finite step; scientific notation supported | Quantity controls and commit guards, Small steps and boundaries |
| `formatter` | Display formatting only; does not change the number | Formatting and slots, Small steps and boundaries |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


`disable-input` prevents typing and clearing while keeping buttons and arrow keys usable. `disable-increment` / `disable-decrement` block one direction; `increment-button` / `decrement-button` control visibility and also block the hidden direction on the keyboard. `press=false` disables repeat.



`step(value, direction, event)` reports accepted changes only, with direction plus or minus. No event is emitted for rejected, blocked, hidden-direction or boundary operations, or external updates.

| Prop | Type | Default |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------- | ------- |
| `disable-input` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disable-increment` / `disable-decrement` | `boolean` | `false` |
| `increment-button` / `decrement-button` | `boolean` | `true` |
| `press` | `boolean` | `true` |

### Empty markers and valid zero

Configure empty-values and empty-value when an API uses -1 for missing data. Initially the input is blank while the model remains -1. Set it to 0 to see a valid zero; clearing returns -1. A second field clears to a valid 0, showing that clear output need not mean missing data.

Example source: src/input-number/example/demos/en-US/empty-value.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const model = reactive({ quantity: -1 as number | null | undefined })
const restored = ref<number | null | undefined>(12)
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <p>-1 means missing and renders blank; 0 remains a valid number. Clearing produces -1.</p>
    <mp-form :model="model" layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item field="quantity" label="Quantity">
        <mp-input-number
          v-model="model.quantity"
          edit-mode="direct"
          clearable
          :empty-values="[null, undefined, -1]"
          :empty-value="-1"
        />
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="model.quantity = 0">Set to 0</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="model.quantity = -1">Set to -1</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <p>
      Current model: <output>{{ String(model.quantity) }}</output>
    </p>
    <p>This field clears to 0 without treating 0 as missing.</p>
    <mp-form layout="vertical">
      <mp-form-item label="Clear restores valid zero">
        <mp-input-number v-model="restored" edit-mode="direct" clearable :empty-value="0" />
        <output>{{ String(restored) }}</output>
      </mp-form-item>
    </mp-form>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Controlled values and events

```vue
}
</script>

      >Parent accepts updates

        v-model="value"
        clearable
        model-event="input"
        @input="(next: number | undefined) => log('input', next)"
        @update:model-value="(next: number | undefined) => log('update', next)"
        @change="(next: number | undefined) => log('change', next)"
        @clear="() => log('clear')"
      />
    </label>
    <label
      >Fixed controlled value; parent rejects updates
      <mp-input-number :model-value="5" @update:model-value="(next: number | undefined) => log('rejected', next)" />
    </label>
    <p>The second input allows a draft, then restores 5 on commit. External updates never emit change.</p>
    <ol aria-live="polite">
      <li v-for="(entry, index) in logs" :key="index">{{ entry }}</li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before completion. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply afterward. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace a later edit's text or caret. Numeric updates still follow model-event, with unchanged blur/Enter commit timing.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.



`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--mp-field-caret-color` defaults to `currentColor` and sets shared caret color. `--mp-input-number-caret-color` overrides this component, default `var(--mp-field-caret-color)`.

Explicit beforeCommit waiting uses the existing loadingMode indicator and sets aria-busy on the actual input. Manual loading remains business-owned and does not imply readonly; beforeCommit guards retain their existing interaction lock. Notification return Promises, including change/step, do not control waiting.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Clear output

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

### InputNumber Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| empty-value | Clear output, falling back to undefined when omitted | `number \| null \| undefined \| (() => number \| null \| undefined)` | `undefined` |
| model-value | Controlled numeric value including null; uses internal state when omitted | `number \| null` | `undefined` |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled numeric value, read at creation | `number` | `undefined` |
| disable-input | Disable typing while retaining step buttons and arrow-key stepping | `boolean` | `false` |
| disable-increment | Disable incrementing through buttons and arrow keys | `boolean` | `false` |
| disable-decrement | Disable decrementing through buttons and arrow keys | `boolean` | `false` |
| increment-button | Show the increment button | `boolean` | `true` |
| decrement-button | Show the decrement button | `boolean` | `true` |
| press | Repeat stepping while held; approval-enabled operations do not repeat requests | `boolean` | `true` |
| mode | Step-button layout | `'embed' \| 'button' \| 'input'` | `'embed'` |
| precision | Explicit precision is an integer from 0 to 100, at least the decimal places required by step | `number` | `undefined` |
| step | Positive finite step size | `number` | `1` |
| disabled | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| error | Show the error state | `boolean` | `false` |
| max | Maximum commit bound, allowing positive infinity | `number` | `Infinity` |
| min | Minimum commit bound, allowing negative infinity | `number` | `-Infinity` |
| formatter | Editor display formatter without changing the numeric model | `InputNumberFormatter` | `undefined` |
| parser | Parse user-edited text once per edit | `InputNumberParser` | `undefined` |
| placeholder | Placeholder or floating hint text | `string` | `-` |
| size | `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, or `xl` | `ComponentSize`<br>`'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `md` |
| variant | `filled`, `outline`, or `standard` | `string` | `outline` |
| hint | Use the placeholder as a floating hint | `boolean` | `true` |
| clearable | Show a persistent clear icon while editable and nonempty | `boolean` | `false` |
| model-event | Model notification timing; change always denotes a commit | `'change' \| 'input'` | `'change'` |
| readonly | Whether readonly | `boolean` | `false` |
| input-attrs | Additional native attributes; the component owns controlled value, state, ARIA bounds, and component events | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| edit-mode | Editor mode; inherits FormItem/Form | `direct / popup` | `undefined` |
| read-pretty | Reading presentation; inherits FormItem/Form | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition set; an explicit set replaces inherited values | `readonly unknown[]` | Inherited component-family policy |
| empty-text | Empty reading text, inherited from FormItem/Form | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Direct commit and deferred save approval: (payload, done, context) | `BeforeFieldCommit` | `undefined` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility in deferred modes | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| default-open | Uncontrolled initial editor visibility; creation-only | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Deferred editor portal target; false renders in place | `PopupContainer` | `undefined` |
| loading | Manual loading presentation; remains editable | `boolean` | `false` |
| loading-mode | Indicator layout | `default / line` | `default` |

Min may be finite or -Infinity; max may be finite or Infinity. Negative values and 0 are valid. Invalid individual bounds use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to their unbounded defaults. An inverted range diagnoses both bounds and becomes unbounded, without swapping values. Input commits, stepping, and ARIA share the effective bounds; clear markers still follow empty-value.

Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` receives `{ value, previousValue }`; context provides `signal`. Synchronous void waits for done; true, done(), or fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows the operation. False, done(false), `Promise<false>`, throwing, or rejection cancels. Direct mode approves changed model values before committing, stepping, or clearing; `model-event="input"` also approves before publishing, without repeated approval for the same value. Pending work announces aria-busy and locks typing/stepping. External model/configuration/state changes or deactivation/unmount cancel stale work. Direct approval errors preserve the value and notify `commit-error`; deferred editing approves once at final confirmation and uses the existing panel feedback. With approval enabled, holding a button does not start repeated requests. Ordinary listener Promises are not approval tasks.

### InputNumber Events

| Event | Parameters / Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | `number \| null \| undefined` | Model update proposal |
| update:open | `boolean` | Editor visibility request |
| open-change | `boolean` | Editor visibility change notification |
| input | `value: number \| null \| undefined, text: string, event: Event` | Parsed numeric value and display text from user editing |
| change | `value: number \| null \| undefined, event?: Event` | Numeric commit; deferred source event may be absent |
| clear | `event: Event` | Approved clear action notification, preceding value notifications |
| step | `value: number, direction: 'plus' \| 'minus', event: Event` | Step notification after changing the value |
| commit-error | `error: unknown` | Direct approval error notification; a boolean veto is not an error |
| keydown | `event: KeyboardEvent` | Native keyboard notification with synchronous preventDefault support |
| focus | `event: FocusEvent` | Native editor receives focus |
| blur | `event: FocusEvent` | Native editor loses focus |

### InputNumber Slots

| Slot | Parameters / Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| read | `{ value: number \| null \| undefined; text: string }` | Custom reading content |
| prefix | `-` | Inner prefix |
| suffix | `-` | Inner suffix |
| prepend | `-` | Outer leading content |
| append | `-` | Outer trailing content |
| plus | `-` | Increment button content |
| minus | `-` | Decrement button content |
| clear-icon | `{ clear(event?: Event): void }` | Clear icon or button |

### InputNumber Methods

| Method / property | Parameters / Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focus the mounted editor |
| blur | `blur(): void` | Blur the mounted editor |
| select | `select(): void` | Select all text in the mounted editor |
| inputRef | `HTMLInputElement \| undefined` | Reference to the mounted native numeric input |

| `--mp-input-number-size-lg-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-lg)` | `width` |
| `--mp-input-number-size-md-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-md)` | `width` |
| `--mp-input-number-size-sm-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-sm)` | `width` |
| `--mp-input-number-size-xl-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-xl)` | `width` |
| `--mp-input-number-size-xs-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-xs)` | `width` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-active-background` | `var(--mp-sys-color-state-selected)` | `background` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-background` | `var(--mp-sys-color-surface-muted)` | `background` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-border-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-border-subtle)` | `border-inline-end`, `border-inline-start`, `border-top` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-secondary)` | `color` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-disabled-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-disabled)` | `color` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-hover-background` | `var(--mp-sys-color-state-hover)` | `background` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-icon-size` | `14px` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-transition-duration` | `0.2s` | `transition` |
| `--mp-input-number-step-button-width` | `var(--mp-sys-control-height-md)` | `width` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-input-number-addon-background: var(--mp-sys-color-surface-muted);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

<!-- Source: src/input/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/input -->

# Input

## Reading direction

The input inherits `dir` from its page or local scope. Affixes, clear actions and input groups follow reading order. Runtime changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; the browser handles caret movement, mixed text and composition without swapping editing keys. Parent rerenders preserve the native composition buffer; older selection-restoration tasks do not overwrite a newer composition.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Default length counts UTF-16 code units (an emoji usually uses 2). Default truncation never splits a valid surrogate pair; a character that does not fit is omitted entirely. For grapheme-cluster counting and slicing, provide matching `word-length` and `word-slice` functions; custom slicing remains application-controlled.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const basicValue = ref('')
const clearableValue = ref('Maple Design')
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="[12, 0]">
    <mp-input v-model="basicValue" placeholder="Enter content" />
    <mp-input v-model="clearableValue" clearable placeholder="Clearable text" />
    <div class="input-example__value">Current value：{{ basicValue || '-' }}</div>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.input-example {
  &__caption,
  &__value {
    color: var(--mp-field-blur-color);
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  &__caption {
    margin: 16px 0 8px;
  }

  &__bottom-space {
    height: 40px;
  }
}
</style>
```

### Form control size comparison

Compare Input, Button, Select, date/time fields and other single-line controls at the same size. Field variants share the height scale; Button uses outline here. DatePicker/TimePicker are panels; this example uses Date/Time fields. The example includes selected and clearable values, removable tags and long multiple selections. Select/Cascader keep the same size height with tag-nowrap. Long tag text uses ellipsis while removal icons remain available; tags scroll horizontally while clear and arrow controls stay outside the scrolling area. Hover, focus or tap truncated tag text to read its full content; dismiss with an outside click or Escape without changing the selected value. Restore values after clearing to repeat the comparison. Multiline text and wrapping multiple selections can grow with content.

### Introduction

Use Input for single-line text entry. It supports multiple variants, floating hints, input types, states, and prefix or suffix content.

## Appearance and states

### Appearance configuration comparison

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | Form Feedback, Hint |
| `hint` | Use the placeholder as a floating hint | Form Feedback, Hint |
| `clearable` | Show a persistent clear icon while editable and nonempty | Form Feedback |
| `variant` | `filled`, `outline`, or `standard` | Hint |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Choose a dimension to compare all its values side by side while keeping other settings and content identical. Change the other settings to inspect combinations; input specimens share one model.

### Form Feedback

Use FormItem `feedback` and `validate-status` for validation feedback. An outer FormItem label disables the Input floating hint to avoid duplicate labels.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/form-feedback.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-form :model="model">
    <mp-form-item
      field="account"
      label="Account"
      feedback
      :validate-status="status"
      :help="status === 'error' ? 'Enter an account and retry' : undefined"
    >
      <mp-input v-model="model.account" placeholder="An outer label disables the floating hint" hint clearable />
    </mp-form-item>
    <mp-button status="primary" :loading="status === 'validating'" @click="validate"
      >Simulate async validation</mp-button
    >
  </mp-form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, ref } from 'vue'

const model = reactive({ account: '' })
const status = ref<'validating' | 'success' | 'error'>()
let request = 0
async function validate() {
  const current = ++request
  const value = model.account
  status.value = 'validating'
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
  if (current === request) {
    status.value = value.trim() ? 'success' : 'error'
  }
}
</script>
```

## Input content and layout

### Character Limit

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | Character Limit, Prefix and Suffix, Custom Clear Icon |
| `clearable` | Show a persistent clear icon while editable and nonempty | Character Limit, Custom Clear Icon, Group State Inheritance |
| `max-length` | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | Character Limit |
| `hint` | Use the placeholder as a floating hint | Input Group |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | Group State Inheritance |
| `disabled` | Whether disabled | Group State Inheritance |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/max-length.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const maxLengthValue = ref('Maple')
</script>

<template>
  <mp-input v-model="maxLengthValue" :max-length="10" clearable placeholder="Up to 10 characters" />
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.input-example {
  &__caption,
  &__value {
    color: var(--mp-field-blur-color);
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  &__caption {
    margin: 16px 0 8px;
  }

  &__bottom-space {
    height: 40px;
  }
}
</style>
```

`max-length` accepts a finite nonnegative number or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; `0` means unlimited. Object `length` follows the same numeric constraint and `errorOnly` is an optional boolean. Invalid values use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to no limit; null is treated as unset. Default slicing counts UTF-16 code units. Supply `word-length / word-slice` together for custom counting and slicing.

```vue
    <template #clear-icon="{ clear }"><m-icon-error @click="clear" /></template>
  </mp-input>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.input-example {
  &__caption,
  &__value {
    color: var(--mp-field-blur-color);
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  &__caption {
    margin: 16px 0 8px;
  }

  &__bottom-space {
    height: 40px;
  }
}
</style>
```

### Input Group

`mp-input-group` passes `size`, `variant`, `disabled`, `readonly`, and `hint` to child inputs unless overridden locally. Use `mp-input-group-label` for attached text.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/group.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="[12, 0]">
    <mp-input-group variant="outline">
      <mp-input-group-label>https://</mp-input-group-label>

      <mp-input placeholder="First name" :hint="false" />
      <mp-input placeholder="Last name" :hint="false" />
    </mp-input-group>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

`InputGroupLabel` renders a span for content attached outside the input. Associate a visible name by matching FormItem `label-attrs.for` to the Input `id`, or use a native label with for/id. You can also provide `aria-label` explicitly.

### Group State Inheritance

Explicit child props override group defaults, including `false`. Nested groups inherit unspecified values.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/group-state.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-space>
      <mp-button variant="outline" @click="disabled = !disabled">{{
        disabled ? 'Enable group' : 'Disable group'
      }}</mp-button>
      <mp-button variant="outline" @click="readonly = !readonly">{{
        readonly ? 'Allow editing' : 'Make group readonly'
      }}</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-input-group variant="outline" :disabled="disabled" :readonly="readonly" :hint="false">
      <mp-input-group-label>https://</mp-input-group-label>
      <mp-input v-model="domain" placeholder="Domain" clearable />
      <mp-input-group-label>.com</mp-input-group-label>
    </mp-input-group>
    <mp-input-group variant="filled" :disabled="disabled" :readonly="readonly" :hint="false">
      <mp-input v-model="first" placeholder="Inherit group state" clearable />
      <mp-input default-value="Independent override" :disabled="false" :readonly="false" clearable />
    </mp-input-group>
    <mp-input-group size="lg" variant="outline" :disabled="disabled" :readonly="readonly" :hint="false">
      <mp-input-group-label>Password</mp-input-group-label>
      <mp-input-password v-model="password" placeholder="Password toggle inherits disabled" clearable />
    </mp-input-group>
  </mp-space>
</template>

const readonly = ref(false)
```

## Value model and interaction

### Default value and v-model

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | Model Modifier, Body and event contract, Native Attributes |
| `aria-label` | Accessible label | Default value and v-model, Native Attributes |
| `clearable` | Show a persistent clear icon while editable and nonempty | Body and event contract, Clear icon and manual deletion |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | Default value and v-model |
| `disabled` | Whether disabled | Interaction state comparison |
| `readonly` | Whether readonly | Interaction state comparison |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


`modelValue` is the controlled value bound through ordinary `v-model`. It takes precedence, including an empty string. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only when the component is created; subsequent user input is stored internally. Changing `defaultValue` does not reset existing text. Remounting reads it again. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue` and does not write to a parent form.

`v-model.trim` follows Vue model event rules: `update:modelValue` is trimmed during input, while `input` reports the original text after length normalization. An uncontrolled editor may retain surrounding whitespace while editing and normalizes its local display on commit; committing does not repeat the same model proposal already reported. Controlled display follows the final parent value, and `change` still denotes a commit.

For a form default, initialize the bound field, for example `const text = ref('Beijing')`, then use `<mp-input v-model="text" />`.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/default-value.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import Demo from '../default-value.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <Demo english />
</template>
```

### Body and event contract

Input notifies input → update:modelValue. Clearing notifies clear → input → update:modelValue → change once each, with one corresponding Form notification. Clearing is blocked while readonly, disabled or composing. Rejected controlled proposals restore the native content, including input types without cursor APIs.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/event-pipeline.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Editable content')
const events = ref<string[]>([])
const record = (name: string) => {
  events.value = [...events.value.slice(-7), name]
}
</script>
<template>
  <div class="input-pipeline-demo">
    <mp-input
      v-model="value"
      clearable
      placeholder="Type and clear"
      @clear="record('clear')"
      @input="record('input')"
      @update:model-value="record('update:modelValue')"
      @change="record('change')"
    />
    <p>Typing: input → update; clearing: clear → input → update → change.</p>
    <output>{{ events.join(' → ') || 'Waiting for interaction' }}</output>
  </div>
</template>
<style scoped>
.input-pipeline-demo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}
.input-pipeline-demo p {
  margin: 0;
}
</style>
```

### Commit approval

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise&lt;void&gt; allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

Example source: src/input/example/demos/en-US/commit-protocol.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref<string | null>('Project A')
const message = ref('')
async function beforeCommit(
  { value: next, previousValue }: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown },
  _done: (allow?: boolean) => void,
  { signal }: { signal: AbortSignal },
) {
  if (next === previousValue) {
    return true
  }
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500))
  if (signal.aborted) {
    return false
  }
  message.value = `Saved: ${String(next)}`
  return true
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-input v-model="value" edit-mode="popup" clearable :empty-value="null" :before-commit="beforeCommit" />
    <p role="status">{{ message }}</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before composition completes. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply after completion. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace the text or caret of a later edit or composition. Length limits and modifiers retain their existing post-composition input/commit timing.

## Usage notes

### Form presentation inheritance

Supports `edit-mode`: `direct / popup`. Inherits FormItem/Form when unset; standalone usage defaults to direct. readPretty displays plain text; popup editing updates v-model after confirmation by default. Optional before-commit can intercept saving after candidate validation. See the Form documentation for usage and comparison demos.

### Native busy metadata

When neither loading nor commit waiting is active, Input preserves native aria-busy metadata. Internal busy takes precedence over an external false hint. Setting aria-busy alone does not create an indicator or async task.
### Configuration

Input exposes these variables; see [FieldDecorator](#/en-US/field-decorator) for container appearance.

Public types: `InputEmits`, `InputSlots`, `InputExpose`, `InputGroupSlots`, `InputPasswordEmits`, `InputPasswordSlots`, `InputPasswordExpose`.

### Input caret theme

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

InputPassword forwards all Input props, events and slots. `open` controls only the deferred editor; direct mode has no editor. Initial `open`/default-`open` does not request an initialization close, and later default-`open` changes do not reopen the editor.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Input Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | :---------: |
| `v-model` | Controlled value | `string \| null` | `-` |
| `model-modifiers` | `v-model` modifiers; supports `trim` | `object` | `{}` |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value; read only at creation, never written into the parent | `string` | `''` |
| `type` | `text`, `password`, `number`, `tel`, or `email` | `InputType`<br>`'number' \| 'text' \| 'email' \| 'tel' \| 'password'` | `text` |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder or floating hint text | `string` | `-` |
| `size` | `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, or `xl` | `ComponentSize`<br>`'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `md` |
| `variant` | `filled`, `outline`, or `standard` | `string` | `outline` |
| `hint` | Use the placeholder as a floating hint | `boolean` | `true` |
| `line` | Show the border or bottom separator | `boolean` | `true` |
| `max-length` | Finite nonnegative length or `{ length, errorOnly? }`; 0 is unlimited; invalid values diagnose and fall back to no limit | `number \| object` | `0` |
| `show-word-limit` | Show the character counter | `boolean` | `false` |
| `word-length` | Custom length calculator | `function` | `-` |
| `word-slice` | Custom truncation function | `function` | `-` |
| `readonly` | Whether readonly | `boolean` | `false` |
| `disabled` | Whether disabled | `boolean` | `false` |
| `error` | Show the error state | `boolean` | `false` |
| `clearable` | Show a persistent clear icon while editable and nonempty | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; omission clears to an empty string and manual deletion is unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `undefined` |
| `autofocus` | Focus automatically after mount | `boolean` | `false` |
| `enterkeyhint` | Mobile enter-key hint | `string` | `-` |
| `aria-label` | Accessible label | `string` | `-` |
| `input-attrs` | Native attributes such as name; `autocomplete` is fixed to `off` | `object` | `-` |
| `text-color` | Text color | `string` | `-` |
| `focus-color` | Focus color | `string` | `-` |
| `blur-color` | Blur color | `string` | `-` |
| `edit-mode` | Editor mode; inherits FormItem/Form | `direct / popup` | `undefined` |
| `read-pretty` | Reading presentation; inherits FormItem/Form | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `open` | Controlled editor visibility in deferred modes | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-open` | Uncontrolled initial editor visibility; creation-only | `boolean` | `false` |
| `before-commit` | Deferred save approval: (payload, done, context) | `BeforeFieldCommit` | `undefined` |
| `popup-container` | Deferred editor portal target; false renders in place | `PopupContainer` | `undefined` |
| `loading` | Manual loading presentation; remains editable | `boolean` | `false` |
| `loading-mode` | Indicator layout | `default / line` | `default` |

Configure validation rules on `mp-form-item`; see [Form](#/en-US/form).

size/disabled/readonly inherit from child → InputGroup → FormItem/Form → library defaults. All five sizes work. `hint` defaults on but is disabled by an external label. name/id/aria-*/data-* reach native input; class/style stay on the wrapper. `input-attrs` cannot override controlled value, type, disabled/readonly or length policy.

### Input Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| -------- | ------------ | ---- | ------ |
| `focus` | Focus | `-` | `-` |
| `blur` | Blur | `-` | `-` |
| `select` | Select all text | `-` | `-` |

### Input Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `focus` | Emitted on focus | `event: FocusEvent` |
| `blur` | Emitted on blur | `event: FocusEvent` |
| `clear` | Emitted when clearing | `event: Event` |
| `input` | Emitted on input | `value: string, event: Event` |
| `change` | Emitted only when blur or Enter commits a value | `value: string \| null, event?: Event` |
| `press-enter` | Emitted when Enter is pressed | `event: KeyboardEvent` |
| `keydown` | Emitted on keydown | `event: KeyboardEvent` |
| `update:modelValue` | Model proposal; includes explicit null | `value: string \| null` |
| `update:open` | Editor visibility request | `open: boolean` |
| `click` | Native input click notification | `event: MouseEvent` |

`errorOnly: true` retains over-limit text and shows an error. Other active length limits truncate; `input` reports normalized text and model notifications follow Vue modifiers. Clearing notifies `clear → input → update:model-value → change`; the following blur does not repeat `change`.

### Input Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| ------------ | -------------- | ------------------- |
| `prefix` | Prefix content | `-` |
| `suffix` | Suffix content | `-` |
| `clear-icon` | Clear icon or button | `clear: (event?: Event) => void` |
| `read` | Custom reading content | `{ value: string \| null }` |

### InputPassword and InputGroup

| Component | Prop / event | Description |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `mp-input-password` | `visibility`, `default-visibility`, `visibility-toggle` | Password visibility; uncontrolled by default, with a visible toggle |
| `mp-input-password` | `visibility-change`, `update:visibility` | Emitted on visibility changes with a `boolean` argument |
| `mp-input-group` | `size`, `variant`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `hint` | Child Input defaults; `variant` defaults to `filled` |
| `mp-input-group-label` | Default slot | Text attachment for grouped inputs |

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-input-caret-color` | `var(--mp-field-caret-color)` | `caret-color` |
| `--mp-input-control-font-size` | `inherit` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-input-control-height` | `auto` | `height` |
| `--mp-input-control-line-height` | `inherit` | `line-height` |
| `--mp-input-control-padding-horizontal` | `0` | `padding` |
| `--mp-input-counter-color` | `var(--mp-field-suffix-text-color)` | `color` |
| `--mp-input-counter-font-size` | `12px` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-input-feedback-duration` | `1s` | `animation` |

| `--mp-input-feedback-success-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-success)` | `color` |

| `--mp-input-feedback-warning-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-warning)` | `color` |

</div>

Apply overrides to the rendered component root or the actual popup ancestor. For example, add the following class to that element and replace the value as needed:

```css
.component-theme {
  --mp-input-caret-color: var(--mp-field-caret-color);
}
```

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

### Input caret theme

`--mp-field-caret-color` defaults to `currentColor` and sets shared caret color. `--mp-input-caret-color` overrides this component, default `var(--mp-field-caret-color)`.

# Lazy

### Intro

Load when the image is visible.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/lazy/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup></script>

<template>
  <img v-lazy="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat" />
  <img v-lazy="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat" />
  <img v-lazy="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat" />
  <img v-lazy="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat" />
  <img v-lazy="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat" />
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.lazy-example-cat {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  background-size: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
```

## Content and presentation

### Background Image Lazy Load

Example source: src/lazy/example/demos/background-image-lazy-load.vue

```vue
<script setup></script>

<template>
  <div v-lazy:background-image="'cat.jpg'" class="lazy-example-cat"></div>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.lazy-example-cat {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  background-size: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
```

### Inline Attributes

You can modify the `loading`, `error` image, and `reload attempts` by using inline properties.

```html
<template>
  <img class="lazy-example-cat" 
    v-lazy="'https://maplejs.org/cat.jpg'"
    lazy-loading="https://xxx.cn/loading.png"
    lazy-error="https://xxx.cn/error.png"
    lazy-attempt="3"
  >
</template>

<style>
.lazy-example-cat {
  width: 100%;
  height: 200px;
  object-fit: cover;
  background-size: cover;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
```

### Plugin

The option to set the default `Lazy` load option is provided, which is passed in at plugin registration.

```js
// playground-ignore
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { Lazy } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

createApp().use(Lazy, {
  loading: 'https://xxx.cn/loading.png',
  error: 'https://xxx.cn/error.png',
  attempt: 3,
  throttleWait: 300,
  events: [
    'scroll', 
    'wheel', 
    'mousewheel', 
    'resize',
    'animationend',
    'transitionend', 
    'touchmove'
  ],
  filter(lazy) {
    // All properties of the context can be accessed, and some property interceptions can be performed.
    // Such as simply modifying all image addresses http-> https
    lazy.src = lazy.src.replace('http://', 'https://')
  }
})
```

## API

### Lazy Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | Loading images, if possible, select images that load quickly | _string_ | 1-pixel transparent image |
| `error` | Load failed to display the picture | _string_ | 1-pixel transparent image |
| `attempt` | Total attempts including the initial request | _number_ | `3` |
| `throttleWait` | throttle wait time, The higher the value, the lower the trigger frequency | _number_ | `300` |
| `events` | A list of events that trigger visibility detection registration | _string[]_ | `['scroll'...]` |
| `filter` | Attribute interceptor function | _(lazy: LazyContext) => void_ | `() => void` |

`attempt` is the total request count including the first request. Non-finite values fall back to 3; finite values are floored and clamped to at least 1. Cache hits do not consume requests. Assign transformed URLs back to `lazy.src` in `filter`. Public types include `LazyOptions`, `LazyContext`, `LazyState` and `LazyHTMLElement`.

Changing the source, background argument or inline `lazy-loading`, `lazy-error`, `lazy-attempt` options invalidates the previous job. Unmount cancels queued frames and preload listeners; already-delivered stale callbacks cannot update a replacement job or detached node. Background URLs use quoted CSS escaping.

Default configuration, the 100-entry FIFO cache and visibility scheduling are module-wide. Reinstall updates defaults for future jobs and rebinds pending elements to the new event list; existing jobs retain their resource options. Final teardown releases registrations and scheduled checks. `events` and `throttleWait` are plugin options, not inline `lazy-throttle-wait` attributes. Visibility uses the viewport; ancestor scrolling triggers checks without promising clipping-aware preloading.

### Hover Background

Both platforms support hoverable (false by default). It adds padding and hover/active backgrounds without changing underline. Keyboard focus uses :focus-visible independently of hoverable.

Disabled or loading links remove href / target / rel, block click and leave the Tab order, including explicit tabindex. Loading takes precedence over the icon slot, which updates dynamically.

Example source: src/link/example/demos/en-US/hoverable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-space size="sm">
    <mp-link hoverable href="#link">Hover background</mp-link>
    <mp-link href="#link">Tab key focus</mp-link>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Interaction and control

### Loading

Example source: src/link/example/demos/en-US/loading.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const ready = ref(false)
const href = 'data:text/plain;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('Example report: ready.')
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined

function prepareDownload(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (ready.value) {
    return
  }
  event.preventDefault()
  loading.value = true
  // Simulate preparation, then let the ready link use the native download.
  timer = setTimeout(() => {
    ready.value = true
    loading.value = false
    timer = undefined
  }, 1000)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space size="sm">
    <mp-link :href="href" download="report.txt" loading>Loading</mp-link>
    <mp-link :href="href" download="report.txt" :loading="loading" @click="prepareDownload">
      {{ loading ? 'Preparing' : ready ? 'Download sample report' : 'Prepare report' }}
    </mp-link>
  </mp-space>
  <p>
    Click or press Enter to prepare the report, then activate the ready link to download it. Business code controls
    loading.
  </p>
</template>
```

## API

### Native links and manual loading

Supply href for navigation. Disabled/loading links that originally had href retain the link role, remove navigation attributes and leave the Tab order. Native download, hreflang, referrerpolicy and ARIA attributes are forwarded. loading takes precedence over the icon slot. click is a MouseEvent notification using Vue once semantics; returned Promises do not manage loading. Use Button for business actions without a navigation target.

On first activation, business code prepares the report. Once ready, activation uses the browser's native download behavior. Unmounting cancels preparation.


### Link Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | Five text, icon and spinner sizes | 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' |
| `href` | Native link destination | string | - |
| `target` | Native target | string | - |
| `rel` | Native link relationship | string | - |
| `status` | Semantic status | `SemanticStatus`<br>`'default' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | 'default' |
| `underline` | Underline policy | 'always' \| 'hover' \| 'none' | 'none' |
| `hoverable` | Padded hover/active backgrounds | boolean | false |
| `icon` | Show the leading icon; icon slot takes priority | boolean | false |
| `loading` | Show spinner and block navigation/click | boolean | false |
| `disabled` | Disable the link | boolean | false |


### Link Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | ------------------------------------------------- | --- |
| `click` | Triggered when the link is clicked | `event: MouseEvent` |

### Link Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Link content | `-` |
| `icon` | Custom link icon | `-` |

### Custom styling

Customize colors, icons and focus appearance through `--mp-link-*` CSS variables.

Text colors match Button text variants: default uses content-primary; secondary/tertiary use content-secondary; colored statuses use their semantic content colors; disabled/loading use content-disabled. Both brands inherit these in light/dark modes.

Size variables: `--mp-link-size-xs-font-size`, `--mp-link-size-sm-font-size`, `--mp-link-size-md-font-size`, `--mp-link-size-lg-font-size`, `--mp-link-size-xl-font-size`. Defaults 12/13/14/16/18px. md references `--mp-link-font-size`; icons/loading icons use 1em.

# List

A presentational list. Compose it with `InfiniteScroll` for pagination.

## Basic examples

### basic usage

Example source: src/list/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup>
const items = [
  { name: 'Alice', value: '138 0000 0001' },
  { name: 'Bob', value: '138 0000 0002' },
  { name: 'Carol', value: '138 0000 0003' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-list :data="items" bordered>
    <template #header>联系人</template>
    <template #item="{ item, index }">
      <mp-list-item>
        <template #prefix>{{ index + 1 }}</template>
        {{ item.name }}
        <template #suffix>{{ item.value }}</template>
      </mp-list-item>
    </template>
    <template #footer>{{ items.length }} 项</template>
  </mp-list>
</template>
```

## Scrolling and virtualization

### Bounded scrolling

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Data consumed by item slot | Bounded scrolling, Virtual navigation |
| `size` | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | Bounded scrolling, manual usage |
| `max-height` | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | Bounded scrolling |
| `scrollbar` | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | Bounded scrolling |
| `split` | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | Bounded scrolling |
| `virtual-list-props` | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | Virtual navigation |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/list/example/demos/en-US/bounded-scroll.vue

```vue
<script setup>
const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => ({ id: index, name: 'Row ' + (index + 1) }))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-list :data="rows" :max-height="180" :scrollbar="false">
      <template #header>Native scrollbar</template>
      <template #item="{ item }"
        ><mp-list-item>{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item></template
      >
    </mp-list>
    <mp-list :data="rows" max-height="12rem" :scrollbar="{ type: 'track' }" size="sm" :split="false">
      <template #header>Custom scrollbar without separators</template>
      <template #item="{ item }"
        ><mp-list-item>{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item></template
      >
    </mp-list>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Virtual navigation

The demo uses `Space direction="column"` to place controls above a full-width list. `estimatedSize` estimates unmeasured rows; application rows do not need a fixed height.

Navigation uses rendered row bounds when available and updates virtual padding after measurement. Programmatic scroll events preserve the current alignment while rendering rows; a different native scroll position, a new command, data replacement, deactivation or disposal cancels its deferred correction. `auto` leaves a fully visible row and the rendered window unchanged. Observed root size changes update measurements where `ResizeObserver` is available; arbitrary layout changes are not continuously tracked.

Example source: src/list/example/demos/en-US/virtual-navigation.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const list = ref()
const rows = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (_, id) => ({ id, name: 'Row ' + (id + 1) }))
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-space wrap>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'top' })">Row 500 at top</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'bottom' })">Row 500 at bottom</mp-button>
      <mp-button @click="list.scrollIntoView({ key: 499, align: 'auto' })">Scroll only if needed</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-list
      ref="list"
      :data="rows"
      :virtual-list-props="{ height: 240, itemKey: 'id', estimatedSize: 48, buffer: 10 }"
    >
      <template #item="{ item, index }"
        ><mp-list-item
          ><template #prefix>{{ index + 1 }}</template
          >{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item
        ></template
      >
    </mp-list>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### manual usage

```vue
<script setup>
const items = [
  { name: 'Alice', value: '138 0000 0001' },
  { name: 'Bob', value: '138 0000 0002' },
  { name: 'Carol', value: '138 0000 0003' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-list size="lg">
    <mp-list-item v-for="item in items" :key="item.name">{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item>
  </mp-list>
</template>
```

## Lifecycle

### Lifecycle

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | Data consumed by item slot | Lifecycle |
| `virtual-list-props` | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | Lifecycle |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Example source: src/list/example/demos/en-US/virtual-lifecycle.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(true)
const mounted = ref(true)
const rows = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, key) => ({ key }))
let retained
const capture = (instance) => {
  if (instance) {
    retained = instance
  }
}
const jump = () => retained?.scrollIntoView({ key: 50, align: 'top' })
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <mp-button @click="active = !active">Activate / deactivate</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="mounted = !mounted">Mount / dispose cache</mp-button>
    <mp-button @click="jump">Retained command: row 51</mp-button>
    <p>Inactive/disposed commands do nothing. Activation never replays them.</p>
    <KeepAlive v-if="mounted">
      <mp-list
        v-if="active"
        :ref="capture"
        :data="rows"
        :virtual-list-props="{ height: 100, fixedSize: true, estimatedSize: 20, buffer: 2, itemKey: 'key' }"
      >
        <template #item="{ item }"
          ><div style="height: 20px">{{ item.key + 1 }}</div></template
        >
      </mp-list>
    </KeepAlive>
  </div>
</template>
```

`scrollIntoView` forwards options to the internal VirtualList `scrollTo` only in virtual mode; it is not a direct native DOM scrollIntoView or a local motion timer. Native scrolling, preferences and retained-command lifecycle require a separate VirtualList consumer audit. Source hints are not visual acceptance; this classification changes no List API/implementation.

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport first and renders `buffer` items beyond it on each side. `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated heights and observes mounted measurable roots when `ResizeObserver` is available. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data; it may return multiple measurable roots, whose combined bounds are measured as one item. Provide a stable `itemKey`. To convey the complete collection to assistive technology, provide `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` on application rows as appropriate.

Server rendering currently fails when `v-for` and `v-memo` occur on the same node inside the `default`, `header`, `footer`, `empty` or `item` slot, with or without virtualization in data mode. As a temporary workaround, remove `v-memo` from that node and verify the update behavior.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.
