# LoadingBar

CSS motion variables control progress-bar and fade transitions. Completion and cleanup wait for the visual transition; CSS styling does not control progress-update timing.

The service uses --mp-loading-bar-transition-duration (250ms) and --mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function (ease) for width/opacity/background-color. Apply tokens to its real html/body ancestor, not a business card. Reduce disables transitions, not progress/cleanup. After DOM flush, hiding waits max(300ms, resolved width duration+delay); unmounting waits max(250ms, resolved opacity duration+delay). The 200ms show/tick and cleanup floors are scheduling policies, not CSS tokens; later arbitrary CSS changes/custom animation are not promised.

Repeated finish is deduplicated; start/error cancel obsolete tasks. Completion unmounts the service and the next load remounts. setDefaultOptions replaces the full configuration and resetDefaultOptions clears owned settings. SSR calls create no DOM/timers.

### Intro

Display loading progress at the top of the page.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/loading-bar/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { AppType, onThemeChange } from '@maple-design/cli-vue/client'
import { LoadingBar } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const hasCustomStyle = ref(false)

onThemeChange()

LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions({
  top: '54px',
})

function setStyle() {
  if (hasCustomStyle.value) {
    LoadingBar.resetDefaultOptions()
  } else {
    LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions({
      top: '54px',
      errorColor: '#ff8800',
      color: '#10afef',
      height: '5px',
    })
  }

  hasCustomStyle.value = !hasCustomStyle.value
}
</script>

<template>
  <app-type>基本使用</app-type>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.start()">开始</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.finish()">结束</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="LoadingBar.error()">错误</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="setStyle">{{ hasCustomStyle ? '清除样式' : '设置样式' }}</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Reading direction

The loading bar grows from the document's inline start. Direction changes do not alter timers, progress or completion. Programmatic calls use document direction.

## Usage notes

### Configuration

Repeated finish deduplicates; start/error cancel old tasks. Completion unmounts the service; the next call remounts it. setDefaultOptions replaces the entire config; resetDefaultOptions clears all options. SSR creates no DOM/timers.

After Teleport, theme variables follow actual DOM ancestors. Variables inside content do not propagate upward to service-created containers.

When importing on demand, also import `@maple-design/ui-vue/loading-bar/style`, or use the full stylesheet `@maple-design/ui-vue/style`.

## API

### LoadingBar Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments | Returns |
| --------------------- | ---------- | -- | --------- |
| `LoadingBar.start` | Start loading | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.finish` | Finish loading | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.error` | Loading error | `-` | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.setDefaultOptions` | Set default option configuration | _options: LoadingBarOptions_ | `-` |
| `LoadingBar.resetDefaultOptions` | Reset default option configuration | _-_ | `-` |

### LoadingBar Options

Use `LoadingBarOptions` for service configuration; `LoadingBarProps` describes internal view props and does not include `finishDelay`.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | -------------- | ----------- | -------- |
| `color` | LoadingBar color | _string_ | `-` |
| `errorColor` | LoadingBar error color | _string_ | `-` |
| `height` | LoadingBar height | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `top` | LoadingBar top | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `finishDelay` ***3.3.13*** | The delay time of the finish function, which can be used to increase the duration of loading animation | _number_ | `-` |

## CSS Variables

Ordinary/error progress bars use readable content-brand/content-danger rather than action/status fills, keeping thin lines visible on ordinary surfaces. color/errorColor override defaults. Recheck custom background/color contrast. Height remains 3px.

Motion variables control width/opacity/background-color; reduce disables transitions. Finishing waits max(300ms, computed width duration+delay) before hiding, then max(250ms, opacity duration+delay) before unmounting. Long overrides are not truncated at 250ms; explicit zero retains cleanup floors. 200ms display/progress ticks are scheduling policy, not CSS tokens. Timing is sampled after DOM updates at each phase, without guaranteeing arbitrary mid-wait CSS changes/custom animations.

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-loading-bar-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-brand)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-error-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-danger)` | `background-color` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-height` | `3px` | `height` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-transition-duration` | `250ms` | `transition` |
| `--mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function` | `ease` | `transition` |

</div>

When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. Override the component variable directly for local styling; root-level aliases are not recalculated merely because a descendant system variable changes. Internal variables are not public APIs.

## Content and presentation

### Loading Directive

The two directive examples keep independent loading states. Their controls and host cards are stacked using Space's `direction="column"`; turning one off leaves the other overlay unchanged.


`v-mp-loading` accepts a boolean shorthand or a `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }` options object. In object form, `loading` controls the loading state and the remaining component options match `Loading` props.

#### Registration

`v-mp-loading` renders its indicator with Maple's built-in `Loading` component. The `mp-` prefix avoids collisions with directives from other component libraries. Register it using any one of these approaches.


With `MapleResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves `v-mp-loading` automatically. Set `directives: false` to disable directive resolution.

> Wrapper mode applies `opacity: 0.38` to its default-slot content. Because the directive preserves the host DOM, it inserts the built-in Loading VNode and uses an equivalent translucent background overlay instead.

Example source: src/loading/example/demos/directive.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loading = ref(false)
const simpleDirectiveLoading = ref(false)
const configuredDirectiveLoading = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <h4 class="loading-demo__title">简单用法</h4>
    <mp-switch v-model="simpleDirectiveLoading" edit-mode="direct" />
    <mp-card
      v-mp-loading="simpleDirectiveLoading"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-mp-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />

    <h4 class="loading-demo__title">复杂配置</h4>
    <mp-switch v-model="configuredDirectiveLoading" edit-mode="direct" />
    <mp-card
      v-mp-loading="{
        loading: configuredDirectiveLoading,
        tip: '加载中...',
        color: 'var(--mp-color-primary)',
        background: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--mp-color-bg-white) 72%, transparent)',
      }"
      title="介绍"
      description="v-mp-loading 会在当前容器内渲染 Loading 遮罩，不会改变内容结构。"
    />
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.loading-demo .mp-space {
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.loading-demo__title {
  margin: 12px 0 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
</style>
```

## Usage notes

### Icons and status messages

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font size in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--mp-loading-indicator-size` font size (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own size. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-busy) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).
### Configuration

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

Content-overlay class: `.mp-loading__content-overlay`.

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

## API

### Loading Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | -------- |
| `color` | Loading color | _string_ | `-` |
| `type` | Can be set to `circle` `wave` `cube` `rect` `disappear` | _string_ | `circle` |
| `size` | Can be set to `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl`, or a number | _string \| number_ | `md` |
| `tip` | Tip of the loading | _string_ | `-` |
| `loading` | Specify whether loading is active | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `radius` | Set radius size when the `type` is `circle` | _string \| number_ | `-` |
| `hide-icon` | Whether to hide the loading indicator | _boolean_ | `false` |

### Loading Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ---- |
| `default` | Content wrapped in `loading` | `-` |
| `tip` | Tip of the `loading` | `-` |
| `icon` | Custom loading indicator | `-` |

The `icon` slot replaces every built-in `type` animation instead of rendering alongside it. `hide-icon=true` hides all indicators while allowing tip content to remain visible.

# LocaleProvider

Set locale and messages for a subtree without changing the rest of the page.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Example source: src/locale-provider/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const custom = ref(false)
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '暂无数据' },
  'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'No data' },
}
const activeMessages = computed(() =>
  custom.value
    ? {
        'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '自定义暂无数据' },
        'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'Custom no data' },
      }
    : messages,
)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义语言包 / Custom messages</mp-checkbox>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="zh-CN" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="en-US" :messages="activeMessages">
    <mp-empty />
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

## API

### LocaleProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| `locale` | Current locale | _string_ | `zh-CN` |
| `messages` | Language messages | _`Record<string, Partial<Message>>`_ | `-` |
| `dir` | Reading direction; inherits when omitted | _'ltr' \| 'rtl'_ | `-` |
| `tag` | Custom tag name | _string_ | `div` |

### LocaleProvider Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Component content | `-` |


## Reading direction

`<mp-locale-provider dir="rtl">` supplies a reading-direction scope independently of locale. Omit dir to inherit; nested `dir="ltr"` and native DOM dir containers provide local overrides. Popup content retains the source scope after teleporting. Physical left/right API values and media content keep their original semantics.

### Language fallback and scope

`messages` maps language names to packs, and `locale` must match a pack in the current scope. Each key resolves to its own value in the selected local pack, then the nearest parent LocaleProvider, then the current global Locale. Missing packs or keys and `null`/`undefined` fall through; explicit empty strings are preserved. `Message` contains text and dictionaries such as calendar months and weekdays, so it is not a plain string map. Import `Message` from `@maple-design/ui-vue/locale`.

Setting only `dir` preserves messages; nested local packs can override individual keys. Components inherit their calling scope through Vue injection, including across Teleport. Function services that create separate applications do not automatically inherit a page LocaleProvider; use the service context/configuration entry or global Locale. This component has no dedicated events or instance methods.
## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

This component declares no independent public CSS variables. Use the configuration and layout APIs documented on this page.

Internal custom properties and measurement values are implementation details and are not customization APIs.

<!-- component-css-variables:end -->

<!-- Source: src/locale/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/locale -->

# Locale

### Intro

Component library uses Chinese as the default language, support multi-language switch.

### Multi-language Switch (Functional)

`Locale.add` is used for language mounted.

```js
// playground-ignore
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

Locale.add('en-US', Locale.enUS)
```

Use `Locale.merge` to override languages.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.merge('en-US', {
  dialogTitle: 'Hello'
})
```

Use `Locale.use` to switch language.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.use('en-US')
```

### Multi-language Switch (Component declarative)

```html
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const date = ref('2021-04-08')
const locale = ref('zh-CN')
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': Locale.zhCN,
  'en-US': Locale.enUS
}

function switchLocale() {
  locale.value = locale.value === 'zh-CN' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN'
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-locale-provider :locale="locale" :messages="messages">
    <mp-date-picker v-model="date" />
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="switchLocale">Switch</mp-button>
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

### Notes

- `Locale.use` operates on a singleton language instance context. Do not call it on the server. It is recommended for client-side rendering scenarios.
- `LocaleProvider` is only valid for the sub-components it wraps, and is invalid for functional calls to components. It is recommended for server-side rendering scenarios.

### Currently Supported Languages

| Language Name | Language Code | Language Pack | Supported Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Chinese` | zh-CN | _Locale.zhCN_ | `v2.0.0` |
| `English` | en-US | _Locale.enUS_ | `v2.0.0` |
| `Traditional Chinese (TW)` | zh-TW | _Locale.zhTW_ | `v2.17.0` |
| `Traditional Chinese (HK)` | zh-HK | _Locale.zhHK_ | `v2.17.0` |
| `Farsi` | fa-IR | _Locale.faIR_ | `v2.22.0` |
| `Japanese` | ja-JP | _Locale.jaJP_ | `v3.9.0` |

## Basic examples

### Local language comparison

Example source: src/locale-provider/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue

const messages = {
  'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '暂无数据' },
  'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'No data' },
}
const activeMessages = computed(() =>
  custom.value
    ? {
        'zh-CN': { emptyDescription: '自定义暂无数据' },
        'en-US': { emptyDescription: 'Custom no data' },
      }
    : messages,
)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-checkbox v-model="custom">自定义语言包 / Custom messages</mp-checkbox>
  <mp-locale-provider locale="zh-CN" :messages="activeMessages">

  </mp-locale-provider>
```

## API

### LocaleProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| -------------- | --------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| `locale` | Current locale | _string_ | `zh-CN` |
| `messages` | Language messages | _Record<string, Record<string, string>>_ | `-` |
| `tag` | Custom tag name | _string_ | `div` |

### LocaleProvider Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Component content | `-` |

### Global and independent instances

The root `Locale` is a global singleton with only `zh-CN` registered and active by default. Add another built-in language with `Locale.add` before selecting it with `Locale.use`. Japanese is available as `Locale.jaJP`; the `locale` entry has no separate named `jaJP` export. `Locale.useLocale()` (or the named `useLocale` export from `@maple-design/ui-vue/locale`) creates an independent instance; it differs from Cedar's global language-switching function of the same name.

`add(lang, message)` writes `lang` to the supplied object. After replacing the current language's data, call `use` again to update the current reference. `merge(lang, partial)` shallow-merges and selects that language. `t` looks up a complete key, returns `undefined` for missing keys, and does not provide generic interpolation or nested-path lookup. Changing language does not automatically change reading direction.

# Menu

Collects transient commands for the current object, such as overflow actions, context menus and the extra actions of a button. Use [Select](#/en-US/select) to pick form data and [Cascader](#/en-US/cascader) to pick hierarchical data.

Use `placement` to choose the popup direction, defaulting to `bottom`; `cover` controls overlap with the trigger. Use `auto-fit-popup-width` to match trigger width and `popup-max-height` to limit menu height.

## Basic examples

### Overflow Actions

Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/overflow-actions.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { IconMore } from '@maple-design/icons-vue'

const actionOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: '编辑', value: 'edit' },
  { label: '复制', value: 'copy' },
  { type: 'divider' },
  { label: '删除', value: 'delete' },
])
</script>

<template>
  <mp-menu :options="actionOptions">
    <mp-button variant="tonal" :elevation="false" aria-label="更多操作"
      ><template #icon>
        <mp-icon><IconMore /></mp-icon></template
    ></mp-button>
  </mp-menu>
</template>

<style>
.menu-example-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 160px;
  background-color: var(--mp-color-fill-2);
}

.menu-example-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
}
</style>
```

## Options and hierarchy

### Groups, submenus and option content

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Option Group

Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level.

#### Submenu

A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles.

#### Custom Option Content

Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots.

`active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.

</details>

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/structure-comparison.vue


### Selection and visual emphasis

`active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/active-rendering.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { MenuRenderContext } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const selectedValue = ref('account')
const status = ({ active }: MenuRenderContext) => (active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中')
const options = [
  {
    label: '设置',
    value: 'settings',
    extra: status,
    children: [
      { label: '账户', value: 'account', extra: status },
      { label: '通知', value: 'notifications', extra: status },
    ],
  },
  { label: '帮助', value: 'help', extra: status },
]
const helpLabel = ({ active }: MenuRenderContext) => (active ? '帮助（已选中）' : '帮助（未选中，仅视觉强调）')
</script>

<template>
  <p>当前值：{{ selectedValue }}。默认选中“账户”；父分支“设置”处于选中路径，但 active=false。</p>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>渲染函数中的 active</mp-button>
    </mp-menu>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :options="options" :hide-on-select="false" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>作用域插槽中的 active</mp-button>
      <template #option-extra="{ active }">
        <mp-tag :status="active ? 'primary' : 'default'">{{ active ? '当前项已选中' : '当前项未选中' }}</mp-tag>
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
    <mp-menu v-model="selectedValue" :hide-on-select="false">
      <mp-button>自定义子项与 highlight</mp-button>
      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option value="account">
          <template #default="{ active }">账户：{{ active ? '已选中' : '未选中' }}</template>
        </mp-menu-option>
        <mp-menu-option value="help" :label="helpLabel" highlight />
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Option values

Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values.

## Triggers and positioning

### Context Menu

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger |
| `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy |
| `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement |
| `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | Positioning strategy |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Positioning strategy |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


Right click inside the target area. Set both `trigger="contextMenu"` and `align-point`. The menu stays at the activation point as the pointer moves; another right click updates its position.

### Placement
Use `placement` to choose the preferred popup position relative to the trigger. See Menu Props for the available values. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/placement.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const placements = ['bottom-start', 'bottom', 'bottom-end', 'top-start', 'top', 'top-end'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-menu v-for="placement in placements" :key="placement" :placement="placement">
      <mp-button>{{ placement }}</mp-button>

      <template #content>
        <mp-menu-option label="Option 1" />
        <mp-menu-option label="Option 2" />
        <mp-menu-option label="Option 3" />
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.menu-example-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 160px;
  background-color: var(--mp-color-fill-2);
}

.menu-example-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
}
</style>
```

### Positioning strategy

Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { MenuStrategy } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const strategy = ref<MenuStrategy>('fixed')
const options = [
  {
    label: 'Actions',
    children: [
      {
        label: 'Export',
        children: [
          { label: 'CSV', value: 'csv' },
          { label: 'JSON', value: 'json' },
        ],
      },
      { label: 'Copy', value: 'copy' },
    ],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-button @click="strategy = strategy === 'fixed' ? 'absolute' : 'fixed'">
      Toggle positioning：{{ strategy }}
    </mp-button>
    <mp-menu :strategy="strategy" :options="options" submenu-trigger="click">
      <mp-button>Open three-level menu</mp-button>
      <template #footer>
        <mp-button variant="text" @click.stop="strategy = strategy === 'fixed' ? 'absolute' : 'fixed'">
          Switch while open：{{ strategy }}
        </mp-button>
      </template>
    </mp-menu>
    <small
      >The strategy applies to every submenu. The mounting container is controlled separately by popup-container.</small
    >
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Switching triggers

Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open.

## State and content customization

### Selected Value and Select Event

Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Activating a command emits `update:model-value` first and then `select(value, option, event)`; `select` means a menu item was activated, not that a form value changed.

Example source: src/menu/example/demos/selection.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref('edit')
const selectedLabel = ref('编辑')
const selectionOptions = computed(() => [
  { label: '编辑', value: 'edit' },
  { label: '复制', value: 'copy' },
  { label: '删除', value: 'delete' },
])
const handleSelect = (_value: unknown, option: { label?: unknown }) => {
  selectedLabel.value = String(option.label ?? '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column">
    <mp-menu v-model="active" :options="selectionOptions" @select="handleSelect">
      <mp-button>{{ selectedLabel || '请选择操作' }}</mp-button>
    </mp-menu>
    <span>当前值：{{ active || '-' }}，最近选择：{{ selectedLabel || '-' }}</span>
  </mp-space>
</template>

<style>
.menu-example-area {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 160px;
  background-color: var(--mp-color-fill-2);
}

.menu-example-footer {
  padding: 8px 12px;
}
</style>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection.

## Keyboard interaction

Enter, Space or an arrow key opens the menu from its trigger. Up/Down and Home/End move between enabled options; Enter or Space activates an option. The forward key enters a submenu and the backward key returns, following the reading direction. Escape requests closing the topmost menu; focus returns to its trigger after closing. Tab requests close and continues browser focus navigation. Editable inputs retain their text-editing keys.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence. Initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

### Menu Props

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | Command tree | _MenuOption[]_ | `[]` |
| `field-names` | `label/value/children/disabled` field mapping | _MenuFieldNames_ | `-` |
| `v-model` | Active value | _MenuValue_ | `-` |
| `v-model:open` | Whether the popup is visible | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `default-open` | Uncontrolled default visibility | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `size` | Option size | _'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'_ | `'md'` |
| `trigger` | Root menu trigger | _'click' \| 'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'_ | `'click'` |
| `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | _'click' \| 'hover'_ | `'click'` |
| `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `MenuPlacement`<br>`'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `'bottom'` |
| `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | _'absolute' \| 'fixed'_ | `'absolute'` |
| `reference` | External trigger element | _string \| HTMLElement_ | `-` |
| `popup-container` | Popup mount container | _string \| HTMLElement \| false_ | `-` |
| `popup-class` | Popup class name | _string \| array \| object_ | `-` |
| `popup-max-height` | Default limit, pixel height, or unlimited | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |
| `offset-x` | Horizontal offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `offset-y` | Vertical offset | _string \| number_ | `0` |
| `mouse-enter-delay` | Hover open delay in ms | _number_ | `100` |
| `mouse-leave-delay` | Hover close delay in ms | _number_ | `100` |
| `close-on-click-reference` | Close when the trigger is clicked again | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `unmount-on-close` | Unmount popup content on close | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `auto-fit-popup-width` | Match the trigger width | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `cover` | Popup covers the trigger | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `disabled` | Disable the menu | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `elevation` | Popup shadow level | _boolean \| number_ | `true` |

### Menu Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:model-value` | Active value update request | `value: MenuValue` |
| `select` | A menu item was activated | `value, option, event` |
| `open-change` | Visibility update request | `open: boolean` |
| `open` / `opened` | Popup starts opening / finished opening | `-` |
| `close` / `closed` | Popup starts closing / finished closing | `-` |
| `click-outside` | Clicked outside the popup | `event: Event` |
| `key-escape` | Escape was pressed | `-` |

### Menu Methods

| Method | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | Open the popup | `-` |
| `close` | Close the popup | `-` |
| `resize` | Recalculate the popup position | `-` |
| `setReference` | Set the external trigger element | `reference?: HTMLElement` |

### Menu Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Trigger element | `-` |
| `content` | Hand-written content, pairs with `MenuOption` | `-` |
| `footer` | Footer | `-` |
| `option-label` | Render every option's main content | `{ option, active, level }` |
| `option-icon` | Render every option's icon | `{ option, active, level }` |
| `option-extra` | Render every option's trailing content | `{ option, active, level }` |

### MenuOption Props

Kept for SplitButton and hand-written `content`. Groups and submenus are described through `options` only; there are no `MenuGroup` or `MenuSubmenu` components.

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | Main content or render function | _MenuContent_ | `-` |
| `value` | Value passed to events on activation | _any_ | `-` |
| `disabled` | Disable interaction | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `ripple` | Whether to show the click ripple | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `highlight` | Visual emphasis without changing selection | _boolean_ | `false` |

### MenuOption Events / Slots

`click` fires when the option is not disabled. The `default`, `icon` and `suffix` slots and the `label` render function receive the same `{ option, active, level }` context.

## Types

### MenuOptionData

| Field | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | Plain command, group or divider | _'item' \| 'group' \| 'divider'_ |
| `label` | Main content | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `icon` | Leading icon | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `extra` | Trailing content such as a shortcut | _VNodeChild \| (context) => VNodeChild_ |
| `value` | Value passed to events on activation | _any_ |
| `children` | Child commands; a plain option with children becomes a submenu | _MenuOption[]_ |
| `disabled` | Disable this item and its descendants | _boolean_ |
| `show` | Whether to render | _boolean_ |
| `ripple` | Whether to show the click ripple | _boolean_ |
| `props` | HTML attributes forwarded to the row element | _HTMLAttributes_ |

The render context is `{ option, active, level }`. `type: 'group'` is visual only and does not add a level; `type: 'divider'` is neither focusable nor activatable.

```ts
import type {
  MenuFieldNames,
  MenuInstance,
  MenuOptionData,
  MenuRenderContext,
  MenuSlots,
  MenuOptionSlots,
  MenuPlacement,
  MenuProps,
  MenuSubmenuTrigger,
  MenuOptionProps,
  MenuValue,
} from '@maple-design/ui-vue'
```

### Option state colors

Use `--mp-menu-option-selected-background` for selected rows and `--mp-menu-option-bg-selected-hover` for their hover background. Disabled colors take precedence over selected, hover and focus styles.

### Group styles

Use `--mp-menu-group-title-height` for group-title line height and the component’s group-title padding variables for spacing. The first group has no extra group gap.

<!-- Source: src/message/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/message -->

# Message

duration controls display time; 0 keeps the message open, and only finite positive values schedule automatic closing. Hover preserves remaining time. KeepAlive reactivation starts a full configured duration, while deactivation or unmounting cancels the old timer.

### Description

Displays lightweight, nonmodal global feedback without locking scrolling or blocking page interaction.

## Basic examples

### Function Calls

Example source: src/message/example/demos/function-call.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { h, onBeforeUnmount, resolveComponent } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

function createMessage(type) {
  if (type === 'time') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      duration: 1000,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'position') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      position: 'bottom',
    })
  }

  if (type === 'icon') {
    Message.info({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      icon: () => h(resolveComponent('MIconHeart'), { style: { paddingRight: '12px' } }),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'action') {
    const customMessage = Message({
      content: 'Hello, Maple',
      action: () =>
        h(
          resolveComponent('MpButton'),
          { size: 'sm', status: 'primary', onClick: () => customMessage.close() },
          { default: () => '关闭' },
        ),
    })
  }

  if (type === 'closable') {
    Message({
      content: '这是一条消息提示',
      closable: true,
      duration: 0,
    })
  }

  if (type === 'update') {
    Message.info({
      id: 'demo-update',
      content: '更新中...',
      duration: 0,
      resetOnUpdate: true,
    })

    setTimeout(() => {
      Message.success({
        id: 'demo-update',
        content: '更新完成',
        duration: 2000,
        resetOnUpdate: true,
      })
    }, 1000)
  }

  if (type === 'loading') {
    const message = Message.loading('等待中...')
    setTimeout(() => {
      message.close()
      Message.success('加载成功')
    }, 2000)
  }

  if (!type) {
    Message('这是一条消息提示')
  }
}
function openMultiple() {
  const message1 = Message('Message 1')
  Message.success('Message 2')
  Message.warning('Message 3')

  setTimeout(() => {
    message1.close()
  }, 1000)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  Message.clear()
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage()">基本使用</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('icon')">自定义图标</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('position')">位置</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('time')">显示时长</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('closable')">可关闭</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('update')">更新内容</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('loading')">Loading 常驻</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="openMultiple">多实例</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="createMessage('action')">自定义操作</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

## Appearance and states

### Statuses

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### Configuration reference for this comparison

| Configuration | Purpose | Related examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | Visual emphasis | Appearance combinations |
| `status` | Semantic status | Appearance combinations |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->


The standard statuses are `default / info / success / warning / danger / loading`. The convenience method is named `error`, while the component receives `status="danger"`. Call `Message(...)` for a default message; there is no `normal` alias.

Example source: src/message/example/demos/type.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

function create(type) {
  const text = type === 'loading' ? '等待中...' : '这是一条消息提示'
  const message = Message[type](text)

  if (type === 'loading') {
    setTimeout(() => {
      message.close()
      Message.success('加载成功')
    }, 2000)
  }
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  Message.clear()
})
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" :size="['3vmin', '4vmin']">
    <mp-button status="success" block @click="create('success')">成功</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="warning" block @click="create('warning')">警告</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="info" block @click="create('info')">信息</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="danger" block @click="create('error')">错误</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="create('loading')">加载</mp-button>
    <mp-button status="default" block @click="Message('普通提示')">普通</mp-button>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Visual variants

Visual emphasis is independent of status: neutral uses an overlay surface and status icon; tonal uses a subtle status background; solid uses a strong status fill and paired foreground. Cedar and Maple both default to neutral. Explicit solid / tonal variants share the same color contract. Solid default/loading retain a dark surface. MessageVariant is exported; imperative calls, default options and same-id updates accept variant.

Example source: src/message/example/demos/variant.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const variants = ['neutral', 'tonal', 'solid'] as const
</script>

<template>
  <mp-space wrap>
    <mp-button @click="Message.success({ content: 'neutral (default)', closable: true })">neutral (default)</mp-button>
    <mp-button
      v-for="variant in variants"
      :key="variant"
      @click="Message.success({ content: variant, variant, closable: true })"
      >{{ variant }}</mp-button
    >
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Appearance combinations

Use this example for immediate feedback after an action. Adjust variant, status and compare the component with the same data. Keep the content unchanged while comparing the available settings.

Example source: src/message/example/demos/appearance-lab.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive as __demoReactive, computed as demoComputed, ref as demoRef, reactive, toRefs } from 'vue'

const shows = reactive({
  show1: false,
  show2: false,
  show3: false,
  show4: false,
  show5: false,
  showCenter: false,
  showClosable: false,
})
const { show1, show2, show3, show4, show5, showCenter, showClosable } = toRefs(shows)
const __demoAppearance = __demoReactive({ variant: 'neutral', status: 'default' })
const demoCompareFields = [
  { name: 'variant', values: ['neutral', 'tonal', 'solid'] },
  { name: 'status', values: ['default', 'info', 'success', 'warning', 'danger', 'loading'] },
]
const demoCompareAxis = demoRef('variant')
const demoComparedOptions = demoComputed(
  () => demoCompareFields.find((field) => field.name === demoCompareAxis.value)?.values ?? [],
)
</script>
<template>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { reactive, toRefs } from 'vue'

const shows = reactive({
  show1: false,
  show2: false,
  show3: false,
  show4: false,
  show5: false,
  showCenter: false,
  showClosable: false,
})
const { show1, show2, show3, show4, show5, showCenter, showClosable } = toRefs(shows)

  shows[type] = !shows[type]
}
</script>

<template>

    <mp-button status="primary" block @click="changeValue('showCenter')">居中显示</mp-button>
```

## Behavior

- `duration` is milliseconds; `0` stays open. `Message.loading(...)` stays open by default.
- Within one mount container/position, the same `id` updates the instance without duplicate DOM.
- Only `resetOnUpdate`=`true` restarts the full duration on same-id updates.
- `pauseOnHover` saves remaining time and resumes it on pointer leave.
- Display deadlines are independent of CSS motion. Restarting, hover pause, cleanup/unmount invalidate old timer callbacks, which recheck open before running.
- KeepAlive deactivation cancels timers; reactivation restarts the current full duration. Updates while deactivated/retained restart after unmount do not schedule work.
- Resuming exhausted positive hover timing requests closing; resetting duration to 0 keeps it open. Only finite positive durations auto-close; negative/nonfinite values do not schedule.
- Services await actual leave completion rather than forcing 150ms/200ms exits. Closing/clearing before mount cleans up directly and reports service onClosed without inventing component open/opened/close animation events. Business duration stays independent of CSS transitions.
- Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.
- Queues isolate by `popupContainer + position`; `Message.clear(position?)` clears per position.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, icons and close-button spacing follow reading order. Direction changes do not alter message type, timers or closing. Programmatic calls use explicit configuration or document direction.

## Usage notes

### Component attribute forwarding

`Message.Component` forwards `id`, `class`, `style`, `aria-*` and native event listeners to its actual `role="alert"` region: the Cedar message root or the Maple inner visible panel. Each attribute is applied once. Required internal roles and classes remain; component lifecycle listeners such as `open` are not bound as DOM listeners. Native attributes update with the parent in both inline and Teleport modes. `dir` continues to determine reading direction. A function service `id` identifies the message for updates and is separate from a component native DOM `id`.
### Configuration

Visual variant is independent of status. neutral uses a neutral popup and status icon; tonal uses a low-emphasis status background with dark content; solid uses a high-emphasis fill and matching foreground. Cedar/Maple both default to neutral; explicit solid/tonal have matching visual semantics. default/loading solid retains a dark background, with the loading icon indicating progress. Both export MessageVariant; function calls, setDefaultOptions and same-id updates support variant.

Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

## API

### Message Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| `open` / `v-model:open` | Controlled visibility | `boolean` | `false` |
| `id` | Unique id in one queue | `string \| number` | Automatically generated |
| `status` | Semantic status | `default \| info \| success \| warning \| danger \| loading` | `default` |
| variant | Visual emphasis | `neutral \| tonal \| solid` | `neutral` |
| `position` | Region of the message itself in the viewport: top/center/bottom, default top. Not positioned relative to a trigger | `top \| center \| bottom` | `top` |
| `content` | Content | `MessageContent` | - |
| `icon` | Custom icon | `MessageContent` | - |
| `action` | Actions | `MessageContent` | - |
| `duration` | Auto-close duration in ms; `0` disables automatic closing | `number` | `3000` |
| `showIcon` | Whether to show the status icon | `boolean` | `true` |
| `closable` | Show the close button | `boolean` | `false` |
| `pauseOnHover` | Pause while hovered | `boolean` | `false` |
| `resetOnUpdate` | Restart duration after an id update | `boolean` | `false` |
| `closeButtonAriaLabel` | Close button label | `string` | `Close message` |
| `popupContainer` | Portal container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |

Function options additionally accept `onOpen / onOpened / onClose / onClosed`. Close callbacks receive the current `id`.

### Message Events

`update:open`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, and `closed`, emitted once per visibility cycle. When an initially open message hydrates, it skips the initial enter animation and emits `opened` after `open` on mount.

### Message Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)` | Open a default message |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | Open a message with the corresponding status |
| `Message.clear(position?)` | Clear all messages or a specified position |
| `Message.setDefaultOptions(options)` | Set defaults for subsequent calls |
| `Message.resetDefaultOptions()` | Restore defaults |

Returns `{ close() }`; repeated calls do not repeat closing. A handle owns a specific message item: it remains valid for same-id updates of that item, but cannot close a new item after the old item completed leaving and its id was reused.

The optional second appContext argument applies to each message: injections, registered components, global properties and error handling use that application context. It does not capture a local Provider at the call site. Applications still share one queue and chronological stack per target/position; Message.clear continues clearing across applications. Each call uses its explicit context, then the current install default. An update with no available context retains the existing item scope. Switching a same-id item to another available context remounts its presentation and restarts its duration while keeping its business handle valid; other items keep their presentation and timers.

`Message.Component` retains its real Props and instance types. Its `restartTimer()` instance method resets only while active, open and resetOnUpdate=true. It is not a service-handle method; while hover-paused, it resets only the saved remaining duration.

| Component instance method | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | Reset the current duration, subject to active, open, resetOnUpdate and hover-pause state |

`MessageContent` is `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`: text, numbers, empty boolean children, VNodes, nested child arrays and synchronous render functions. Arbitrary plain objects and asynchronous tasks are not renderable content. content, icon and action share this protocol; local slots take precedence.

duration must be finite and nonnegative. Negative values, NaN and Infinity do not schedule automatic closure and trigger development prop validation. Zero stays open; restartTimer follows the same rules.

### Message Slots

`default`、`icon`、`action`。

## CSS Variables

Colors use `--mp-message-{variant}-{status}-{bg|content-color|icon-color|border-color|close-color}`. bg sets the panel; content-color sets body/actions without separate styling; icon-color sets status icons; border-color sets borders; close-color sets close buttons. Custom backgrounds require checking all three foregrounds. Geometry retains platform density. Variables must affect actual Teleport-container ancestors.

# NavMenu

NavMenu provides horizontal filter entries with key/label options, independent selection, title fallback, scoped slots and controlled open state.

## Basic examples

### Horizontal filters

Example source: src/nav-menu/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import type { NavMenuKey, NavMenuOption } from '../../..'

const category = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null)
const region = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null)
const keyword = ref('')
const appliedKeyword = ref('')
const categories: NavMenuOption[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部分类' },
  { key: 'design', label: '设计资源' },
  { key: 'development', label: '开发工具' },
]
const regions: NavMenuOption[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: '全部地区' },
  { key: 'east', label: '华东' },
  { key: 'south', label: '华南' },
  { key: 'north', label: '华北' },
]
const categoryLabel = computed(() => categories.find((item) => item.key === category.value)?.label ?? '未选择')
const regionLabel = computed(() => regions.find((item) => item.key === region.value)?.label ?? '未选择')
function resetFilters(close: () => void) {
  keyword.value = ''
  appliedKeyword.value = ''
  close()
}
function applyFilters(close: () => void) {
  appliedKeyword.value = keyword.value.trim()
  close()
}
</script>
<template>
  <div>
    <mp-nav-menu mode="horizontal">
      <mp-nav-menu-item v-model="category" label="分类" :options="categories" />
      <mp-nav-menu-item
        v-model="region"
        label="地区"
        :options="regions"
        options-mode="horizontal"
        popup-layout="full-width"
      />
      <mp-nav-menu-item label="更多筛选" :highlight="!!appliedKeyword" popup-layout="full" :hide-on-select="false">
        <template #content="{ close }">
          <div style="height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px">
            <div style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto">
              <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
                <strong>按关键词筛选</strong>
                <mp-input v-model="keyword" placeholder="输入资源名称" aria-label="资源名称" />
              </mp-space>
            </div>
            <mp-space>
              <mp-button @click="resetFilters(close)">重置</mp-button>
              <mp-button @click="applyFilters(close)">应用</mp-button>
            </mp-space>
          </div>
        </template>
      </mp-nav-menu-item>
    </mp-nav-menu>
    <p aria-live="polite">分类：{{ categoryLabel }}；地区：{{ regionLabel }}；关键词：{{ appliedKeyword || '不限' }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

All panels fill the viewport width below the entire filter bar. The default popup-layout="full-width" uses content height, capped by the remaining visible height. popup-layout="full" fills all remaining visible height. Custom content owns draft, apply/reset actions and sticky footer layout. Input keyboard and viewport changes update the available region.

## Layout and arrangement

### Long content and fixed actions

Long lists scroll inside the available panel height. A full panel keeps its actions visible while its body scrolls independently, with background scrolling locked.

Example source: src/nav-menu/example/demos/long-content.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { NavMenuKey, NavMenuOption } from '../../..'

const value = ref<NavMenuKey | null>(null)
const options: NavMenuOption[] = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, index) => ({ key: index, label: `选项 ${index + 1}` }))
const conditions = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, index) => ({ value: index, label: `条件 ${index + 1}` }))
const draft = ref<Array<string | number | boolean>>([])
const applied = ref<Array<string | number | boolean>>([])
function apply(close: () => void) {
  applied.value = [...draft.value]
  close()
}
function reset(close: () => void) {
  draft.value = []
  applied.value = []
  close()
}
</script>

<template>
  <div data-nav-long-demo>
    <mp-nav-menu>
      <mp-nav-menu-item v-model="value" label="长列表" :options="options" />
      <mp-nav-menu-item label="更多条件" popup-layout="full" :highlight="applied.length > 0" :hide-on-select="false">
        <template #content="{ close }">
          <div style="height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px">
            <strong>筛选条件</strong>
            <div data-nav-filter-body style="flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain">
              <mp-checkbox-group v-model="draft" :options="conditions" orientation="vertical" />
            </div>
            <mp-space>
              <mp-button @click="reset(close)">重置</mp-button>
              <mp-button @click="apply(close)">应用条件</mp-button>
            </mp-space>
          </div>
        </template>
      </mp-nav-menu-item>
    </mp-nav-menu>
    <p aria-live="polite">长列表选中：{{ value ?? '未选择' }}；已应用 {{ applied.length }} 项</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

## Data and state control

### Controlled state and disabled entries

Example source: src/nav-menu/example/demos/controlled.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const accepted = ref(true)
const open = ref(false)
const value = ref<string | number | null>(null)
const options = [
  { key: 0, label: '不限' },
  { key: 'design', label: '设计' },
  { key: 'disabled', label: '禁用选项', disabled: true },
]
function updateOpen(next: boolean) {
  if (accepted.value) {
    open.value = next
  }
}
function updateValue(next: string | number | null) {
  if (accepted.value) {
    value.value = next
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <mp-button @click="accepted = !accepted">{{
    accepted ? '当前接受更新，点击拒绝' : '当前拒绝更新，点击接受'
  }}</mp-button>
  <mp-nav-menu>
    <mp-nav-menu-item
      :open="open"
      :model-value="value"
      :options="options"
      label="受控筛选"
      @update:open="updateOpen"
      @update:model-value="updateValue"
    />
    <mp-nav-menu-item label="禁用入口" disabled :options="options" />
  </mp-nav-menu>
  <p>选中：{{ value ?? '未选择' }}；展开：{{ open }}</p>
</template>
```

## Interaction and control

### Panel state and closing

Example source: src/nav-menu/example/demos/panel-state.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import type { NavMenuInstance } from '../../..'

const menu = ref<NavMenuInstance>()
const unmountOnClose = ref(false)
const options = [
  { key: 0, label: '不限' },
  { key: 'design', label: '设计资源' },
]
</script>
<template>
  <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
    <mp-space>
      <span>关闭后卸载</span>
      <mp-switch v-model="unmountOnClose" />
      <mp-button @click="menu?.close()">关闭当前面板</mp-button>
    </mp-space>
    <mp-nav-menu ref="menu" mode="horizontal">
      <mp-nav-menu-item label="草稿表单" :unmount-on-close="unmountOnClose">
        <template #content="{ close }">
          <mp-space direction="column" style="width: 100%">
            <mp-input default-value="" placeholder="输入后关闭，再打开查看草稿" aria-label="面板内部草稿" />
            <mp-button @click="close">关闭并返回入口</mp-button>
          </mp-space>
        </template>
      </mp-nav-menu-item>
      <mp-nav-menu-item label="分类" :options="options" />
    </mp-nav-menu>
    <p>默认保留面板内部草稿；开启卸载后再次展开会重新创建。关闭面板不会提交或重置业务筛选值。</p>
  </mp-space>
</template>
```

### Cross-platform contract

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Both libraries create panel content on first open and retain it when closed or switched, including local drafts and expanded branches. With `unmount-on-close`, content is destroyed after the closing transition and recreated on the next open; the Item's own selected value remains intact. Applications own draft submission, resets and filter application.

Root `close()` requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus without changing selected values, active-item or desktop tree expanded-keys. Controlled open values remain authoritative when closure is rejected. Entries with neither options nor a content slot never open; asynchronous options follow the current open state when they arrive. KeepAlive suspension hides panels and requests closure; controlled state remains authoritative on activation.

Item values, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods share the same contract. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. Names must be unique within the menu; changing a name releases the previous one. Batched swaps and insertions validate the final rendered names. Vertical options expand enabled ancestors of the selected value on initialization and value/options updates. Users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | options tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Individual entry bottom | Entire filter bar bottom; standalone Item uses its own bottom |
| Trigger and placement | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Backdrop and scrolling | Non-modal; background scroll remains available | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Theme | theme override | Global theme; no theme prop |
| Tree-only methods | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

## API

### NavMenu Props

| Prop | Description | Default |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| mode | Horizontal only on mobile | horizontal |
| active-item / default-active-item | Controlled / initial active named entry | undefined / null |
| size | xs / sm / md / lg / xl | md |
| disabled | Disable all entries | false |
| popup-container | Popup mount container; false renders in place. Does not change viewport layout references; transformed ancestors may change the fixed-position containing block | body |
| popup-class | Additional panel class | — |
| overlay | Show the overlay; false retains a transparent outside-click area | true |
| overlay-closable | Close on overlay click | true |
| lock-scroll | Lock background scrolling during opening and closing transitions | true |
| esc-to-close | Escape closes the current panel | true |
| z-index | Overlay and panel stacking level | Automatically distributed |

Event: update:active-item. Methods: close(), resize(), setActiveItem(key). The default slot contains mp-nav-menu-item; NavMenu.Item is also available.

### NavMenuItem Props

| Prop | Description | Default |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| name | Unique root-level business activation key; omitted entries highlight their selections independently | — |
| label | Entry title when no option matches | — |
| options / field-names | Cedar-compatible options and field mapping | [] / — |
| model-value / default-value | Controlled / initial selected key; supports strings, numbers and null | undefined / null |
| open / default-open | Controlled / initial open state | undefined / false |
| highlight | Visual highlight override; follows business active state when omitted | undefined |
| disabled | Disable the entry, also respecting the parent menu | undefined |
| hide-on-select | Close the panel after select | true |
| unmount-on-close | Destroy panel content after the closing transition; retain it by default | false |
| popup-layout | full-width spans the viewport width with content-driven height; full fills the visible area below the filter bar in both dimensions. Both open below the entire filter bar without automatic flipping; width does not depend on the entry | full-width |
| popup-style | Custom panel styles | — |
| popup-container / popup-class | Override the parent menu mount container / panel class | Follow parent menu |
| options-mode | Vertical / horizontal arrangement of options within the panel | vertical |

A standalone NavMenuItem uses its own bottom edge as the panel origin. Triggering is fixed to click; overflowing entries scroll horizontally. Mobile does not expose placement/trigger, dropdown, or side full-height layouts.

Events: update:model-value, update:open, select(key, option, event), click(event). Methods: select(key, event?), close(), setOpen(open).

Slots: default (entry contents), label, icon, content (replaces the default options panel), option-label, option-icon and option-extra. Entry/content slots receive `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`; option slots receive `{ option, active, expanded, level }`.

## Types

NavMenuKey is string | number. NavMenuOption uses key, label, icon, extra, children, disabled, show and props, with type item/group/divider. label/icon/extra accept VNodes or context render functions. Numeric 0 and empty strings are valid keys; missing or duplicate item keys throw. Disabled state is inherited by descendants; hidden items and their subtrees are omitted. All types are exported from @maple-design/ui-vue.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

NavMenu inherits the nearest native `dir`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Left/Right moves navigation focus in reading direction; Home/End focuses available boundary entries. Down opens the option panel; Escape closes and returns trigger focus. Horizontal panel keys follow direction while Up/Down keeps existing order. Teleported panels inherit trigger direction. Direction changes do not clear filters or selections.

# NoticeBar

### Intro

Display temporary system notices or campaign messages.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/notice-bar/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="notice-bar-example">
    <mp-notice-bar text="这是一条通知信息" />
    <mp-notice-bar style="margin-top: 12px" type="info" text="信息提示" />
    <mp-notice-bar style="margin-top: 12px" mode="closeable" text="可关闭通知" />
    <mp-notice-bar style="margin-top: 12px" scrollable text="这是一条很长很长的通知，将会横向滚动播放。" />
  </div>
</template>
```

### Pause scrolling

Use `paused` with an action button to let readers pause and resume. When the system requests reduced motion, content wraps without animation.

`speed` is measured in CSS pixels per second. The cycle is recalculated when the container, text, or slot content changes size; animation progress is retained, so the visible position may shift. Provide a pause button in `action` as shown below, or use `closeable` to let readers dismiss continuous motion.

Example source: src/notice-bar/example/demos/en-US/pausable.vue

```vue
<template>
  <mp-notice-bar scrollable :paused="paused" text="This notice can be paused so you can continue reading.">
    <template #action>
      <mp-button html-type="button" variant="text" :aria-pressed="paused" @click="paused = !paused">
        {{ paused ? 'Resume scrolling' : 'Pause scrolling' }}
      </mp-button>
    </template>
  </mp-notice-bar>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const paused = ref(false)
</script>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons, text and close actions follow reading order. Scrolling text moves from inline end toward start, reversing motion in RTL without mirroring text or changing close/replay event meanings.

Icon and close spacing use `--mp-notice-bar-icon-margin` and `--mp-notice-bar-close-margin`; RTL uses `--mp-notice-bar-icon-margin-rtl` and `--mp-notice-bar-close-margin-rtl`. The close control uses the nearest LocaleProvider, falling back to the global language.

String `speed` and `delay` values are parsed by their numeric prefix. Nonfinite speeds and speeds below 1 use 1 px/s; invalid or nonfinite delays use 0 seconds, while negative delays retain CSS animation semantics. Closing hides the component without unmounting it; remount it from the parent to show it again. Internal instance state and handlers are not public reopen or pause methods; use `paused` to pause.

| `icon` | Left-icon name; empty string hides it | `string` | `info-circle` |

| `background` | Background color | `string` | `-` |
| `scrollable` | Enable marquee | `boolean` | `false` |

| `speed` | Scroll speed (px/s) | `number \| string` | `50` |

<!-- Source: src/number-keyboard/docs/en-US.md; locale: en-US; page: /en-US/number-keyboard -->

# NumberKeyboard

### Intro

A bottom popup virtual keyboard for numeric or password input flows.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/number-keyboard/example/demos/basic.vue

```vue
<template>
  <div class="number-keyboard-example">
    <mp-input v-model="value" edit-mode="direct" readonly placeholder="点击输入" @click="open = true" />
    <mp-number-keyboard v-model="value" v-model:open="open" :max-length="11" title="安全键盘" />

    <mp-input
      v-model="customValue"
      edit-mode="direct"
      readonly
      placeholder="自定义主题"
      style="margin-top: 16px"
      @click="showCustom = true"
    />
    <mp-number-keyboard v-model="customValue" v-model:open="showCustom" theme="custom" extra-key="." />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('')
const open = ref(false)
const customValue = ref('')
const showCustom = ref(false)
</script>
```

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Header and actions inherit reading direction. The numeric keypad retains LTR digit order; RTL does not reverse digits or entered values. Safe areas still use physical device edges.

Keys are native buttons supporting Tab, Enter and Space. The icon-only delete button has a localized name. The visible `title` names the dialog by default; component `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` can provide an explicit dialog name.

Within FormItem, the dialog merges the caller’s `aria-describedby` with the current form error; clearing the error preserves the caller’s description.

Input and visibility use local passive state and emit updates; parents should accept and synchronize them, since refusing an update alone does not guarantee that the panel remains open. `hide-on-click-outside` controls backdrop closing, not arbitrary outside mouse clicks.

`max-length` uses JavaScript UTF-16 length. Finite values are floored and clamped to zero; `Infinity` or the exact string `"Infinity"` is unlimited. Extra keys may contain multiple characters: an addition that exceeds the limit is rejected in full and emits no `input`. Delete removes one UTF-16 code unit. There are no public business methods or slots; ordinary event promises do not control input or visibility.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is input text; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins; initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

The keyboard panel uses an independent `open/defaultOpen` model with `update:open`. Text and panel opening are separate states.

### NumberKeyboard Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------- |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled input value, read once | `string` | `''` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled visibility, read once | `boolean` | `false` |
| `v-model` | Current value | `string` | `''` |
| `v-model:open` | Whether keyboard is visible | `boolean` | `false` |
| `title` | Keyboard title | `string` | `-` |
| `theme` | Keyboard layout | `default \| custom` | `default` |
| `max-length` | Max input length | `number \| string` | `Infinity` |
| `extra-key` | Extra bottom-left key(s) | `string \| string[]` | `''` |
| `close-button-text` | Done button text in custom theme | `string` | `完成` |
| `delete-button-text` | Delete key text; icon when empty | `string` | `-` |
| `show-delete-key` | Show delete key | `boolean` | `true` |
| `random-key-order` | Shuffle 1-9 keys | `boolean` | `false` |
| `hide-on-click-outside` | Close when overlay is clicked | `boolean` | `true` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | `boolean` | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Overlay class | `string` | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Overlay style | `object` | `-` |
| `overlay-closable` | Allow backdrop close, subject to hide-on-click-outside | `boolean` | `true` |
| `lock-scroll` | Lock background scroll | `boolean` | `true` |
| `esc-to-close` | Close on Escape | `boolean` | `true` |
| `popup-container` | Teleport target | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to enable the bottom, left and right safe areas | `boolean` | `true` |

### NumberKeyboard Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | ---------------------- | ------------- |
| `update:modelValue` | Input value update | `value: string` |
| `update:open` | Visibility update | `open: boolean` |
| `input` | Emitted on key press | `key: string` |
| `delete` | Emitted on delete | `-` |
| `close` | Emitted on close | `-` |
| `blur` | Emitted on close | `-` |
| `open` | Emitted on open | `-` |
| `opened` | Emitted after open transition | `-` |
| `closed` | Emitted after close transition | `-` |
| `key-escape` | Emitted on Escape | `-` |

## CSS Variables

<!-- component-css-variables:start -->

Use these variables to customize the component. Defaults may vary by the selector condition shown. Each variable applies to the corresponding size, variant and interaction states.

<div class="token-reference-table" style="max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">

| Variable | Default / condition | Affected styles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mp-number-keyboard-background` | `var(--mp-color-bg-1)` | `background` |
| `--mp-number-keyboard-close-color` | `var(--mp-sys-color-content-brand)` | `color` |
| `--mp-number-keyboard-close-font-size` | `var(--mp-font-size-lg, 16px)` | `font-size` |
| `--mp-number-keyboard-delete-icon-size` | `22px` | `font-size` |

Explicit inline styles and props that write the same CSS property take precedence over stylesheet defaults. After Teleport, ordinary CSS variables inherit from the actual mount location. When using ThemeProvider, follow its local-theme and popup configuration rules. # Overlay

### Intro

Create an overlay layer to emphasize specific page elements.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

Example source: src/overlay/example/demos/overlay-base.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="open = true">显示背景层</mp-button>
  <mp-overlay v-model:open="open" />
</template>
```

## Content and presentation

### Overlay Content

Example source: src/overlay/example/demos/overlay-content.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="open = true">嵌入内容</mp-button>
  <mp-overlay v-model:open="open">
    <div class="overlay-content">点击背景区域或按 Escape 关闭</div>
  </mp-overlay>
</template>

<style lang="less" scoped>
.overlay-content {
  padding: 24px;
  width: 312px;
  background: var(--mp-color-fill-3);
  border-radius: 28px;
}
</style>
```

## Interaction and control

### Click Event

Example source: src/overlay/example/demos/click-event.vue

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="open = true">点击背景层</mp-button>
  <mp-overlay v-model:open="open" @click="Message.success('点击了背景层')" />
</template>
```

## Usage notes

### Configuration

These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API.

## API

### Overlay Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- |
| `v-model:open` | Show overlay | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `default-open` | Whether to display by default in uncontrolled mode | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `overlay-closable` | Whether clicking the backdrop closes the Overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `lock-scroll` | Whether to disable scrolling penetration, scrolling the Overlay when disabled will not cause the body to scroll | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `unmount-on-close` | Whether to unmount slot content after closing | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `popup-container` | Teleport target; `false` renders in place | _string \| HTMLElement \| false_ | `'body'` |
| `esc-to-close` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `z-index` | Custom z-index | _number_ | `-` |

### Overlay Events

| Event | Description | Arguments |
| ------------ | ------------------- | --------------- |
| `update:open` | Open state changed | `boolean` |
| `click` | Triggered when clicking the overlay | `MouseEvent` |
| `key-escape` | Triggered when click keyboard ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |
| `open` | Triggered when opening starts | `-` |
| `opened` | Triggered after opening transition | `-` |
| `close` | Triggered when closing starts | `-` |
| `closed` | Triggered after closing transition | `-` |

### Overlay Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --------- | ---------- | ---- |
| `default` | Default slot | `-` |

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

# PageHeader

The back button only emits `back`; it does not navigate or call browser history. The demos show a Message notification. Handle the destination in your application. The native button supports click, Enter and Space.

Displays the current page title, context and related actions. Use application-level `class` / `style` for fixed positioning, safe areas and visual backgrounds.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Compose the heading and actions with Card and Space. Tap Back, Follow or Create task to show a message. Use `show-back` to display a back arrow to the left of the title and place the primary action at the bottom.

Example source: src/page-header/example/demos/basic-usage.vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { Message } from '@maple-design/ui-vue'

const handleBack = () => Message.info('点击返回')
const handleAction = () => Message.success('已关注项目')
const handleCreate = () => Message.info('点击创建任务')
</script>

<template>
  <mp-card variant="outline" size="sm">
    <mp-page-header show-back back-button-aria-label="返回项目列表" @back="handleBack">
      <template #title>
        <mp-space direction="column" :size="0">
          <h2 style="margin: 0; font: inherit">设计系统</h2>
          <small>项目概览</small>
        </mp-space>
      </template>
      <template #extra><mp-button @click="handleAction">关注</mp-button></template>
      <template #footer><mp-button block status="primary" @click="handleCreate">创建任务</mp-button></template>
    </mp-page-header>
  </mp-card>
</template>
```

## Content and presentation

### Breadcrumbs and transparent surfaces

Compare breadcrumb navigation and title hierarchy on transparent surfaces.

<details>
<summary>Configuration details and limits</summary>

#### Content above the heading

Use Card for the surface, the `header` slot for breadcrumbs, and Space to stack the title and subtitle.

#### Transparent background

The page header is transparent by default. A tonal Card supplies the outer surface without custom background styles.

</details>

### Complete structure

Compose the header with Card, Space, Cell, Grid, Statistic and Divider without custom styles. The project details, statistics and actions match the desktop example. The back arrow sits beside the title, while breadcrumbs occupy the separate `header` slot. Mobile stacks the title and project details and places Create task at the bottom.

Example source: src/page-header/example/demos/complete.vue

```vue

          <mp-breadcrumb-item>项目</mp-breadcrumb-item>
        </mp-breadcrumb>
      </template>
```
